അതേസമയം ഈ ഋഷിസായി എന്നു പറയുന്നത് അനേകായിരം സിദ്ധികാണിച്ചയാളാണ്, പക്ഷേ അത്, ആ സിദ്ധിജാലങ്ങള്‍ ദൈവത്തിന്‍റെ വകയായിട്ട് നമ്മള്‍ കരുതിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. അപ്പോള്‍ ഇത് യോഗങ്ങളും അങ്ങനെ മുറകളും അങ്ങനെ പലവിധത്തിലുള്ള സിദ്ധിജാലങ്ങള്‍കൊണ്ട് മനുഷ്യനെ കബളിപ്പിച്ചിട്ട് ഇത് ദൈവമാണെന്ന് വരുത്തിത്തീര്‍ക്കുന്ന ഒരു കര്‍മമുണ്ട്. നമ്മള്‍ അത് ചെയ്തുകൂടാ. അതുവരേക്കും എന്തെല്ലാം നാശം വന്നാലും ചെയ്യാന്‍ പാടില്ലാത്തതൊന്നും ചെയ്യില്ല. അതു ചെയ്യില്ല എന്നുള്ളത്, ഞാന്‍ ആരാധിച്ചിരുന്ന വകയും അതിന്‍റെ എല്ലാം തന്നെ, ഞാനതിനെ എടുത്ത് ദൂരെ കളഞ്ഞു എന്നല്ലാതെ അതിനെ വേണ്ടാത്തത് ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല. ചെയ്യില്ല. അങ്ങനെ സിദ്ധികാണിച്ചു കൂടാ. ദൈവനിശ്ചയമാണെങ്കില്‍ അത് തനിയേ വരണം. അതായിരുന്നു ആഗ്രഹം. പക്ഷേ ഇതിപ്പോള്‍ നിങ്ങളെ ബോദ്ധ്യപ്പെടുത്തുകയല്ല ഞാന്‍. പക്ഷേ എനിക്ക് നിങ്ങളോട് സത്യം പറയേണ്ട ഒരു കാര്യമുണ്ട്. കാരണം നിങ്ങള്‍ ചിലരെല്ലാം ഇങ്ങനെയൊക്കെ പല സന്ന്യാസിമാരുടെയും അനേകം ദേവാംശങ്ങള്‍ ചേര്‍ന്നു വന്നിട്ടുള്ള പ്രയോഗങ്ങളും കേട്ടുവച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഇതെല്ലാം നിങ്ങള്‍ ധരിക്കുകയും ദൈവത്തിന്‍റെ വശമാണെന്ന് ധരിച്ചുവച്ചിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു മതസമ്പ്രദായത്തിന്‍റെ കോലാഹലങ്ങള്‍ ധരിച്ചു പോയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഇതൊന്നും ദൈവം ചെയ്യുന്ന പണിയല്ല. ദൈവം ഒരിക്കലും അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുകയുമില്ല. നമുക്ക്, വേണമെന്നുണ്ടെങ്കില്‍ മനുഷ്യനെന്നുള്ള നിലയില്‍ ദൈവത്തിന്‍റെ കാരുണ്യം തേടിപ്പിടിക്കുക എന്നുള്ളതല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊന്നും ചെയ്യാന്‍ അധികാരമില്ല.
ഗുരുവാണി

അപ്പോള്‍ ഈ കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ നമ്മള്‍ നേരില്‍ കണ്ടറിയുന്നതിന് ഒരു ശിഷ്യന്‍ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കണമെന്നാണ്. അതിന് രണ്ടു പേരിവിടെ ഇങ്ങനെ വളര്‍ന്നു വന്ന പിള്ളേരുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവരെക്കൊണ്ടാണ് ഞാനിതൊക്കെ ചെയ്യിച്ചത്. ഇത് ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍ വന്നുനിന്ന് ചെയ്യുകയായിരുന്നു; ചെയ്യിപ്പിക്കുകയായിരുന്നു. അതങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തുകഴിഞ്ഞതിനു ശേഷം പിന്നെയും രണ്ടരക്കൊല്ലം മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കുവാന്‍ പറഞ്ഞു. മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു. പിന്നീടാണ് ഇത് തുടങ്ങി ഇന്നത്തെ നിലയില്‍ എത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഇന്നത്തെ നില എന്നു പറയുന്നത് വേറൊന്നും അല്ല. അത് പറഞ്ഞുവരണമെങ്കില്‍ വളരെ പറയണം. ഇന്നത്തെ നിലയെന്നു പറയുന്നത് കലിയുടെ ധര്‍മം. ഈ കലിധര്‍മം ചീത്തയാണെന്നു നമ്മളെ ധരിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ട് നമ്മളിതേതോ തരത്തിലൊക്കെ - ചില പുരാണങ്ങളില്‍ ചിലതൊന്നു പറയുമെന്നല്ലാതെ - പക്ഷേ അത് അവയുടെ ചുവട്ടില്‍ നില്‍ക്കുകയില്ല. അതങ്ങനെ പൊയ്പ്പോകും.

ഇതെങ്ങനെ വന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചാല്‍ ഒരു മഹാത്മാവിന്‍റെ ആ കര്‍മം തന്‍റേതു തന്നെ പൂര്‍ത്തിയാണോ എന്നു നോക്കിയപ്പോള്‍ പൂര്‍ത്തീകരണം പോലെ കണ്ടു. അപ്പോള്‍ ഉണ്ടായ ഒരബദ്ധമാണത് (ചതുര്‍വാക്യ പ്രയോഗവും അതേത്തുടര്‍ന്നുണ്ടായ കാര്യങ്ങളും). അല്ലാതെ അദ്ദേഹം തെറ്റു ചെയ്യാന്‍ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചതല്ല. ആ അബദ്ധത്തില്‍ നിന്ന് ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ച് ചതുര്‍യുഗം കഴിഞ്ഞെന്നാണ് നമുക്ക് പറഞ്ഞുകിട്ടിയ സത്യം. ആ സത്യത്തില്‍നിന്ന് നമുക്കാര്‍ക്കും വിട്ടൊഴിഞ്ഞു മാറാന്‍ കഴിയില്ലതന്നെ. അനേകം കലികള്‍, അതായത് കലികാലങ്ങള്‍, ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ചു കലികാലങ്ങള്‍, വന്നു എന്നാണ്. അതില്‍ ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ചാമത് കലിയുഗമാണ് ഇപ്പോഴത്തേത്. ആ കലിയുഗത്തിനാല്‍ ഇതിനൊരു മാറ്റം വരുത്താന്‍, അനേകംപേരെ വരുത്തിയിട്ടും, കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല. ഈ ഗുരുക്കന്‍മാരെ കുറേ പറഞ്ഞു കൊടുത്തും അറിവുകൊടുത്തും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു എങ്കിലും ത്രിമൂര്‍ത്തിയുടെ അവസ്ഥവരെ ചെന്നു പറഞ്ഞ്, അവിടെ നില്‍ക്കുകയാണ്. അതിനു മുകളില്‍ പ്രകാശത്തിന്‍റെ കാര്യമേ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുള്ളൂ. ഉപനിഷത്തുക്കളെല്ലാം തന്നെ അതേ പറയുന്നുള്ളൂ. എവിടെ നോക്കിയാലും അതേയുള്ളൂ.

ഈ പ്രകാശം എന്ത്? ഈ പ്രകാശത്തിന്‍റെ സ്വഭാവം എന്ത്? അതേതുവിധം? ഏതു കളര്‍? ഒരു കളര്‍ എത്ര കളറായിട്ടു മാറും? ഇതൊക്കെ ഇങ്ങനെ നമുക്ക് പറഞ്ഞു കിട്ടിയാലേ ഇത് മുന്നോട്ടു പോകൂ. അല്ലാതെ സിദ്ധിജാലങ്ങളോ മറ്റുവിധത്തിലുള്ള കാര്യങ്ങളോ നമുക്ക് പരിപാലിക്കാനുള്ള കാര്യമല്ല ഇത്. അങ്ങനെ ഒന്നും ആരും ധരിക്കരുത്. അങ്ങനെ ചിലര്‍ ധരിച്ചിട്ട് നമ്മുടെ ആളുകളില്‍ തന്നെ വലിയ അബദ്ധവുമുണ്ടായിട്ടുണ്ട്. എന്താണവര്‍ കാണുന്നത്? ഒരു ദേവനോ ആയിരം ദേവനോ ദേവിയോ അല്ല. കോടിക്കണക്കിനെണ്ണം ഒരു ദേവനെക്കൊണ്ടു സാധിച്ച കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ പിന്നെന്തുകൊണ്ട് സാധിച്ചു കൂടാ എന്ന് ധരിച്ചിട്ട് അവരത് ആ വഴിക്ക് കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യാന്‍ നോക്കി. പക്ഷേ അത് പൊയ്പ്പോയി. അവര്‍ക്കൊന്നും ചെയ്യാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല. അവര്‍ക്കപ്പോഴാണ് മനസ്സിലാകുന്നത്, അതങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യാന്‍ പാടില്ലാത്തതാണെന്ന്. ദേവന്‍മാരുടെ കഥയിലുള്ള ചില കാര്യങ്ങളൊക്കെയാണ് നമ്മള്‍ കേട്ടും അറിഞ്ഞും വച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഈ കഥയൊന്നും തികച്ചും ഈശ്വരസന്നിധാനത്തിലേക്ക് അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ദൈവസന്നിധാനത്തിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്നതല്ല. അത് വേറെ എവിടെയെങ്കിലും എത്തുകയേ ഉള്ളൂ.

ഇപ്പോളിത് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മനസ്സിലാകാന്‍ വേണ്ടി ഇതൊന്ന് ഇങ്ങനെ കുറിച്ചിരിക്കുകയാണ്. ഇത് ഇതിന്‍റെ ചുരുക്കി ചില വാക്കുകള്‍ മാത്രമേ ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലുള്ളൂ. ഇത് എഴുതിനിറയ്ക്കാന്‍ എളുപ്പമല്ല. വേണ്ടിവന്നാല്‍ ഒരു വലിയ ഈശ്വരസങ്കല്‍പത്തില്‍ ജനിക്കേണ്ട മക്കളാരെങ്കിലുമാണ് ഇതു വന്നെഴുതേണ്ടത്. അല്ലാതെ ഇന്നത്തെ പഠിച്ച ആളുകള്‍ക്ക് എഴുതാന്‍ പറ്റുകയില്ല. അതിനു കാരണം അവര്‍ പഠിച്ചതും പഠിപ്പിച്ചതും ഇന്നുവരെ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്ന സിദ്ധരൂപം മുതല്‍ ആവര്‍ത്തിച്ചുവന്ന സംസ്കൃത വശത്തില്‍ക്കൂടി പണ്ഡിതമഹോപാധ്യായമോ പണ്ഡിതശിരോമണിയോ ഇങ്ങനെ പല അവസ്ഥാന്തരഭേദത്തില്‍ പഠിച്ച് ഇതിന്‍റെ അത്ഭുതം പറച്ചിലാണ് വേല. അല്ലാതെ അവരുടെ അനുഭവം അല്ല. അപ്പോള്‍ ഇതിങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞുപോയിട്ട് ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ചു ചതുര്‍യുഗം കഴിഞ്ഞെന്നാണ്. ഇതാണ് ഇതിന്‍റെ സത്യം. ഇതില്‍ നിന്ന് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കിത് കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്, നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളാകുന്ന ചില ആളുകള്‍ വരും. അതാണ് നിങ്ങള്‍ സൂക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടത്. എങ്ങനെ? ഈ ഗുരുപരമ്പരയില്‍പ്പെട്ട ഏതെങ്കിലുമൊരു വീട്ടില്‍ ഇതിനോരോന്നിനുമായിട്ട് ആളുകള്‍ വരും. അതാണിതിന്‍റെ പരമ്പര. അത് കല്യാണംകഴിഞ്ഞ് ഇവിടെ ഇപ്പോള്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാത്ത ഒരു കാര്യം നടക്കുന്നു. കല്യാണംകഴിഞ്ഞാല്‍ അവരെ വീട്ടിലയക്കാതെ - ചിലര്‍ ഏഴു ദിവസം നില്‍ക്കും; ചിലര്‍ ഒരു മാസമൊക്കെ നിന്നവരുണ്ട്. അതെങ്ങനെയോ ആകട്ടെ. അവരെ ഒരു സങ്കല്‍പത്തിനിരുത്തുമ്പോള്‍ അവരുടെ ആരാധനാമൂര്‍ത്തിയും അവര്‍ വിശ്വസിച്ചുപോന്ന കാര്യങ്ങളും അവര്‍തന്നെ കാണുകയാണ്. അതുമുതല്‍ അവര്‍ക്കൊരു നേട്ടം ഉണ്ടാവുകയാണ്. ആ നേട്ടം അവരുടെ ഈ ഉല്‍പത്തി കര്‍മഗതിയില്‍ വന്നെത്തുകയാണ്. അത് നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളായിട്ട് തിരിച്ചുവരികയാണ്. ഇതാണിതിന്‍റെ വിഷയം. അത് അധികം പേര്‍ക്കും മനസ്സിലാക്കാനും കഴിയില്ല. ഇത് നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളില്‍ത്തന്നെ വരണമെന്നാണു ദൈവനിശ്ചയം. അല്ലാതെ അത് ഞാനല്ല ചെയ്യേണ്ടത്. അപ്പോള്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ യോഗ്യമായി പെരുമാറി ഇത് എടുക്കണം. അത് ദൈവമായിട്ട് കാണിച്ചു തന്ന ഒരു വഴിയാണ്. ഈ വഴി സൂക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടുന്നതിനു വേണ്ടി നിങ്ങള്‍ പലതും അംഗീകരിക്കേണ്ടി വരും.

എന്താണ് നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതക്രമം? ഒന്ന്, അതില്‍ വരാവുന്ന കേടും നല്ലതുമായിട്ട് തിരിച്ചു വച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന തൊഴിലവസരങ്ങള്‍. ഇതെങ്ങനെ വേണം, എങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു നിങ്ങള്‍ എടുക്കണം? അതുപോലെ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം, എത്ര കാലം മുന്‍പോട്ടു പോകുമെന്ന് തീര്‍ച്ചപ്പെടുത്താന്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കു കഴിയില്ല. അങ്ങനെ ഒരവസ്ഥ ഇതിനുണ്ട്. ഇത് കാലം മാറിയിരിക്കുകയാണ്. ഇപ്പോള്‍ ഈ ജാതി ഒരു കര്‍മം കൊണ്ടുവരാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. വിദ്യാഭ്യാസത്തിനും അതനുസരിച്ചുള്ള തൊഴില്‍വകുപ്പിനും മാറ്റം വരും. അതു പത്തുമുന്നൂറു കൊല്ലത്തിനകം ആയിരിക്കും വരുന്നത്. നമുക്കിന്നു കാണാന്‍ കഴിയുന്ന രീതിയല്ല. അപ്പോള്‍ അതുതന്നെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളിലൂടെ വരാതെ ഇത് നടക്കുകയില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ടാണ്, ഗൃഹസ്ഥാശ്രമി സന്യസിക്കാനല്ല, സന്യാസത്തിന്‍റെ വിവിധവശങ്ങള്‍ ഒഴുക്കിവിടുന്നത് അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ കരുതി നടപ്പിലാക്കി പ്രവര്‍ത്തിപ്പിച്ചുവിടുന്നത് അത് ഗൃഹസ്ഥാശ്രമിയാണ്. ആ ഗൃഹസ്ഥാശ്രമം നിങ്ങളിലിരിക്കുകയാണ്. അങ്ങനെയുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളെക്കൊണ്ട് ലോകത്തിന്‍റെ സഞ്ചാരവിധി എങ്ങനെയെന്നു കാണിച്ചു കൊടുക്കുകയാണ്. അല്ലാതെ ഇത് കണ്‍കെട്ടുവേലയും സിദ്ധിവിശേഷവും - അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ഒരനുഗ്രഹനിഗ്രഹസ്വഭാവവും ഇതൊന്നും - ഇതിലില്ല. അത് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് കഴിയും, ആ അനുഗ്രഹവും നിഗ്രഹവും എന്തെന്ന് അറിയാന്‍. അതിന് ഒരു തെളിവ് നിങ്ങളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തില്‍തന്നെ ഗൃഹസ്ഥാശ്രമികളായ ആണും പെണ്ണും ഈ ത്രിമൂര്‍ത്തിപദവിവരെയുള്ള ഋഷീശ്വരന്‍മാരെയും ത്യാഗികളെയും സന്യാസിമാരെയും ദേവന്‍മാരെയും കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ള ആളുകള്‍ ഇതിനകത്ത് ഇപ്പോള്‍ ഇരിക്കുന്ന കൂട്ടത്തിലുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ അതിനു മുകളിലേക്ക് പോകണമെങ്കില്‍ വേറെ രീതിയാണ്. അതു നിങ്ങള്‍ മനസ്സിലാക്കി അത് ചെയ്തെടുക്കാന്‍ ഈ കര്‍മം കൊണ്ടേ നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കു കഴിയൂ. ഈ ധര്‍മം നടപ്പിലാക്കാന്‍ നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളെക്കൊണ്ട് എന്നെന്നേക്കുമായി വേലചെയ്യിപ്പിക്കേണ്ട ഒരു സത്യത്തിന്‍റെ വാതില്‍തുറക്കലാണ് ഈ പറഞ്ഞ ഗൃഹസ്ഥാശ്രമസമ്പ്രദായം. അല്ലാതെ സന്യാസിയില്‍ക്കൂടി ഇത് വന്നുകൂടാ. സന്യാസിയല്ല വരുത്തേണ്ടത്. അങ്ങനെയുള്ള സന്യാസത്തിന്‍റെ സകലവശങ്ങളും കുറെ ആളുകള്‍ അഭിനയിച്ചുകാണിച്ച് ഇത്രയും കാലമൊക്കെ ചെയ്തു. പക്ഷേ അതൊന്നും സന്യാസത്തിന്‍റെ പരമ്പരയല്ല. ഇതൊക്കെ നിങ്ങള്‍ വിചാരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. നിങ്ങള്‍ പറഞ്ഞുപറഞ്ഞ് ഈശ്വരസാക്ഷാത്കാരം കിട്ടിയവന് വെള്ളംവരെ വേണ്ട, ഉണക്കയിലയും വേണ്ടാത്ത ആളുകളാണെന്ന് നിങ്ങളെ പറഞ്ഞു ധരിപ്പിച്ച ഒരറിവുകേട് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കു വന്നിട്ടുണ്ട്. അതൊക്കെ തെറ്റും തെറ്റിന്‍റെ പുറത്ത് തെറ്റും ആണ്. ഈ വെള്ളം വേണ്ടാതിരിക്കാന്‍ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്ന കര്‍മം എന്ത് ദുഷ്ടത്തരമാണെന്നു പോലും നമുക്ക് ****************** കഴിയില്ല. ഇത് തുളസിയിലയില്‍ തുടങ്ങി കാഞ്ഞിരത്തിലയില്‍വരെ എത്തി. അതുപോലെ കയ്പുള്ള സകല മൂല്യങ്ങളുമെത്തി വീണ്ടും അതിന്‍റെ കായ്വര്‍ഗങ്ങളും എടുത്ത് അത് ശുദ്ധിയാക്കി അത് കഴിച്ച് അങ്ങനെ പിന്നെ സിദ്ധമരുന്നുണ്ടാക്കി കഴിച്ച് അത് കഴിഞ്ഞ് ഒന്‍പത് മുഖമുള്ള ഒരു ഗുഹ തീര്‍ത്ത് അതിനകത്ത്. അപ്പോള്‍ ഈ ആളിനെ മാറ്റി - അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങോട്ടും മാറ്റി - എടുത്തു വയ്ക്കണം എന്നാണ്. എണീറ്റു മാറാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. എല്ലൊക്കെ പഞ്ഞിപോലെ ആയിപ്പോകും. അപ്പോള്‍ പൊങ്ങാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ട് അയാളെ എടുത്ത് മാറ്റിവയ്ക്കുകയാണ്. അങ്ങനെ ഒന്‍പത് മുഖങ്ങളുള്ള ഗുഹ രാവും പകലുമായിട്ട് മാറ്റിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുകയാണ്. ഇങ്ങനെ വളര്‍ന്നെത്തുന്ന ഒരു വ്യക്തിയുടേതാണീ സിദ്ധാന്തം പറയുന്നത്. എന്താണ്? യോഗവിദ്യ, അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ഇങ്ങനെ പലവിധത്തിലുള്ള കൈയടക്കവേല - ഇതൊക്കെയാണ്. ഇത് സന്യാസമാണെന്ന് നിങ്ങള്‍ തെറ്റിദ്ധരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. സന്യാസമേ അല്ല ഇതെല്ലാം. സന്യസിച്ചുള്ള കര്‍മമൊന്നും അല്ല. അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങള്‍ ധരിക്കുന്നെങ്കില്‍ അബദ്ധമാണ്. ഇന്നുവരെ ഈ അത്ഭുതം കാണിക്കുന്ന സ്വാമിമാരെയും നോക്കിയാണ് നമ്മളോരോരുത്തരുടെയും ഇരിപ്പ്. അത് കാണിച്ചു കൂടാത്തതാണ്. സത്യമായിട്ട് പോകുക, വരേണ്ടത് വരട്ടെ. വരാത്തത് വരണ്ട.

ഈ ഒരു കര്‍മത്തില്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ ഉറച്ച് നിങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളില്‍ക്കൂടി നിങ്ങളുടെ തലമുറകളില്‍ക്കൂടി ലോകത്തിനു ദാനം ചെയ്യാനുള്ള ഒരു വലിയ കര്‍മസിദ്ധി നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കായിട്ട് ദൈവം ദാനം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു. ഇത് നിങ്ങള്‍ ചെയ്തെടുത്തോണം. ഇതിനുവേണ്ടി നിങ്ങള്‍ ഏതെല്ലാം തരത്തില്‍ സംഘടിച്ച് ഈ നാടുകളില്‍ അവനവന്‍റെ ബുദ്ധിയും അവനവന്‍റെ അധികം പറഞ്ഞു പിടിച്ച തോന്ന്യാസങ്ങളും ശരിയാണെന്നു കരുതിയിട്ട് അതിനെ പുലമ്പി നടക്കുന്നവരുണ്ട്. അതൊന്നും ഈ പരമ്പരയ്ക്കോ ഈ വരാന്‍പോകുന്ന നന്മയ്ക്കോ ഒരിക്കലും ശരിയല്ല. ഇന്നുവരെ എന്തെല്ലാം കര്‍മദോഷങ്ങളുണ്ടോ അതെല്ലാം നമ്മള്‍ ഏറ്റെടുക്കുക എന്നുള്ളതാണ്. അപ്പോള്‍ നമ്മള്‍ അതിനിറങ്ങുമ്പോള്‍ നമുക്കു പലവിധത്തിലുള്ള സങ്കടവും വിഷമവും പ്രയാസവും സ്നേഹമില്ലായ്മയും എല്ലാം കിട്ടും. അതെല്ലാം ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ട് നമ്മള്‍ ഈ കര്‍മത്തിന്‍റെ യോദ്ധാവാണെന്നുള്ള നിലയില്‍, ഒരു പെണ്ണ് ലോകത്തിന്‍റെ മാതാവാണെന്നുള്ള നിലയില്‍, പ്രവര്‍ത്തിച്ചൊതുക്കാന്‍ സൗകര്യം തന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സത്യമായ വഴിയാണ്. ഈ കര്‍മം നിങ്ങള്‍ തെറ്റിക്കാതെ ലോകത്തിനു കൊടുക്കാന്‍ ദൈവം നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കും എനിക്കും വേണ്ടി ദാനം ചെയ്ത വകയാണ്. അതു സൂക്ഷിക്കണം.
ഗുരുവാണി
en: January 1999
Gurukula Brahmaniveditham

The ceremony performed by Brahmins lasts for nine and eleven days. This ceremony involves seating boys and girls, reading out a summary of the Puranas and epics, and explaining them both materially and spiritually. A summary of the six Shastras and the four Vedas is read over ten days (six plus four). The eleventh day is the wedding. They also perform a specific ritual during that wedding. Although not everyone does it at home now, it is still practiced in the homes of chief Tantris. In other homes, the father, mother, and closest relatives sit together, fill a large vessel with water, catch a fish, and while chanting Vedic mantras, make the bride and groom scoop it up. This symbolizes the birth of Vyasa.

However, the ignorance they imposed on the Shudra class includes Kettukalyanam and Pulikudi. This was done to prevent Shudras from attaining Brahmajnana (knowledge of Brahman). To announce that a girl has come of age, relatives and friends are invited. An ada (a type of pancake) is made using nine types of grains. The girl who has come of age is seated on a mat placed over this ada, and everyone gathers around and showers flowers on her back. This ada is then given to the Nair of the Illam. The remaining adas are cut and distributed to all relatives and friends. The name of this ada is Poriyuda. Whoever eats this Poriyuda will never attain Brahmavidya.

The ritual we have initiated to correct this misguided practice is Gurukula Brahmaniveditham. Brahmavidya is the knowledge acquired through the practices instructed by the Guru. For this, the girl must be protected as a Brahmacharini. Children worthy of Brahmajnana will be born to such a Brahmacharini after marriage. These children are called noble offspring (Salsanthanam). Such a ceremony did not exist among us before. Therefore, God has revealed this ceremony for us. It also signifies informing the parents and the community that the girl has reached the age to acquire knowledge. By following this path of instruction, one can at least reach the state of Saraswati, Parvati, or Lakshmi. Knowing at least this much, we must raise our girls and boys in a way that benefits the world. They can proceed as Brahmacharis and Brahmacharinis, as householders (Grihasthashramis), or through the stages of Brahmacharya, Kaumara, Vanaprastha, and Sannyasa. This is the knowledge we have received. This lineage in particular, and everyone else, must know this. The position these children attain is also acquired by their parents. The purity of the Gurukula Brahmaniveditham lineage, as that soul takes birth again, is intended to make this lineage universal. This is the purity of purpose behind this ritual. What they see through the vision they receive is the culmination of millions of years of sacrifice by not just gods and goddesses, but the entire lineage of prophets. This is why it is said that they should at least attain the position of Saraswati, Parvati, or Lakshmi through this vision. Even without making these sacrifices, children here who have the vision are attaining this state. This ritual is meant to bring that into our children through action. However, not all children may receive this blessing. For the lineage of children whose souls do not have this right, this ritual helps them acquire it through action. The Brahmacharis, Brahmacharinis, and householders here are proof of this.

What have the authors of the Puranas in the Vedic religious tradition done? The Puranas and epics are crafted in a way that does not equip children to distinguish between good and evil, nor does it make them worthy of the Guru's karma. Through the Guru's effort, while the Guru is present, we all receive this blessing. But what when the Guru is not there? Even while the Guru is alive, through disciples or visionary figures, all forms of karmic proficiency in the Guru-disciple relationship are attained by the disciples through the Guru's grace. This karmic proficiency in nature It keeps it dissolved. One should consider whether the right to such a great ceremony is needed while the Guru is alive. All this must be made a right in Karma, included in Dharma, and given to the world through the Guru Parampara. Moreover, the goal of this ceremony called Gurukala Brahma Niveditham is to sort out some of the flaws committed according to customs included in the Vedic religion and to complete them in the Dharma of realization.

Through this karma, we are completing the karma of Chaturvarnya to serve the complete knowledge of the Satya Yuga. For this, parents, guardians, men, and women, without distinction, make the Brahma resolution the cause of world creation, and this Guru Parampara is the foundation for it.
Guruvani
February & March - 1999

The righteous should not seek Dharma in Tantra Santhigiri's concept is not a religious karma. It is a karma that points out the mistakes that have happened among the people and corrects those mistakes to help people come forward. Correcting the mistakes of the past way of living is what should be called reform. When it is said that pointing out mistakes is reform, that statement itself becomes a mistake. One should be able to say that there is such a way out to correct the mistake. That is Dharmic karma.

Scholars should at least see it this way. Today's science has grown by taking each atom from the atomic cells and working on it, understanding through intellect that the storage of new light happens from a single atom. Scientists had also established that this atom cannot be split. Now, who split this atom? The theory that an atom cannot be split is like the completion of Advaita. There are things said based on science. The path taken by one who speaks like that is not right. What is understood from this?

There are examples of this happening in nature without a tree. What it is like is that the objective application of emotional charge should only be spoken by a truthful person who classifies and makes the life experience felt. It is regarding the matter that travels a long distance starting from the Annamaya Kosha, operated in each cell by the great effort over a long period by truthful souls who sought the source of compassion in such great men, that it has been brought and stopped in the Anandamaya Kosha. The mathematics of the language created by Gundert is done in the same way as Vedanta is included in the Amarakosha, a dictionary of synonyms beginning with 'Amara Nirjjara Deva'. Rejoicing by taking many reservoirs and calculating that all are one is a flaw in karma, just like rejoicing by stating the mathematical description in the Amarakosha. One reservoir is not like another reservoir. How can a person who does not understand that all these reservoirs are taken and flowed into the sea, and that even this sea is contained within the earth, classify and shape life?

Beyond the seventh sea, there is an Ezhilampala or Ezhinampala. This is an imagination that is added to each person's logic. Does writing like this mean that they have seen it? Similarly, rejoicing by calculating the light of experience that occurs when crossing each sky, and only when the repetitive capacity of the past three periods reaches the fourth quarter, will one see that there is nothing where the Advaita religion speaks. Why does this scientist calculate sitting in a place where there is nothing like that? Will one become wise if this is called a vision and the empty or non-empty karma residue filled with scholarship is fitted into the intellect and created? The Amarakosha and Gundert's dictionary are fitted into the intellect in this way.

The science of the soul stands beyond that - beyond intellect, beyond thought. There is no room for thought there. There is no room for the intellect to work either. Here, the scientific scholarship of creating calculations in imagination and the scientific scholarship of creating a great language among languages (Sanskrit - the refined language) are not different. Both these sciences were confined within the covering circle of the Trimurti, whose face of knowledge was lost. This is scholarship. Therefore, no one understood the aspect that needs to be worked on in the fourth period. This is the mistake that has come to lie in the Trimurti system. This has never worked in the fourth period.

The meaning of Kali, the fourth period, is manifold. It is how karma works in each cell and reaches. If the capability of the grass is seen and its description is given, it is complete. When each grass is given each medicinal quality and completed, it is complete. Then it was turned into plants. When the repetitive capacity of plants comes, it is a different completion. For example, Ramappacha. When it itself undergoes renewal by joining the two fortnights, the bright fortnight and the dark fortnight, it becomes another completion.

120 years are stated for the completion of a human's life. If a human lives for these 120 years and exercises his intellect, of his vision or Can the layers of imagination or evolution be completed? A layer means a lunar month equal to one year, a lunar month equal to 100 years, and a lunar month equal to 120 years. Just because this could be scientifically noted, is it possible to calculate and say how the special repetition of four eras, which a fool, a highly intelligent person, and a rogue with a cruel nature alike considered as truth, worked in the interplanetary division? In the state of time when a four-era cycle like Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dvapara, and Kali has passed, a great revolutionary song of a remnant of karma from salt to camphor, as our old uncles say, is resounding. Having discovered this, what can the knowledge-practice tainted by the sin of karma, which assigns the same position to truth and untruth, do?

So how will we believe anymore? Suppose we pick out all the good things and reject the bad things while classifying them as good and bad. Can one take an account of a lunar month by picking out only the good? Or if one picks out and shows the bad of a 100 years, will a person become wise? Similarly, even if one operates from the Annamaya Kosha to the Anandamaya Kosha inside the sin of karma corrupted by serving pedantry, it will not be enough. One must act. Vision is the means to act like that and bring an end. That is what is calculated up to the seventh heaven. This is a truth that resides only in a few era-men who happened across eras.

Because Sri Sankara spoke Advaita, if South Indian people who reach North India as sannyasis are asked which guru lineage they belong to, they will say Sankara lineage. If one says Sankara lineage, then there is no obstacle. One can go in anywhere. This is an over-trick used by all the Shudras in South India.

How would it be if this over-trick is put into caste? There are people who have acquired knowledge in each. In your own language, an encyclopedia. Just like a botanical garden that preserves plant diversities by writing and studying the names of plants, each movement in the name of these wise men is an encyclopedia that preserves each course of karma. Each is a system of karma where this knowledge and ignorance flow mixed together. Each will attain purity, distribute purity, and attain purity again.
If peace is attained three times like this, where will the Vedic's peace reach?

Is it enough if it is completed in this Tantric way? This is the completion of dharma caught in the Hindu's sin of karma. Other religionists who believe and do not believe in rebirth. What is the difference between the two? The seriousness of completing dharma in the Tantric way like this is only like a child playing with sand, making appam and puttu, and doing milk abhishekam, running away leaving it if given a beating. Therefore, these ignorant children In the verbal spectacle of a vision completed through play... in the linguistic ability that is established, the downfall of human beings is completed. In this action where scholarship and ignorance cross swords and perish, let not the righteous fall! It is good for all human souls to think about this.

What we see from history and vision is that no great soul has ever found a place in their homeland. All religious theorists speak about vision. But very few say that such a vision is in such heavens. Some people convince themselves of certain visions about themselves. Because we did not understand their sacrifice, we could not accept their dharma with love. Not only that, some scholarly actions show the past Treta and Dvapara yugas that create miracles or show siddhis. When it comes to the place of truth, it is maya, mahamaya, blessing. Blessing is just making people worship demonic things, bringing them into human bodies, and blessing from that demonic action.

It is our ancestors and ourselves who are comforted in this way. Will we ever be able to respect the truth? Think! When all such thoughts are put together, it will become the action and dharma of the great scholar. But that is not true dharma; nor is it action. This is just an evaluation of opportunities that have become familiar due to the antiquity of many ages. That evaluation should be extended to three periods - Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga, Kali Yuga. Since the Satya Yuga's can be changed, some ways to bring that proclamation of knowledge to realization are mentioned here and there.
None of us are included in the struggle to prove the historical truth of this and that. Other people in the world are not included either. What to do? Let us pray for the good of all of them.

What is the action called vision? Vision is the dialogue between the guru and the disciple, recognizing the different states of cause, effect, gross, and subtle. It is the correction of knowledge between the disciple and the guru. It is not a theoretical justification that destroys action by merely talking about revelation and realization. This is an error in action that keeps theory as knowledge. This is the fault of not recognizing the difference between Hindu and Sanatana and putting it into practice. This is an orphaned martial arts school where the gymnasium of the intellect works in people who believe in God. The expression 'orphaned martial arts school' (Nadhanillakkalari) is not only in Malayalam but in all languages. The visionary aspect to understand in which heavens this orphaned martial arts school is affecting must be obtained from the guru.
Our loss of values is that we did not get the realization that Ishwara, God, Brahman, and Parabrahman are all different according to the determination of God or the determination of Brahman.
Guruvani
April 1999

Many Mahatmas have come after Sree Krishna. All of them have come with the emergence of another theory. In short, Vyasa and many prophets born as world teachers, as well as the widespread scholarly clan that originated similarly, have determined this emergence. When studying the dharma theory built by Hindu dharma to confine everything within the divine form, it seems as if God himself has given a deceptive method. Krishna's birth itself is one such thing.

Before Krishna's birth, the seven children born to that mother were beaten to death. The eighth one was not found. Therefore, it was not killed. Although Poothana was brought for that purpose, she was destroyed, according to the storytellers. Looking at it that way, whether born as a king of kings, in a cowshed, or without distinction between a hut and a palace, poets have sung the karma story these Mahatmas have experienced in a decorative manner, disconnected from their lives.

If we look at the Mahatmas who came after Sree Krishna, we can see that their lives themselves have been played with. The ignorance of the scholar who presented this as a special story is not small. When looking at this on the path of Yuga Dharma, the truth has been hidden by praising all their lives in a way that time calculation cannot be brought into history. This is what is understood if we look at the long list of poetic imagination decorated in praise and blame. The first example of this is Sree Krishna's life itself.

Hiding the evidence that Sree Krishna came as a Guru, millions of stories depicting him as a god have been fabricated. Keeping the Dharma of being a Guru intact, making Krishna a god and the Gopis as Devadasis, the reality has been hidden through acquired stories without Dharma in the decorative style of great poets, leaving no place for Dharma and losing Karma. To create the story that Vyasa lived when Krishna was alive, Vyasa was specially given the name Krishna Dwaipayana.

Dwaraka sank. When Arjuna gathered everyone and left there as Krishna said, forest robbers looted everything from Arjuna. It is recorded that many were killed and Arjuna was let go. Then it is said that Vyasa said, the boons of the gods and the bow and arrows obtained from it were for you to use when the Lord was present. It's over. Now we can go to renounce the world. Everyone knows that all this is said to have happened in the place where Gujarat is situated now.

Looking from then to now, the birth of all great souls after Krishna's time has been like a hidden arrow. Because Buddha was born in a royal family, they did nothing then and kept quiet. Finally, when he became a Bodhisattva, they killed him by giving him pork. Similarly, it is said that Jyotiramalingam went with his body. Then only a lamp remained. It is said that those who wrote the story of Rama many ages ago left his body in the river. The poet's imagination is that he was taken somewhere in a chariot. The same is the story of Ramatirtha attaining Jalasamadhi.

Thus, whoever became a Shudra by birth and a Dvija by action, all of them, even mere poets, have been destroyed in this way. What is the history of Kabir Das himself? Although it was written and managed that he was a disciple of Ramadas Swami, no one knows what that hardship was for. Here too, the story has been written and defeated. What is Kabir's devotion to his guru? Even if all the trees that have grown so far and will grow in the world are made into pens, and all the oceans are made into ink, the greatness of the guru will remain - this is Kabir's devotion to his guru.

When looking at the historical presence of great souls, the stories written about them rarely, have destroyed all their experiential truths in the waterless sea (incomprehensible) by putting them in the karma dosha of the ignorant. We must also carefully understand the purpose of writing and keeping the stories of Moses, Buddha, Jesus, and the Prophet who came after Krishna. These miraculous deeds written like this have been made to be done by poor intellectuals. When talking about realization or vision, except for recording it as the light of the world, the form of light, and the flood of light, there too the gods and goddesses have been glorified.

The truth of the birth of Moses and Jesus has been covered up so that it cannot be recognized. Even the part where karma was given to tell the sacrifice of Jesus has been wrong. If there is evidence that the Prophet who came after Jesus was beaten and driven away by the people, that the mountain was set on fire, and when the fire went out, he came down and ate roasted skin - and shouted that the jinn are ruling the world - why couldn't the place of Samadhi of that great man be fully revealed? In fact, as soon as he saw the demonic power of these jinn, he sat in that cemetery itself. Once you sit in one place, you will see urination and defecation for seven or eight days. Finally, he passed away there itself. Even with all this, where was that body taken and laid to rest? Without even keeping that historical truth straight to remind us of this, they are trying to maintain love in a harsher language than Hindus today. By pouring blessedness into the life of that great man in the way of this kind of love, the seekers of sacrifice have kept it as a land of ignorance in such a way that we cannot take it or handle it mutually.
What will happen to our children who take up such karma doshas?

From Sri Krishna till today, no one has been spared. Who can cure the karma dosha that keeps them as a miracle after the time of the great souls? Isn't this the evil desire of the demonic forces that do not agree to take up the karma of the land of sacrifice?

The extraordinary and decisive dharma that shows the endless excellence of yoga and karma, divided into four as yoga, bhakti, karma, and jnana, has been attempted to be illustrated through Sri Ramakrishna and Vivekananda. What can be done about the brave defenders of dharma who cause intellectual destruction by taking up arms in the names of Sri Shankara, Chattampi Swami, and Narayana Guru, who were born in Kerala? They have left the people as complete scarecrows and pushed them into the veil of blindness. Caste, religion, and class hatred have grown in them to such an extent that even if God started forgiving, it would be impossible.

The blue sky is a colorless color that stands beyond the seven stages called jnanabhumika. The path of karma that has walked into the growth of science, which has written the theoretical lines of the nine planets in the language of scholars and laymen, is what exists today. Science should not become miserable and countless. Today's aeronautics is like this. Scientists should think whether these inventions, which can destroy the entire earth like madmen by giving all these names, are needed or not. What is to be achieved by taking the size and weight of each planet? What part of knowledge is going to emerge from it? What can be taken from it other than the path of karma that makes a goat a dog, as the old people say? What to say to these utter fools who travel in such a way that they never get consciousness in life, dress up in silk, leave the language called the crest jewel of scholars, and maintain a culture by dressing up as neither man nor woman, serving karma that burns with intellect! We have nothing to do with this baseless story that cultivates such a sense of humor. We also know that this is the failure of our daily life. Don't we need at least a good imagination?

Will the stage of karma come if the karma to be realized through life is lost by singing, talking, and writing? Is there anything else in this beyond the intellect that obeys or makes one obey by law? Aren't all these seen the playhouses of good and evil that bring God's words into the intellect by singing? Who doesn't know that all this is growing and spoiling the human masses who do not know how to behave knowing that it has come due to the mistake of the yugadharma.

Who doesn't know that only what the court creates by telling the truth in the name of God will happen? What has the legacy of ignorant creators who try to choose good and evil through people like Mugalalyam and Brigadier made us, the human figures who have created so much misery, as warmongers? Dharma has been presented by making us believe that this is the rule of the world. I ask you again, what else is there to say whether the burden of sin that came due to the mistake of the yugadharma is to test the ability of each person? What is that? Know it truly, think.
Guruvani
May 1999
God does not insist that He should be worshipped; if you must worship, do not distort it.
Only one who has can give; only one who knows can make known.

Why does society in general worship God today? Why do they go to places of worship and ashrams? For very trivial, immediate material gains. It ends with breaking coconuts and lighting lamps. The return journey is worse than the going.
Small gods for small castes. Big gods for big castes. We have been behaving so far by standing behind this system that has been passed down.
The fulfillment of monotheism is necessary in Kali Yuga. Because Kali is eligible for liberation. And the Shudra for Brahmajnana.
It is better to internalize sacrifice than to propagate it.
Rather than accumulating wealth for children, it is better to raise them to be capable of working.
For us living in this world, a 'one' is necessary to stand together. Confining oneself to that one, pervade everything. That one which pervades everything is the truth.
Only a visionary who knows the three times (past, present, and future) can save you.
The Guru works to bring about transformation in society during a specific period.
For those who believe and act upon the words of the Guru, it is experienced as truth and God. The concept of God is realized through the Guru.
Guruvani
June 1999

'The space is self-luminous' - One should see the Guru in that self-luminosity. From there, one can see how vast the possibilities of that Guru are. This is the principle of the soul. Vedantins, researchers, and psychologists have nothing to do here. How many theories are there? How many postgraduate disciplines and research departments? But the one who took pride in being a theorist went his own way, and the poor man ended up nowhere. The tradition is now reaping the fruits of such actions. It has to be experienced. There is no point in blaming God for it. If the fruits of karma are to be taken back, there must be a way, a path that everyone can take together.

Great souls like Jesus and the Prophet have done their karma for humanity across various eras, sacrificed themselves, and shown us the way. Those who are eager to reap its benefits are trying to see their doctrines in many different ways. This is the aftermath of a betrayal. Do you want to be saved from this betrayal or not? What path have you chosen for that? If any path is enough, isn't it enough to become a Christian or a Muslim - isn't it the path of the Prophet?

What is needed is a dharma that aligns with the karma. That dharma must be sought, found, knocked upon, and opened. That is, one must seek and find a visionary who is capable of predicting what will happen until today and believe his word. Even if anyone says their word is wrong, it is not wrong. Their word is the will of God. The will of God must be respected. Grounded in that belief, one must investigate the special provisions of karma capable of sustaining the dharma of the times. By bringing the aspect of knowledge into karma, this visionary guru wipes away all sinful karma after seeing the weight of sins and virtues, transforming the soul into a virtuous one to bring it from that karma to dharma. We must see and believe in such a Guru as everything. This Guru is capable of showing the entire nature to us, the owners of karma that lies absorbed in nature. Through the glory of creation and that glory itself, this Guru will show us ourselves. The Guru will show that the Guru is present in all glories. But he is none of these. If one examines all that is said to be 'I', the inside is not many, but becomes one.

When one comes to believe that this Guru is everything, seeing its point of origin, one sees creation and preservation. Then, this seen object is neither this nor that, nor is it the meaning of what is seen. Becoming courageous with the clarity of real meaning, it settles softly, softly. To reach this state of settling, who should the Guru you hold on to be?

It is not easy to get such a Guru. Even if found, he will not open. To open, one must know how to knock. When one becomes courageous and settles softly upon realizing the true meaning, they have seen through the states of waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and Turiya. But these states exist in Turiya and Turiyatita. To show who stands in that state, what state must the Guru have reached? He must be someone who has gone beyond Turiya and Turiyatita. This state is what is meant when it is said that after crossing six steps and reaching there, Shiva can be seen. We could then see what Shiva was, what Shiva's karma was, what our possibilities in that karma are, and what we are going to become. We have only just begun to see it. It is later that the value of Shiva must be found. Thus we were brought here. There, the space devoid of name and form is self-luminous.

The Guru is showing what the soul principle is. If you believe, you can find it. If you knock, it can be opened. By believing, finding, and knocking to open, all the deities of creation, preservation, and destruction have been seen. Only later is the luminous goal, which is the primordial form of all this, understood.

The intellect of discernment will arise like ten million suns rising - this is what is said here. How can you take this? We have a difficulty in this. Because we ended up believing in all these ways. Our ancestors also lived this way. We have received this birth as a remnant of the karma done by our ancestors; and also due to the fortune of our soul. This fortune of the soul must be enlarged. Liberation must be given to the ancestors. We must take up the right of our karma and become a soul-form that shows what virtue is through dharma. Thus, one must reach a position of experience and karma worthy of making a man a Deva, a sage, an ascetic, and a liberated wise man.

What is experiential worthiness? How far is it? All past karmas must be integrated and brought forth with a new attitude. To say it a bit more subtly, it is not that we bring it, but God makes us do it. Everything happens according to time.

From a grain of sand to whatever things are created and destroyed in this world, everything has its own wholeness. It is with the support of these wholenesses that this world itself exists. Looking at it this way, it is clear that even wholeness cannot exist without the support of another wholeness. Humans, without knowing the mutual support of wholenesses, support here and there, seeing greatness in each thing like a frog in a well. While living in this world understanding this, a 'One' becomes necessary to stand firm on. The truth is that if one acts firmly rooted in that One, the action will be in everything. Otherwise, the action will become so empty that it won't even feel like an action was done.
If you stretch your gaze into this atmosphere, you can see how many atoms are flashing and fading within the span of a coin. It is enough to think that we are just one among such countless atoms.

Nothing is non-existent. If thought to be non-existent, it will lead to emptiness. All atoms have mutual access. It must be understood that this penetrating nature will reach everywhere like gas. Isn't the nature of the mind also like this? Whatever our desire is, the mind will enter into all those desires like a gas. Whether good or bad, the mind will enter that way. Some ascetics are examples of this. Through certain worship-like behaviors, they will believe and worship goddesses and gods as God. It will become a worship according to their desire. Among many such people, some will feel like showing off their prowess in it. Then the desire to apply supernatural powers (siddhis) will arise. This siddhi will be to attract people or to achieve selfish things. Whatever it is, the desire itself is the goal. One person's desire may also cause immediate harm to many.

Since the time of creation, the world has stood as a mixture of good and bad. Thus, we, who are a mixture of good and bad, and many others like us, must think and know what this world is before performing miracles upon miracles. Otherwise, to undo the destruction caused by these miracles, one will have to constantly strive by performing more miracles. Thus, the efforts of both these groups became empty. One created, the other destroyed. No one gained anything either. This is how the so-called ascetic strives and fails. None of them did this with the desire to be bad. They slipped in their actions.

If we do not have the innate nature to act aiming at the will of God with our minds set on the worship of God, this flaw will unknowingly take hold of us. Such flaws come to us who act in numerous external and internal matters.

To regain the merit in karma, an era-appropriate guidance is absolutely essential. In the Kali Yuga, guidance must be given by weighing its intensity and measure. For this, there must be a clear understanding of what Kali is. The notion about Kali that people and everything else are possessed by Kali, and that it is a time when humans are ruined, unable to do good, is incorrect. We ourselves say that we have arrived on this earth according to the fruits of our past karma. If so, a little result of what was done in Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga will also come in this Kali. If it comes, shouldn't the good done then also come? That is, when acting in the fourth era evaluating the good and bad of the past eras, it is an absorption that reaches a liberated state that is neither good nor bad through the results of actions where the weight of sins and virtues has been balanced. There is no time like Kali where any thing can be brought forward if one works hard. That is why our ancestors, the sages, desired to be born in the Kali Yuga to attain liberation.

Evaluating and knowing all the things that have come till today, rectifying their flaws, systematizing them according to the times, giving a form to the coming state, and striving to bring it forward is what is happening at Santhigiri. This is the knowledge given to us as Brahman.

When systematized in an ashram nature, some differences arose from the ashram nature that has existed till today. The traditional practice of completely following the path shown by the predecessors is what is regularized here. God has entrusted us to systematize the worship methods of Vaishnavism, Shaivism, and Shaktism according to Hindu logic. This is an effort to bring a 'One' in place of all three. That is how much distance there is in the experiential worthiness of this ashram. No one else has anything to do in this.
Guruvani
July 1999

Santhigiri's is the knowledge guided by God. That knowledge received here in nineteen seventy-three - a voice from the sky, a word from the light - a message from a form - behind this message is the desire that the children of the world should find peace and tranquility behind it and be able to live so. This is informed by following the word of God.

As part of God's mercy, a lotus with two thousand four hundred and forty-four petals was shown to the disciple in a vision. Then all these petals fell off. It was only informed then that all these are those who are to arrive. Its meaning was understood through a message received several years later. These two thousand four hundred and forty-four are past gurus. All these gurus will be born in this lineage. Along with these gurus, crores of their lineage are also to be born. They all have to be born before this Kali Yuga ends. Those who work for their birth hold the position of those gurus. And then liberation. Another special provision is that the entire clan of those who create the lineage that straightaway carries this ideology will be purified. How many births will you have to take to complete this karma?

Let me describe an illustrative vision received here. What we have seen in the world so far is nothing. There is much to be seen on a much larger scale than what has been seen. There is much to reach. It will come. A notification for that has been received. The primary lineage of this is the Santhigiri lineage.

A stream of light is striking the earth in one or two places in Kerala. This stream of light, which guides the thinkers and religious philosophers here to the right path, is illuminating Kerala in a pattern of four, forty, four hundred. In four years, scientists will ascertain that this light exists. In forty years, it will be ascertained that this light is true and how it should be utilized. In four hundred years, the value of the theory of this light will be convinced. The language of Kerala and the dharma of India will have to be practiced by the whole world.

People have started saying that what exists today is not enough. The people who discover this light will make public what this inadequate thing is. Along with that, a capability for karma will erupt from here so that the world understands what Santhigiri's mission is. With devotion, love, and respect mixed in, this movement, those who love this movement, and those who love this world must possess a special intelligence to be humbly accepted and sacrificed with courage in action. Understanding this and acting upon it, writers or people described as scholars, litterateurs, and ascetics and celibates who can explain the glorious deeds of visionaries must come forward. All of them have the right to absolute fulfillment. Because, the third generation of the householder - male and female - who consider the perfection of this knowledge as their life's discipline, goal, and mission by paying the full price, will be the ones who wield true efficiency in karma in any part of the world. They will be the perfect prophets of this mission, which is God's will. I say truly that every child who acts courageously for this will be praised as holy souls who impart the purity of karma essential for the eternal salvation of the world.

God has given us the opportunity to retrieve the lost parts of the world. If it is not done properly, it will be lost again. Those parts must be grown as a support and shade for God's will. If not grown that way, or if an attempt is made to grow it by holding onto worldly justice, God will not give it again. One person must do the work of a thousand people. We have that much more work to do. Acting for one year like this will yield the result of acting for a thousand years. The thoughts and actions of you poor people will become research materials in universities within fifty years. For that, your humility and eligibility must rise to that extent. The gain from life in this ashram is very great. For that gain to happen, one must live forgetting caste and religion. Even if your beauty is destroyed, wealth is lost, or illness comes, life will not be destroyed. It is enough to be brave. If there is bravery, there is a blessed life. The life that comes like that is the greatest.

This is not the age of Devas. Making Devas appear is not going to achieve anything either. What takes many births to achieve can be achieved in one birth in Kali. Kali is the time that came as a correction in the Rishi tradition. Kali is the time of the Shudra. The Shudra exists in all Varnas and in all times. That correction must come from the Shudra himself. For the correction in the Rishi tradition to come from the Shudra, who must he become? He must become a Rishi, a wise man, and attain liberation. He must become above all worshiped figures.

This eligibility must come to receive the knowledge according to the will of Brahma that there has been an error in the dharma over time. Through states called disembodied voices and direct manifestations, a path of resolving karma is happening at Santhigiri, which is capable of resolving the sorrows of my twenty-nine years of life, and at the same time enabling all beings in the world to act and be made to act benevolently. The Guru path advised at Santhigiri is the greatest path of resolution that makes every human being practice the sections of dharma spanning from atoms to the absolute in the universes, bringing into them a life of dharma that removes sorrow, brings virtue through karma, and carefully guards dharma as the foundation through a life obedient to the will of Brahma. It theorizes solar system evolutions and is able not only to preserve them as theirs in karma, but it has become fully capable of bringing complete gain to the lineage.

The Guru is appointed by the will of Brahma in accordance with the Yuga Dharma. Prophets who come for different time spans like two thousand, three thousand, five thousand years come under this Guru. The Guru is the visionary who foresees and commands what a Yuga needs and doesn't need. Only rarely in the solar system is a Guru born with the worthiness to witness such karmas. That Guru will have no aberrations. He is with the lowliest, he is with the highest, and he will not hate the rogue. Since diversity came from oneness, nothing is forbidden to such a Guru.

An authoritative step for eternal survival throughout the world is being implemented through this ideology. Where Narayana Guru, Buddha, and Krishna left off, that is where our beginning is. We have been gifted by Brahma with a great capacity for action to function for the entire period of the Yuga Dharma as willed by Brahma, much more than what others have shown.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
The Globally Radiant Path of Dharma

Having known the good and bad through the birth we have received, we are reaching the historical truth of the long periods in which we have been born and raised under the dharmas of Kali Yuga. In this journey across lives, we have also passed by great souls who had visions for the times. But we are unable to retrieve it. Ours is a soul whose operational capacity has been lost in that way. Therefore, ours is a lifestyle of moving forward feeling happy with what is received. There is no point in living like a trapped wolf, employing our body, mind, and intellect without being able to overcome this fate.

Kali is a time where even days, hours, and minutes are conducive to acting with awareness of the soul's operational capacity with the help of the body, which experiences waking, dreaming, and deep sleep states. It is also a time of connecting past lives, current, and future lives. If one attains firmness in present karma and achieves the elevation of dharma, this connection cannot be made. That is, if one gets trapped in contemporary theories that have gone astray, it will not be possible to move forward.

There are many obstacles before us for this. One of them is Shaktism, Shaivism, and Vaishnavism. It may be due to the fortune of some past life that we got human birth. Thus we have had many human births before this. Unable to break away from tradition, such a person acts in various ways and loses his own fortune. As an example, for over five thousand years, great souls have come in many states and many forms of effort, yet where the Trimurti tradition has reached, the soul is spinning from there without finding a way to salvation.

According to our belief system, the goddesses and gods we have been worshiping as deities are our God. Its succession rights belong to severe karmas ranging from ghosts to the city of vampires (Vethalanagaram). This is the biggest mistake we have inherited from our past tradition. We have not been able to realize that this is a mistake. How can we, who have degenerated to the level of having a separate god for each small caste, understand this? But we can understand. We can understand what the long historical truth of the past is by placing the soul in a suitable manner within the body, which is our accumulated karma. The status of a soul is to perceive the Yuga Dharma that has been spoken, sung, and taught about various things. Even a person who stood behind rationalism and worked firmly to acquire emptiness can qualify for this status by knowing certain things.

When a god or goddess is worshiped and made to manifest, another will follow it. Thus, a halo of fortune of thousands of visions will come to us. To achieve this, we need a great soul capable of explaining these visions according to the times. Through that person, one must know what aspects of visions are, understand even demonic natures, and understand the part called the city of vampires before moving forward. However, we have a long history behind us of being satisfied with the gains from these ghosts, spirits, and demons, offering vows and gifts. The knowledge of our ancestors is also the same. Therefore, no one has the virtue to reclaim and act upon the dharma of the times. There is no karma that goes up to its theories. What can change this, how can it be changed - this is the subject we must think about.

As far as we are concerned, when we move forward past the city of vampires, no matter who shows the path that reaches the karma of a Deva, the karma of a prophet, or the karma of a visionary in whichever way, an unmanageable demonic karma resides in everyone. If you look at anyone, you can see them moving forward with a kind of senseless life. We also have traditions in many forms that are unable to experience, respect, and absorb the glory and love of the Supreme Being. Without thinking about this destruction of karma, we have inherited a course of life where we cannot act upon the dharma of the times despite seeing, hearing, and knowing about it from somewhere.

Then what is the course of life suitable for us? We must be told a traditional foundation that is lived out according to the times by conscious actions in the Turiya state, after showing visions in the waking, dreaming, and deep sleep states. This is the world-class karmic dharma. For that, one must be able to completely see (in vision) all past Kali Yugas and all Chaturyugas. One must be able to discern the truths and untruths in it. We need the foundation of knowledge brought to completion by five Gurus who reached the states of gurus across time. We, every child in all religious doctrines of the world, must get this familiarity. What is intended here is to harmoniously see the operational capacity of the past Chaturyugas and the specifics of the present and future truths of dharma. Then, we arrive at a path of knowledge where we directly see and hear what the mistakes of past times were.

What is referred to as states is about the part that perfects Shaktism, Shaivism, and Vaishnavism. The ancestral acharyas have not been able to reach a state perfected in that way. This is also the extent of the meaning of the word 'Kala Dharma' (Dharma of the times). When looking back at the dharmas of acharyas, we can see that some great souls have practiced certain true dharmas suitable for the times. What is intended by Kala Dharma is the timely dharma that shapes their supreme love and the tri-temporal (past, present, future) natures they saw, knew, spoke, and struggled to attain. However, since we have traditionally followed a life that is out of tune with the times and lacks regularity, this timely dharma is like a reflection in the water for us.

Knowledge is said to be like an ocean. Knowledge that reached capacity in which era? Now, by justifying and observing this, can a wise man whose soul is in distress be given guidance that integrates the four eras, acquiring the total meaning of life, seeing various wholes like the attainment of the other world, heaven, hell, or the universe, to complete it? This is a part that must be seen, known, shown, and completed. For that, a globally radiant path of truth must shine before us, showing who we each are through our past lives of mind, word, and deed. Through that, there should be a karma where the knowledge of the past and present is given correctively in parts known as vision, disembodied voice, or light. Only a visionary can give that.

Now, who is a visionary? Is it someone who completes by singing, speaking, and writing about three periods in the Chaturyugas - presenting long lists from Puranas and epics? No. Long-term vision is the knowledge of a consciousness that stands in wisdom, devoid of birth, having seen and known the history of creation, preservation, and destruction from a grain of sand to all forms of characteristics.

Vision is long-term vision. Seven thousand four hundred and forty-four visions is one state. Thus, when reaching a state in the nature of a visionary by seeing visions, through the person with that knowledge, determining its density--knowing how and where our mind and ideology stand in the subject we have seen, known, heard, and taken, we must start as 'one' from there.

Narayana Guru has said in one place, "A man who crosses the boundaries of the three worlds and expands needs no other work to do," and in another place, "The lamp that shines after the triputi (knower, known, knowledge) is destroyed will not fall into the hands of a deceitful ascetic." In this section, there is a subject we must be very careful about. After the entire nature of our mind's primal karma has come into us, we can only grow according to the worthiness of the person who shows and corrects what is to come next. This is why it is commanded not to go without a Guru.

What is said is this: We are seeing and knowing many things. In that, from ghosts, spirits, and demons to Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras is one state. Above that, until entering the fifth state, it is a very difficult path. These states will pass through a path that is unbearable in every way and dangerous. How to retrieve these ups and downs of the mind? The karmic capability of many Chaturyugas is passing within this state. It is these temporal differences across time that are called state differences.

It was previously mentioned that the four eras is the period that recognizes the four eras. At every level, everyone has a part called recognition--according to their own abilities. That is not what is being said here. Since it is a visionary tradition, the Guru standing in this soul-part must be someone responsible for speaking up to the light of the times. The Guru who makes the transformational phase of the soul, or the demarcation of the soul easily possible - that is the Guru standing in the soul-part.

We have a familiarity from Puranas where some water is drawn from the sea, kept in various vessels, and we are told that it is seawater and it is pure. If we want to at least somewhat understand the dynamics of the wheel of time that changes periodically, this familiarity is not enough. It is impossible for anyone with this familiarity to reclaim the temporal divisions made of devas, asuras, and demons up to this day in the Trimurti system. Because, a force of tendencies, both good and bad, which has passed through numerous births, resides in the soul unable to recognize itself. If one starts to determine this without at least seeing and knowing some of it, the doubt will not clear. If scholars who are commentators on letters think they can clear doubts and rewrite, it won't happen. The truths of past, present, and future that have been heard, seen, and known are not subject to speculation.

The result of effort over a long time has become the soul's karmic tendency, like a path of sacrifice. It is not easy to define and contain the familiarity of a soul with such a long time. Then, if fortunate, it might be possible to align this familiarity with the most appropriate and loving culture of a soul. Or, even if such a soul is found, it will take ages to understand it.

A soul with numerous operational capacities crossing over ages cannot be handled by a prophet or a scientist in their simple theories. Only a Guru can handle it. Even among Gurus, only a Guru across time can do it.

The truths of Yuga Dharma are stated variously as Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali. Some historical skills will define and contain all that. When living caught up in the tendencies of the soul through life, determining what the light of each dharma is, and what its light is when that dharma reaches the state of the Trimurtis, is called historical skill. As eras pass one by one and new ones follow, it is impossible for anyone other than a Guru across time to define and contain the soul's operational capacity according to its tendencies.

What about the knowledge of ants, cockroaches, and numerous other living beings? Vision is what defines this as a virtue. Many names and many biographies have come into the realm of knowledge. Scholars state it in their terms, and sacrificing soul-knowers state it in their terms. Those who legally practice yoga and those who do karma have their own calculations. But it is difficult for everyone to retrieve the nature of karmic differences. Because the knowledge of eras - that is, the knowledge of the Chaturyugas - is that knowledge which combines numerous things constructed over past lives. It is at some juncture of such knowledge, divided into four eras, that a scholar or a layperson makes the determination of this knowledge. That juncture is called the celestial sphere (Nabhomandalam).

Celestial spheres have nine natures. There is another nature that divides it into four. In which karma of self-knowledge called vision, and in which tendency can this nature be served to each person in different ways? The ability to impart the light of eras is the main thing here.

The diverse historical truth of nine spheres is what is utilized in a soul. It cannot be illuminated by the glory of knowledge measured by the intellect. Then who can illuminate it? Passing through thousands of open spaces called 'the space is self-luminous', passing according to the changes in times, illuminating numerous earth spheres - the Guru who determines the worthiness of the course of dharma, and the disciple in whom that Guru's dharma resides. The karma that makes even a layperson or a scholar capable of asking what Kala Dharma is by convincing them of the epochal differences of Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali - this is the compassion of the special path of dharma prepared jointly by this Guru and disciple.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition September 1999
The Tapas Practice Entitled to the Yuga Dharma

There was a state when I tried to think about how my past life was. Crores of souls who took human form and reached the state of the Trimurtis stand in the subtle realm. All are form-concepts created by humans. That is, a conceptual form belonging to the artistic sense of an artist who draws outlines. The subtle realm is a procession of crores of conceptual forms that humans have imagined in this way. Rahu and Ketu are formed by the gathering of the light of such conceptual forms. This even covers the sun and the moon. That is how an eclipse occurs. During an eclipse, the rays of the sun hit the moon, and its dust particles falling on the earth are considered poisonous potencies. This is shown to ascetics. They will purify these toxic substances (mercury, sulfur, vermilion, etc.) found from the earth and keep them in their bodies. The practice of alchemy (Rasavada) is purifying and applying the most poisonous of these. Scientists say that even gold can be made from this. This is what is depicted as a peacock, the vehicle of Subramanya. It shines because it has more copper in it. The treatment method of applying peacock oil arose by applying intellect in this. An application of even greater intellect is the Kayakalpa treatment performed by ascetics. If Kayakalpa treatment is done, then food and water are not needed. The eight siddhis and Samadhi by bursting the head are all parts of this.

When an ascetic who has performed Kalpa Seva is made to meditate sitting in a cave with eight faces, changing positions according to zodiacs and stars, the bones in the body will become like cotton, making him unable to stand or walk. Siddha medicine is a treatment system completed by consuming the Navapashanas (nine poisons) in various ways along with Guru Kalpa. The things done by creating caves with seven and nine faces and keeping the body at each cave entrance at every watch (Yama) are part of this treatment. It takes eighteen and a half years to complete this Kalpa Seva system by taking this body and placing it in all nine cave entrances as watches change and turn. The Puranas and Vedic sciences are descriptions of what was completed in this way. The six-faced Subramanya is the one who carried the Kalpa Seva as six sciences. His vehicle is the peacock. It is poison. Subramanya's body had the strength to carry this much poison. The authors of the Puranas called this Subramanya 'Mayilvahanan' (He who rides the peacock).

The state of Subramanya is the power of penance acquired over numerous births. Names like Shubhramaniyan and Arumukhan came because of this. Vyasa, who devised this, was brought in, made a Vaishnava, given the name Krishnadwaipayana, and depicted. Characters like Drona, Bhishma, and Shalya are stories depicted by devising such imaginations. Shaivism, Shaktism, and Vaishnavism are also imaginations devised over various periods. What is described by differentiating this is Ravana's head. His head needs to be equal to the heads of ten Brahmins. That is, he has the intellect of ten Brahmins. That character was changed into a Brahmin, and changed into Ravana. Where he was supposed to attain ten states, he was made Ravana. He couldn't be devised into ten states, could he?

It is by keeping aside the soul that grows like this that it incarnates as a Guru. It is by assigning this meaning that it is said a Brahmin should not be questioned. This meaning of Brahminhood will come up in many places and contexts. When it comes into the imagination of a poet, Shiva's people will write praising Shiva. In Aryavarta, they will write praising Aryans. When both combine, it becomes Shakti and Shiva, and Lakshmi and Saraswati. It is by this same poetic imagination that the concept of Yaksha became Brahma. In my experience, all these conceptual forms came and I saw them. None of this shows the way. When crossing and seeing the Puranas, I had to think about the true state and the courageous actions of Ravana.

The Brahmin class only reaches up to a Deva. A Brahmin acting as a Deva, decorating like a Deva, and standing with positions as Goddess and God is the karma called 'Brahmajnaneti Brahmana'. A knower of Brahman exists in every class. A Deva will not let anyone pass into the state of wisdom. That is what chased Sri Krishna around without letting him stay in India. The Brahmin (knower of Brahman) Sri Krishna is the one who rose up after the poetic imagination—which wrote that a Deva and Devi stood changed, sent a special Putana to breastfeed Sri Krishna—broke at its root and fell. Sri Krishna has crossed the state of Deva and attained siddhi in numerous Yugas. Sri Krishna was born in such capability. All demons were invoked and all witchcraft was done to kill Sri Krishna. It should be understood that Sri Krishna crossed the Yamuna river using what was in his hand. History says Moses also showed such a siddhi.

This depiction in poetic imagination, making many great souls with knowledge of Brahman into Brahmins, became a mistake over many Yugas, and they themselves handled the aspects of Shudras and Brahmins. But knowledge is not an outline of imaginative fancy. It is a state that stands devoid of form. Passing the seventh stage, one can only describe up to the seventh stage in the eighth and ninth stages. The outlines of imagination are only up to there. After that, it is this divine power that stands merely as a concept. That is why the story of the Formless One (Arupi) was written. The story written that Duryodhana saw a mirage, lifted his dhoti, and started swimming is part of this imagination.

These variations in actions, concepts, and designs are blunders that have come over twenty-five Chaturyugas. This is the reason why Rahu and Ketu cannot be formalized and stationed. Rahu and Ketu will also come according to the rotation of the stars. Reaching the exact time, minute, and even the smallest fraction of time while revolving with the sun and moon, when these smoke screens come and cover, it was depicted like a snake. Although snakes are poisonous, not all snakes have poison. The saying that even a water snake's bite during an eclipse is poisonous is because nature is afflicted with poison during an eclipse.

When the fog formed by the gathering of the light of these conceptual forms fills up, there will be a notification here that one must pray for this much time to cross those changing states. I have passed through many such changing states. That is completion. I have prayed from morning to evening without drinking water. As a prelude to completing such a state, I have prayed continuously for up to twenty-one days.

In several iterations like seven, nine, ten, twelve, twenty-seven, repeatedly crossing stars and zodiacs, there will be a change when twelve years pass. At the time this change occurs, holding back the soul that desires to become a knower of Brahman, a Guru is a visionary born according to the will of Brahma. It is regarding this Guru that it is calculated and said that he has come and gone many times in the account of spiritual glory of five thousand or ten thousand years, and then took steps across lives as years of penance. This is the life-cause of a creator who reaches the presence of God. The intellectual activity that brings the knowledge of vision to the five senses, five sheaths, and five elements, the tamasic activity, and the ignorant activity revolving twenty-seven times is a state, the calculation of a vision called 7775. Three calculations are said for this: 7777, 7775, and 7774. When the worship in all eras from the first Treta Yuga, where this calculation went wrong, to today were wrongly written and brought into the status of Devas, the Brahma circle had to be completed by calling it Shaktism, Shaivism, and Mahamaya. But only a wise man can determine how many crores of concepts are in an action done in an epochal concept. A person incapable of claiming such an explanation for himself—one who is not born entitled to the Yuga Dharma—is the one who speaks the nonsense that an ascetic is one who lives without doing any karma. The proponent of ignorance is the one who enacts the timely dharma of such nonsense.

The wise man (Jnani) is a great soul who has traveled around the epochs on the path of knowledge of the wheel of time. It is the soul of that great soul, who ascended the wheel of time with penance, observing the Yuga Dharma without ever making a mistake, that is kept aside by the will of Brahma. This soul is what is utilized for the coming ages.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
The Extensive Meaning of a Guru's Birth

The wheel of time or Chaturyuga. How many visions when a Chaturyuga revolves? The total practice of penance of a Chaturyuga traveling around is one state. A soul that does not break the transition of a Yuga becomes the authority of a Yuga. A soul that does not break the transition of a Chaturyuga becomes the authority of a Chaturyuga.

Five Gurus will come as the authority for a Yuga. Along with them, Gurus who have completed 500, 2000, 3000, 5000, 10000 years will come. They are also called Gurus. They will write and fill in as far as they have seen and then leave. Those educated people who do not know what they wrote, or what they left out from filling, are the ones who interpret letters and state all Yuga Dharmas wrongly. They will apply logic and think in many places. Narayana Guru has also hinted at this.

Many great men have failed to revolve around the penance practice of a Yuga and acquire the state. Even people who perform karma and maintain dharma according to the proclamation of time, once they cross the states and acquire the position of Trimurti, they will stand still, unable to pass through. This is because the penance practice of the wheel of time is a karmic path where the outlines of flawed Yugas fill the atmosphere, becoming thousands of true and untrue things. The wheel of time to be evaluated is not about the wheel of time that passed five hundred or a thousand years ago, but the wheel of time that sees through the coming Yugas.

The Yuga Dharma is described as four periods—Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dwapara Yuga, and Kali Yuga. If one wants to completely know about all these four Yugas, only one who revolves and knows the wheel of time (Chaturyuga) through penance practice, whatever stages have been conceptually brought in, can do so. However, a Guru who has completed from 500 years up to a Yuga is also a Guru. There is a temporal dharma completing one Yuga and a temporal dharma completing a Chaturyuga. Through penance practice, one can cross all wheels of time. Those who fail to achieve this are the ones who practice yoga due to the quality of the soul. Such yoga practices are meant to cross the era of Gods and Goddesses. Sri Ramakrishna's emphatic statement 'Not this, not this' is exactly this. It is also this that a soul that has crossed the position of a God desires to see the Kali Yuga, or desires to be born in it. There are also souls that have requested not to be born in the Treta and Dwapara Yugas. Such followers of Yuga Dharma are specially set aside. It is a great soul who has grown in the order of the sky, broken transformation, and come according to Yuga Dharma who is born as a Guru. Such Gurus will cross conceptual forms and reach the karma of open space mentioned by Agastya. One who reaches seven hundred such open spaces is a Yuga Dharmi. This open space will explain all dharmas beneath it.

Good things do not catch on in all parts of the earth. Similarly, good water will only pool in certain places. When the sun's rays hit due to the progressive pressure of the earth and the moon's dust particles fall on the earth, what conditions those dust particles are the day and night, the new moon and full moon, and the natures of the stars. Crossing all these one by one, crossing the distances one by one through numerous formless open spaces is the soul, whose life is arranged in the concept of a Guru. It is regarding the verses of a Guru whose life has passed like this, forming and emerging, that it is said, 'Word is Truth, Truth is Guru, Guru is God.'

The Dharma of Kali waits to get the birth of a Guru who has been set aside as such a great soul. It is as the time permitted to get such a Guru that the author of the Bhagavatham said, 'Of all the times, Kali is indeed the best.' Not knowing how to improve this time, they explain and praise knowledge and ignorance, standing tied down. Narayana Guru's statement that one must cross death by knowing knowledge and ignorance is apt. Such words have been used freely in many places. Yogishwaras who authored Patanjali sutras and wise men who have turned the wheel of Raja Yoga have also used such independent words.

Raja Yoga has not been useful to many people. There are some gurus who have called the Hatha Yoga system as Raja Yoga. There are even practitioners who take the breath rhythm up to the Hamsa Padam. What is Hamsa Padam? Knowing and acting from the Chithira bird among bird species up to the vulture, and keeping it as a vehicle is the Hamsa Padam. Subramanya is a person who reached such a Hamsa Padam. Hamsa Padam exists in many colors and many picture systems. A Guru across time can make all these positions attainable.

There are those who reach the positions of Goddesses and Gods, embellish the Hamsa Padam, and speak of it. It is not such a Hamsa Padam that is targeted here. The previously mentioned vulture is also a swan (Hamsa). Garuda, the vehicle of Mahavishnu, is a pet name given to the vulture. Just like the mistake that happened in writing stories and mocking the Garuda-hanging rituals in temples, Kalashundi and Ashwatthama are also written in stories and mocked. Kathakali and Harikatha are stories buried in the verbal fanfare of storytellers who do not hesitate to write numerous miraculous stories catching hold of it. They have attributed greatness and written stories even about the dead and alive millipedes that the vulture eats. When that came into today's colloquial language, it stands spanning from the girl bitten by a snake to the bursting dawn. It is at this wheel of time that we have arrived.

The conceptual action completed by the heroism that North Indians and South Indians failed to establish, went to the stage of absurdity and sowed the seeds of destruction. Let us deduce where this started from. Stating the dharma of the Stone Age, it was inscribed on copper plates. Then it became palm-leaf manuscripts. Today, it has become paper that is torn up daily. If we agree that this is a change of state brought about by the turning wheel of time, does it mean that it claimed the virtue of the soul that holds authority over the thought of God?

In this state, the memory of Manvantaras, completed over many Chaturyugas, has been abandoned. Instead, let us not forget the truth that we peeked into distant times by renewing memories in the colorful beauty learned by competing with the mindless intellect of the poet's imagination, which started with the story of the girl bitten by a serpent and disappeared in the breaking dawn.

It is good for us to think about the falsehood in the exposition in Devi Purana that Swayambhuva Manu was born as the son of Brahma. A single Yuga within a Chaturyuga comprises millions of years. Thus, historical periods that reach up to the calculations of Manvantaras have been confined to a mere 6000, 7000, or 8000 years, terming them the Stone Age and the like, thereby creating short-sightedness in the sense of time. In this situation, how much greatness can be attributed to the concept of a Guru? Those who come for 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000 years, those who come for a Chaturyuga, and those who transcend all realms of light through penance are all the same in the eyes of this historian!
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Issue
September 1999
Kalidharma is not a useless log carried by a scholar
Disciple: In this era we are living in, where do we get the knowledge of how we should act and how we should not act?

Guru: Mankind is the remainder of a mistake that happened to the world twenty-five Chaturyugas ago. The manifestation of each human life is a remnant of a conceptual action form infused with different kinds of tendencies. The origin of a soul incapable of completing any action dwells in everyone. Before that incomplete course of action attaches to this soul, it will jump into the tendency it previously resided in and grow there. Anyone would be amazed to see that growth. Elements from wondrous old stories heard and seen all fall apart and merge together like a path of knowledge, growing as aspects of fragments completed through actions over a long time.
