Neither these people nor those who joyfully observe this know that these growing aspects are old tendencies. Similarly, classifying incomplete actions as Tamasic and Rajasic, they hack and stab each other, dancing furiously, completing the nine characteristics of the Goddess in numerous forms. The theoretical side of this inherent form deposit is Shaktheya, Shaiva, and Vaishnava. This is like mistaking thorny trees, Murukku, Manjanathi, and Acacia for strong main timbers. If someone who doesn't know about wood gets amazed by this and makes tools out of them intending for color or strength, can they be used for a long time? Likewise, without knowing anything, if one starts evaluating these sprawling theoretical trees that grow and spread suddenly, these Shaivites, Shaktheyas, and Vaishnavites will only cause frequent destruction by showing magic tricks, sleight of hand, and other systems. Among these three systems, which one is complete and which is not? Is what any of these magic-performing dancers say false? This might seem convincing to the audience and true to the followers. There are many types of people who sing, strive through birth and action, and try to reach Dharma, accepting this as a traditional path. There are also theorists to grab each part of this and speak about it. Bringing a form of Siddhi nature to each of these, and completing it with an interpretation that tears apart the letters of Amarakosha—when it is completed, no one has any doubts!

Usually our people, aren't they shining from the scholarly completeness of letter interpretations like 'Ra must change'? But if asked whether the letter is completed by the remaining words, it is not. For that, they give the outline of Shabdataravali and Siddharupas and complete it, getting trapped and degrading in the scholarly action, which can only lead to joining the Amarakosha that interpreted the meaning for the formless sound. Like shaping any object by naming it in the action of dissolving and enjoying in this scholarly action, so is the scholarly action shaped in each language. Hanging onto it and providing humor --providing mimicry in today's language-- isn't it like experiencing and realizing the humor of a joker that the scholar and the layman carry around this useless log? The rosewood log that a single person can carry cannot be a huge piece, can it. A person carrying a large Murukku log is seen by someone who cannot identify wood, and thus by many ٹ aren't we standing behind the interpretation that makes it complete in that manner?

Similarly, how can we evaluate the ignorant action classified as Karmi, Yogi, Jnani, and Bhakta? Or complete it by comparison? Aksharaslokam further explains it. Isn't the work done by the Shaktheya, Shaiva, and Vaishnava systems similar to this completion? If one enjoys completing something with thousands of examples, does it mean it has attained respectability?

Likewise, the Tantric science of conceptualizing by giving Avatarhood is also a lame excuse. Teaching ignorant children by telling them to speak the truth, whatever the poet practiced in the order of ragas, all that echoes in this atmosphere, creating sounds. Thinking whether there is anything more than this in these theories will be our source of peace.

Similarly, we must possess another knowledge. Among those classified as Yogi, Karmi, Jnani, and Bhakta, there are visionaries who come for 2000, 3000, and 5000 years. Those who follow the actions coming at the end and beginning of a Yuga are also in this group. The Gurus who follow the Yuga Dharma (they are five Gurus) also belong to this category.

A Manvantara is completed by numerous Yuga Dharmas. Thus, a completion is possible only when one crosses the long steps of the Manvantara. As mentioned earlier, can the positions compared by petty poets be equal to the positions acquired in this state of completion? If it is said metaphorically that after crossing step six, it became visible, which of these is correct: it was not seen, it was seen, or it is so close that it can be seen? If meaning is given in sound, form, and name, which one will we accept? The meaning of the word or the meaning of the action erased by giving it a form? The greatness of the run of the Karmi who builds boundaries on one side of a boundless land and runs to see the end on the other three sides, or the boundary determination stating many lands, streams, lakes, masculine and feminine genders among those who ran away? The story of the one who ran, got exhausted, and entered a dense forest, or the sight of the one who cleared the forest, stood on top of a big hill, and was satisfied seeing all four sides, or the description of the nature-absorbed one who got tired of seeing the forest's beauty and finally got tired of seeing everything? Which of these will be accepted? Among all that was seen and experienced, it will seem difficult to find out whether the decoration added to the Murukku wood is correct or the decoration added to Sandalwood, Teak, and Akil is correct. This uncertainty is the same for our country and foreign countries.

In these blind sights of exhausting runs, where will the poet who described the beauty of nature like a blind man's boundary determination, and the conceptual action that compared the colorful beauty of a mirage in the imagination of a theoretical poet's concept end up? What should we understand—the boastful talk of lame logic that tells the story of the one who claimed to have seen the ends of the sky upon seeing a mirage, or the antics of the visionary who made a boundary determination through poetic depiction similar to the sight of a mirage? Here is where we must distinguish between the one who came as a visionary for 2000, 3000, 5000 years, the one who came as a visionary of the Yuga Dharma, the one who came as a visionary of different eras, and the one who came giving conceptual forms to respective times, providing the extreme visionary state of the Manvantara. We need to know the Guru of eras who explains what an extreme visionary is, and the visionary who says how it will be in such and such Manvantaras. It is when trying to know this that it is said the leg pain of the one who ran and the one who made others run is the same.

What is the divine plan that gifted us in many ways Gurus who are among visionaries and prophets? What have all these people done for us? All this can only be told to us by a great soul who has been granted permission to know the remainder of actions, giving importance to times. What is our obligation to that divine resolution that gave the opportunity for that great soul to be born, grow, and act in this Yuga?

How have we acted here? Up to the time of Sree Krishna, who stands foremost in every way among our predecessor Gurus, and after that, during the time of the historians who wrote and completed the Trimurti Dharmas and created the four Vedas, six Shastras, and eighteen Puranas, what all have we done here? The Epics and Puranas have celebrated Gurus like Bhishma and Drona, who had acquired mastery over weapons and mantras, even using them for war through the boon-power of gods who applied magic tricks, as well as Gurus and sages who lived as predecessors to Sree Krishna. We have even been made to understand that Veda Vyasa divided these Vedas and Shastras. If even visionaries could not point out that there are pros and cons in this, where is the fault? Where was that mistake repeated from? When we highlight this, the picture of truth will become clear to us.

According to the divine resolution, there is an essence that is separated from counting and studying the days that turn the wheel of time in this globe or solar system, forming numerous streams of light and nurturing them as a foundation. This essence has been shared as Vedas, Shastras, and Epics. This essence is the core of all those special actions performed by whoever, wherever, and for however long.

Among what the great sages who wrote and taught the Vedas, Shastras, and Aranyakas drew to show the ups, downs, and valleys on the way to reaching the Trimurti state, Aranyaka is one. To this knowledge, giving the name Nanmukhan, the concept of Brahma was assigned and actions were performed. While acting thus, Subrahmanya (Arumukhan), the disciple of Bhogar, through the prowess of his knowledge, asked Brahma about the essence of Omkara and its analysis. The Trimurtis could not explain it. Then, a story in the Puranas says that he tied up all three and pinched off one head of Nanmukhan (Brahma).

The face of knowledge means the path of Brahmajnana. Pinching off the face of knowledge means removing the path of Brahmajnana. Those who say the path of Brahmajnana was removed do not actually know what was removed. This can be known and made known from the knowledge of the power of time. But this Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra together fell into the power of time, rotted into manure according to nature's movement, pointed at mountains, sought the light of times that traveled in the sky, managed to say up to the Trimurti concept, and showed another prowess. One of such managed prowess is the earlier mentioned Subrahmanya. Another is the prowess where one came as a Yaksha, threw a blade of grass, and called the gods one by one, asking, 'Can you lift this?', 'Can you burn this?', 'Can you blow this away?' The story goes that the gods, who had water, fire, and wind as their physical strength, could do nothing to the blade of grass thrown by this Yaksha. Then, one among the gods understood who the Yaksha was using his intellect. That is Devendra. Devendra said, this Yaksha who has come is none other than the actual Brahman. There is also a story that because he understood and justified it through intellectual prowess without testing, he was given the name Devendra. Saying this in various ways, artists have drawn and shown Nanmukhan in many ways. That is, by the ability of Subrahmanya, the three Trimurtis were tied up and one head of Brahma was pinched off. All this is depicted at the Palani installation site. This Subrahmanya also humiliated his Guru Bhogar once. (The story is not elaborated here). Bhogar is the one who turned semen into a bell through alchemy.

It was sung knowingly that upon crossing step six, Shiva was seen. This talks about the growth of Shiva. Vaishnavites, Shaivites, and Shaktheyas have not crossed beyond this. The history of Sree Krishna proves this further. No one has come above Sree Krishna, who was a Jnani by birth, until then. Regarding Sree Krishna, he has not prayed to anyone. The truth in my experience is also the same. Then how should we see its essence?

The nine planets speak about the spheres of the solar system. Making the nine planets into twelve zodiac signs, twenty-seven stars, adding up to the star clusters, and deciding the lord of the clusters is the calculation where things have reached today. However, they made Sree Krishna be born in eight, and his time also ended in eight.

I think giving a small hint of my experience here would be appropriate for those who think. I haven't been able to find an explanation for my experience in any of the actions written and shown up to the Brahmasutra. It is through intellectual application that many sutras are written, attempting to provide explanations. The prowess of the Trimurti system completed in the Puranas is a creation of the intellectual application of the glossary of sounds and forms.

Maharshi Aurobindo has said that Sree Krishna is not the supramental light. Aurobindo stated that Sree Krishna is the overmind that brought the supramental light to earth. Krishna ushered in the Guru state with deserving dignity. The action performed subtly by Krishna, who came as a Guru at the end of Dvapara, for the sake of Kali, was seen by Maharshi Aurobindo in a vision.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Issue
September 1999
Those who love the world must possess special intellect
Disciple: Maharshi Aurobindo has said that Sree Krishna is not the supramental light. I don't clearly understand what that is. There should be some light shed on it from the Guru's words.

Guru: When talking about that, we have to go far back and see. Manvantara, Chaturyuga; how many Chaturyugas make a Manvantara - we have stood in the unfortunate position of not knowing this clearly, and much time has passed. That was a mistake that happened through another right thing.
Disciple: What is right, and what is wrong?

Guru: Regarding the creation of the world, Yugas and Deluges take a very long time to come. After a deluge, when entering another era, a Manvantara occurs. It is said that the world changes and a deluge comes after fourteen Manvantaras. However, many events happen in between.
Disciple: Although the events occurring in between are recorded in history, it has not been understood that they are related to the changing of the world.

Guru: It wasn't understood that it is related to the changing of the world, or the deluge, because there was a flaw on the part of a Jnani's knowledge. That is, at the end of the third Chaturyuga of Vaivasvata Manu, when a sage named Sathyathranan ruled as the lord of the world, he looked back. He should be seen as an individual born and raised during the changes of Yugas and deluges. However, no matter which era one is born in, if any word or action happens that forgets the primal source, it is difficult to correct it later. Especially when looking at the causes and effects of the origin of the Sanatana religion.

The causes are stated in connection with the Saptarshis. What the concept of Saptarshis is should be revealed by a Jnani. When an occasion arrived where it was covered with stories, sung, and reached an action resembling a Kathakali performance, the birth of Sree Krishna became a necessity.

Disciple: Is the Guru suggesting that trouble arose in Sanatana Dharma due to the flaw of Sathyathranan, and Sree Krishna had to come to resolve it? If so, it has not been revealed whether Sree Krishna, who came by divine resolution, was able to complete his mission.

Guru: Even before Sree Krishna was born, there were kings in every varna. That is, the Shudra varna existed even before the beginning of Kali. Kamsa belonged to this Shudra varna. Kamsa was a Jnani, a devotee, and quite a scholar. Therefore, Kamsa had the fortune in life to become a king. But the births of Kamsa and Krishna happened before the end of Dvapara. By having Kamsa born, since he was knowledgeable, it was thought that things could be brought about step by step through him.
Disciple: Should it be considered that Kamsa came as a medium of divine resolution?

Guru: That divine resolution brought royal authority to the Shudra class over many eras before that, in a way that they would attain royal power. Regarding the division of Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra, in Satyayuga all humans are equally Brahmins. But when shifting from Satyayuga, things change according to the Yuga Dharma.

Yuga Dharma refers to Satyayuga, Tretayuga, Dvaparayuga, and Kaliyuga. In Satyayuga, all people are Brahmins. Everything happens only truthfully. Only truth works. There is no going beyond that to think or cause trouble by thinking about irrelevant things. Human action was like that in Satyayuga.
Disciple: Human action was like that in Satyayuga. Now humans have changed. What is the reason for such a change?

Guru: After Satyayuga, the time of the Brahmin—the Jnani—ended. The time of Tretayuga is a combination of Kali and Dvapara. The time of Satyayuga is a combination of Kaliyuga and Tretayuga. In the change of eras, or in the initial stage of Tretayuga, we see that humans lived up to one hundred and fifty years. It is said that humans who were forty feet tall and less than thirty feet tall were rare.

As Yuga Dharma, when the entire Tretayuga comes, an idea will not last beyond two thousand, three thousand, five thousand, or ten thousand years. Due to the passage of time, many flaws will come to those ideas. Then great souls will be born here and there. Under those great souls, things will go without mistakes to some extent. Then mistakes will occur again. Thus, there was an obscuration from the beginning of Tretayuga. Events like humanity's intellect being completely obscured might have happened.

After truth disappeared, some intelligent people, knowledgeable people, and those with special intellect performed penance, found some lights through that penance, discovered what existed in that light, and acted making it a witness, which is why India's philosophy remains an atomic science. Today is an era that talks even about the science of atoms on a fly's leg. India's administration was handled according to the guidance of spiritual figures who discovered millions of times more subtlety than that.

Disciple: Having forgotten the truth and stumbling in the darkness without seeing a path in Tretayuga, although some lights were obtained here and there, people were overall in darkness. Although ways according to divine resolution were available to escape from it, people couldn't take them. Was it because of their ignorance?

Guru: The working capacity of life in that era was also huge. Then we can see numerous intellects rising from a single human being. Similarly, if we examine every human in this world, the combined working capacity of their intellect and life has been seen in their actions. The knowledge to carefully understand and gather what those actions are doesn't happen to all humans. It happens to a few people, and through rulers, it is imparted to them according to Yuga Dharma. It is the Jnanis who advise this.
Disciple: Can we assume that because the misfortune persisted where even if a Jnani's knowledge was given on one side it couldn't be spread widely, it wasn't available extensively to the people?

Guru: The words that came from the mouths of women called Veda-vahinis were kept safe by them as Smritis and Shrutis. It is said that Vyasa came and divided that action into four. The Dharma of Satyayuga, the Dharma of Tretayuga, the Dharma of Dvaparayuga, the Dharma of Kaliyuga. But most Jnanis were unable to say what the Dharma of Kaliyuga is.
Disciple: Why was there a situation where even Jnanis couldn't?

Guru: As said before, Jnanis will come as authorities for two thousand, three thousand, five thousand, ten thousand years. If we take India itself, more than six hundred princely states were ruling. This administration was also controlled by a sage or a royal Guru. The Jnani who comes for two thousand years will give vision for two thousand years and leave. The one who comes for ten thousand years will give vision for ten thousand years and leave. The common man of that time did not have the knowledge to think about the actions in their sub-divisions. Why?
Disciple: It might be because the common people lacked the ability to think about how even if that knowledge of the Jnani was given on one side, it could become widespread.

Guru: One who lives truthfully has no action to think about anything. He is living truthfully. Therefore, love, respect, and humility do not leave him. But he doesn't have a high thinking habit. He doesn't look at its evolutionary theory. He doesn't think about the past or the future. He operates by evaluating contemporary actions and giving weight and balance to them. It is from this that a mistake happened.
Disciple: It would be good if you described why such a mistake happened.

Guru: There were periods when South Indian culture and North Indian culture were going on with much difference. In fact, Satyayuga was a period when North Indian culture and South Indian culture went together. Due to the change of Yugas, many developments occurred. What an Acharya says first during Satyayuga is not what is repeated later. Without stating the truth till the end, those who come later say something and leave. People fail to grasp it and go into darkness. People also increase in large numbers. All of them go into darkness and remain like that for a long time. Ascetics or visionaries come again. The penance of the Saptarshis is an example of that. Their concept is what is called the seven planes. That action exists. Then the Tantric specialty that formulates something and the Navagraha specialty—along with calculations like zodiac signs, matches, stars, nazhika, and vinazhika were all linked together one by one. Then a Guru came and divided these calculations and left. The stanza in the Bhagavatam, "Aneka janma sampraptha karma dharma vidahine," is proof that those who divided those calculations came at various times. That is, starting from Krishna Dwaipayana, those who came in respective times. The Gita also says that the four Vedas were divided from Vyasa's words. These Vedas were divided over many periods. It is impossible to divide this at a single time. It is asked how many Vyasas there were. Thus, these Vyasas came through the history of a long time. In all those times, they came as Gurus, Kings, and Emperors. Thus, there were many minor Gurus of different eras and many major Gurus of different eras.
Disciple: Gurus who guide for specific periods and Gurus for even longer periods come. What is the reason for this?

Guru: The reason is that every soul has accumulated karma. The Puranas say one person did penance for a thousand years. Another person did penance for twenty-five thousand years. Another person did penance for a Manvantara. Thus, it will go into the stories of visionaries. There are those who come for a period of one thousand to five thousand years. There are also those who tell things for five hundred years and leave. Moses, Jesus, and Prophet Nabi are examples of those who came for two thousand years. They came as prophets. They did not come into a traditional path. They came as those who prophesy themselves. They created something else through their own vision. Because, as time passed, due to the widespread state of the country in a way that none of this could be brought straight, when they acted by modifying and uplifting according to the language and dress they got in each country, it became varied.

In the early period of Tretayuga, many Gurus had come. By the time it was the end period, numerous Gurus came. They spoke for a thousand years in one place, two thousand years in another place, and ten thousand years in another place. People lined up under Gurus who went like this. To show that their Guru was great, kings formed royal assemblies. A time came when judgments were made in royal assemblies. If one sits at one end of ten thousand acres and looks, the other end will seem to touch the sky. The rulers of the land within such a boundary became kings known as Vanavaramban. Inside the royal assemblies of such kings, they praised and glorified their own king and Guru. Because scholars spoke in many ways within this, no one could understand what the stance of this scholarship was.

At a certain period, some women in a royal assembly had the ability to sit with closed eyes and tell the truth. That wasn't just their honesty, but the truth of the time. But the history of the vision for two thousand years, ten thousand years, and twenty-five thousand years is different, isn't it? Kings ruled taking these visions into account. Then the flaw of being unable to think and know which is right and which is wrong happened by itself.
Disciple: What is the path to resolve these flaws and go towards the ultimate truth?

Guru: I told you, the reason for this flaw is the mistake that happened in the Manvantara. Six Manvantaras went smoothly. The mistake occurred in the third Chaturyuga of the seventh Manvantara. The sage named Sathyathranan, who came at the end of the third Chaturyuga of the seventh Chaturyuga, looked back at the history behind him. What is man's effort, how is it. Coming to Manu's time continuously from the Saptarshis, he saw what the passed Manvantaras were. Merging each one into that Manvantara, seeing the necessity of that self-light, he began to think about the vital points. Everything operates under Manu and is contained in Manu. He conceptualized that Guru is Brahman.

How does the Guru become Brahman? That was not thought about. When it became 'Guru is Brahman, truth, the Yuga Dharma', the authors of the Puranas who came in each era wrote each Purana creating dualities upon dualities. No one knew to which Purana it should be attached to get its truth. Then it went to the action of 'Aham Brahmasmi'. Each one of us is Brahman. On the path of philosophical initiation, that is also good. But if each of these ignorant people becomes Brahman, what wouldn't happen here? The rulers and royal Gurus of that time did not act with the knowledge to think about this. The blunder started there.
Disciple: What is the way to overcome this blunder?

Guru: No matter in which Yuga a mistake happens, it is corrected in Kaliyuga. The divine resolution waits for eras for such a Kali. When the end of each Yuga comes, the Yuga Dharma needs to be implemented by shaping the end of the Yuga. That must be performed by an Acharya who combines the Dharma of the past Yuga and the incoming Yuga. Only five such Acharyas will be born in a Yuga. Others are those who guide for ten thousand, thousand, five hundred, such times. But they will also see some truth here and there. Everyone will assume that this is the whole matter of the world. Then the rulers and statesmen sitting at that time joined together, saying Purana, Epic, Aranyakas, Upanishads like this, writing them full, and passed away in their respective times.

Disciple: The Guru said there are Acharyas who tell ideas meant for smaller periods. However, people who cannot differentiate between the Acharya who comes to correct what has come so far and implement Dharma for future times, and those who come for smaller periods, fall into trouble. Escaping from this, how can one understand the Acharya who truly prophesies the Dharma of time?

Guru: For this, one has had to struggle mentally for two or three reasons. The periods called the scientific era seen today existed back then as well. For example, aeronautics was invented by Bharadwaja. When Bharadwaja invented it, his Guru said, this should not happen now, it is to be implemented in the coming time. If implemented now, it will cause harm. Because the disciple didn't understand it, and because he had no way to see the distance of the magnitude he invented, he went straight to Kubera's kingdom. Having completed its construction there, he returned during Rama's time and took Sita away in it. Although the Puranas say that Sita was kept very carefully without losing honesty and without compromising the dignity of womanhood, it led to the destruction of Lanka and the loss of prosperity for Kubera's kingdom.
Disciple: Although we have heard about a Prophet Nabi and a Christ, our knowledge is that many Acharyas have come in various times.

Guru: Yes, many Acharyas have come. But the names are different. How many Buddhas there were is proof of that. Thus, many Acharyas come, and a Guru of eras or a visionary will come to prepare things needed for the end of one Yuga and the beginning of the next Yuga. However, there are two or three things to say about this. In philosophical initiation, stopping in brief words without losing the scope of meaning is the words of visionaries. But if contemporaries are incapable of understanding it, there is a failure to fully see and recognize what the intelligence, capability, and action realm of vision and knowledge is for Gurus or prophets coming at the same time in many countries for a thousand years, two thousand years, ten thousand years, and a Manvantara. At the same time, every scholar and ruler of every country would call together the available eminent scholars and, like the preface of a poet's imagination, even grant visionary status to the king if necessary. We often forget numerous instances proving that there were royal sages, sage traditions, and prophet traditions that acquired sleight of hand and powers. It can also be seen that the rulers of respective times and the Gurus advising them, looking at the past, granted visionary status in that manner, gave adornment for royal rule, and even the biggest strategists and intelligent rulers tried to handle and fix this in a way that their greatness brimmed over.

If we examine history, we can see that the practice of maintaining and making others maintain an administrative wheel molded in the cast of intellect, as truth got hidden by time like this, happens among us even today. It is called Chanakya Tantra. It means the truth was covered by intellect. In this state, many situations passed by misleadingly making administrative tactics, sleight of hand, powers, and service systems seem like wisdom. We can look and see this even today. Not just in this country, but in many countries, such intellectual prowess, sleight of hand, instilling spirits through the practical application of medicinal varieties, and thereby some actions degrading the divine resolution using the selective intellect of scholars and laymen to a point where the firmness of divine resolution is forgotten, can be seen by us. For example, what is called the last prophet and the last Christ, and among Hindus, the intellectual tactics of avatars recently arrived, known with titles like Rishi, Jnani, and Hamsa, operating assertively, can be seen.

One can see everyone who believes and knows praising the aspects of numerous Gurus who operated from Sri Shankara to Sri Narayana, who lived in recent times. However, without respecting and understanding the sorrows they experienced and the life dharmas they practiced in their times, making some tricks to establish that my Guru is great, my path is right, my caste is great, my religion is great—having seen this, Kumaran Asan must have had the occasion to say 'built a fort with smritis beforehand'.

Contemporaries have tried to smuggle a heap of misleading things into the lives of all castes that have come to date. Unable to push it into their hearts, they have embraced it in life and suffered. The truth that we or our ancestors couldn't see the truth manifested by great souls by giving it its due greatness has been proven by the life of every great soul. One of those is the Prophet's retreat. Climbing hills and mountains, when that was set on fire, hiding in a cave, doing many things for survival without food or clothing, coming forward and trying to bring followers into monotheism, he cried out in pain, 'Jinn are ruling the world, alas'. Another example for that is Jesus's question, 'Father, why have you forsaken me too'. If we look closely at the lives of Sri Rama, Shankaracharya, Rama Tirtha, and Vivekananda, it proves that if the truth is spoken, there is no one to accept it. Jesus's words are an example of that: 'I have much to say. But you will not understand'. They sacrificed their spiritual penance, blessed with renunciation and compassion.

If we look at this thoroughly without exception, where did the blunder that befell us begin? Science today proves that the time to think and know where this should stop is past. If we struggle in this scientific confusion, just like getting barely ten words from reading a book, we might get a word from it. But it is good for us to remember that there are no children to use that word.

The experiences in Santhigiri might be the thirst for God that arose upon seeing all this. The history of these hardships has been narrated exactly here. Explaining this, acquiring through action, and residing in the element of virtue are what each one today should be as children. I think there is no harm in us, who intensely pursue the scientific study of foreign and worldly actions, considering Kumaran Asan's words, "Change the rules, or else those very rules will change you," as a guidance. Going a little higher, let's look at what Sri Narayana Guru said:
Neither this nor that, neither the essence nor the ego
Realizing the truth as the immortal essence, becoming courageous
Losing the attachment of 'real and unreal', as the truth-
Om, one must gently, gently merge.
A special time for achieving that attainment has come to us.
Disciple: Sree Krishna, Jesus Christ, Prophet Muhammad, isn't it that we only know of them having come?

Guru: Not just that, if you look at the depth and weight of the actions spoken by the Parayi petta panthirukulam and the eighteen Siddhars who came in between, it can be understood. The tradition where ascetics called Lingayats saying 'Sri Shankara Path' go to a place called Kailash in North India and jump into a deep gorge, and the action spoken giving the poetic concept of Jalasamadhi from Sri Rama up to Rama Tirtha, what is it?
Disciple: Despite so many great souls having come, why is it that the divine resolution cannot be implemented?

The Guru: As mentioned earlier, we have made mistakes. It is known that the sage Satyathranan, in order to know what the cause and effect karma is, looked back into the karma of ten Chathuryugas. Then everything is the karma path of the previous Manu, that is, the sixth Manu, the seven Chathuryugas in the final stage and the three Chathuryugas in the Vaivasvatha Manvanthara. Having found out the gross, the subtle, the cause and the effect, he saw the words A, U, and Ma of the primordial sound coming through Manu. But the fundamental reason is that he could not find out from where and how the creative willpower, which is the dharma and karma to distinguish time, originated. Secondly, for some reason, they missed out on the truthfulness that the great men of those times had acquired through the power of penance. For that, the universal Aham Brahmasmi of the Hindus and other words in the Chathurvakyas came out, formulated the Vedas, Puranas and Epics, attained Advaita in one spirit and made it practical. However, without looking into what all transactions have taken place through these three letters, and what is the current state of that transactional karma, after some time passed, it began in the sweetness of the sound of the letter Om and helped the scholars to descend into the depth of the initiation of principles. The great souls who read, knew and taught it, established each karmadharma and ritual order under each guru. Through that came the Vedic Tantra. The reason is that it strengthened and fell into a profound karmic degradation where it could not be known from where and how the aforementioned initiation of principles originated. We forgot the small discriminative wisdom that was needed to remove this cause and take the effect. There is only one truth. To tell the truth with anything as a witness, in the path of action, standing always as evidence in front of us,
karmam kayamirukkeyavarjyam
cheyvathu guruvannorthathu cheyga
karmaphalodayasana pinne
janmam neetta mohavumakalum.

Fallen deep into the unitary prayer said as such, like the rhythm of a drummer's beat, hamٹhamٹhamٹhamham, hamham, thatharikida, when it came, the aforementioned ham went away. Without recognizing this tharikida and thatharikida, the beat cannot be recognized. Then, these eighteen mentioned instruments arrived at the part under the drum.

Because the error originated from the lineage of Manu, it continues undeniably. Even this syllable (Om) was given the phonetic forms that change into Shaktheyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam, creating art. Following that, they brought the Tantra called Vedic, got entangled at the base of the Tantra, gave a unitary sound to all of this such as Tantra, Mantra, and Yantra, gave Advaita, and forgot God. Then, using each science, linking everything from medical science to Tantra science, the value of Dharma was forgotten. Moreover, bringing in the illusionism (Mayavada) of nothingness in nothingness, confining everything in the 'Ya' of Maya, this Mayavada succeeded in leading to a part where the vital origin could not be recognized as to how, where, and what it was like. Following that, they entangled and mixed rationalism and liberationism, and forgot the truth. Along with that, yoga sciences and vital point sciences spread and flourished. It left the core dharma part of Vedanta, which is gross, subtle, cause, and effect, which was turned upside down and miniaturized like a banyan tree, and put the Mayavada, which is the karma part, in the forefront. The Dharma part, which had degraded Aham Brahmasmi, could not be preserved. It was consolidated, brought back, included in Mayavada, and destroyed.

This made us all like a piece of iron that fell into the gymnasium, or rather the framework, of an intelligent man who formulated without the awareness of the special duties of the passage of time. In this way, for the entire human world, in the language of today's scholars, a degradation of Dharma occurred. But it is not known where it is. Believe that it is a truth that has occurred regardless of religious or caste differences. In the end, the intellect, which was amazed by the spread of the bottomless person, is spinning from there.
The Disciple: The common people are those who spin by the intellect of these scholars. So, when even the scholars are spinning like this, the whole country will be caught in this spinning, right?

The Guru: The stupidity of not being able to take it even though it has been given to us in many ways and at many times from the Brahmic power over the ages to escape from it, has made us as if we have been carried away.
The Disciple: Now what is a way?

The Guru: Now we have only one medium. The medium that speaks of what is seen day by day - yesterday - today - tomorrow, the great sages praise what is seen day by day. Who is it that speaks of what is seen day by day? The great sages. The great sage is a visionary. That great sage is not one who came for the aforementioned five thousand or ten thousand years. That great sage is a great spiritual power that is part of the discipline of at least a guru of an era. That is, that guru is the authority of seven solar systems, just as one is of one solar system.

When speaking of a solar system, it is an inter-planetary karma of 9 planets, 12 zodiac signs, and 27 stars. Having conducted the clairvoyance of seven such solar systems, he who sees where the activities of life take place in these five elements, combining the five elements, the five senses, and the five sheaths, which are full of gross, subtle, cause, and effect - and then the individual soul and the supreme soul, is the one who sees it miniaturized. What is the karma in every tree and stone, living and non-living? - That is what is seen miniaturized. Thus, seeing what is the unity of the individual soul and the supreme soul by miniaturizing it is the discrimination between the soul and the non-soul, the offering of the soul and the non-soul mentioned in the Gita. As long as this karma is not understood, there is nothing special in babbling about illusionism or rationalism.
The Disciple: The Guru occasionally used the word that we were lucky to be able to see, know, and overcome all this. I did not understand what that was.

The Guru: It has been said earlier that the period to correct any mistake is Kali. Therefore, working by distinguishing the past three periods, giving priority to Kali, the shortest period of Kali, which specifies the Dharma of Kali, is four lakhs and thirty-two thousand years. Within this, in order to correct mistakes, accept the good, and take the authoritative nature of the Satyayuga, the children of men born and raised in Kali, having seen and known without leaving truth, dharma, mercy, and compassion, in order to act by seeing and knowing when, where, and what will happen in it, the visionary should convince them about the necessity of Kali. By summarizing the enduring nature of all times with letters, confining it as Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, and standing within the meaning of the initiation of principles preserved as the Supreme's Brahma, if the clairvoyance like an eagle falls on the earth, he will see what he needs, but it will not be an elevation that reflects charity by seeing all the special qualities of the earth. If calculated in that way, the fate is that both the one who ran and the one who chased go and kneel down.
The Disciple: Does that mean that everything we thought was completely religious and spiritual is incomplete?

The Guru: Not only that, it has become clear that the suitable way for us to set out to the door of the Satyayuga is to conquer the sense organs of knowledge with the sense organs of action, see how the five elements are contained, how the sense of unity of the individual soul and the supreme soul should be achieved, and how the karmas that have come as manvantaras for that should be destroyed.

The Disciple: Even though the path has been cleared, our Dharma, or the Indian curiosity, has gone wrong, and in many places, great souls and ignorant fishermen have brought the external, and through their calculations, our external and internal have been made to kneel, and we are in a state of a wrong path where we have to follow them. In a state where this is evident in the contemporary world, although the Indian curiosity has suggested a way to return to that path of truth, people are unable to take it on a practical level.

The Guru: As I said before, we have found such a way, and we were talking about a few parts of what we found. As a small part of this, a stream of light is hitting the earth in one or two places in Kerala. Such streams of light are hitting in many places. Because there is no one to take it there, natural disasters like in Russia have occurred in China and other big countries. The stream of light hitting Kerala is clearly appearing in Kerala in the form of four, forty, four hundred, leading the thinkers and religious thinkers here to the right path.
The Disciple: What did you mean by four, forty, four hundred?

The Guru: In four years, scientists will ascertain that this light exists. In forty years, they will ascertain that this is true and how it can be utilized. In four hundred years, this society will know what value this theory has. The Portuguese and the Mughals came here and made everything from our universities theirs. Today they rule with their language and their universities. Similarly, the language of Kerala and the Dharma of India will have to be practiced by the whole world.
The Disciple: What does this stream of light do?

The Guru: To carefully extract things. This place is light, it is truth. When this stream of light strikes, if it is seen that the people of that country are not good, it will destroy them. When this light strikes, living beings will be lost. It will come on the side of good and on the side of evil. If they take the good, they will get the good. Otherwise, it will destroy them. This can happen in any country. It was given in Russia but they didn't take it, did they? Didn't you see it in Armenia itself? Forty thousand people went down.

There is already a saying that what exists today is not enough, not enough. The people who discover this light will make public what this insufficient event is. At the same time, an ability of action will reflect from here in a way that the world understands what our mission is. It is a special intelligence that should be there not for this movement, not for those who love this movement, but for those who love this world, an action heroism to humbly take it and give it with sacrifice, mixed with devotion, love and respect.

People described as writers or scholars, authors, and sannyasins and brahmacharis who make people understand the deeds of visionaries should come forward to understand this and act. They all have the right to complete fulfillment. Because the third generation of the householder who considers the completeness of this knowledge as the life routine, goal, and mission by paying the full price, whether male or female, in whichever part of the world, will be the ones who handle true work efficiency. Every child who acts bravely for this will be praised as holy men who provide the purity of action that contributes to the eternal salvation of the world, I tell you the truth.
Guru Vani
Guru Jayanthi Edition September 1999
The Counterfeit Coin of Literal Interpretation
The Disciple: Natural disasters are causing destruction in many parts of India and the world, aren't they? Why is that?

The Guru: We have often prayed at Santhigiri for peace to come from natural disasters, haven't we? Peace has also come. Even before the scientists said that the cyclone was going to the Bay of Bengal, we were informed here. It also came true. It started from Kollam. That very night, someone was sent from here to inform the believers. Because of the prayer, it moved to the Bay of Bengal. Even then, it caused destruction in some places. However, it went to the Bay of Bengal that very day. Since then, we have prayed for a change in natural disasters.

There will be many such opportunities in the future. In India, as well as in Arab countries, European countries, and American countries, violence will increase, and within twenty years, complete ignorance that earns the hatred of the people will come to the rulers. Thus, losing merit, within thirty-five years, their power itself will decline, and the people will not want their own country. Even now, the signs of it have started to appear.

America is the place where thieves and violent people from India and many other countries, outcasts who were like some pirates, were exiled and settled, isn't it? They later grew up. Therefore, they should not be blamed for theirs. If the children who grew up like this have undergone such a change, and if they have been able to keep many countries in check and rule them, we should only see it as a good thing. In another thirty-five years, the people of that country will hate their own country. Such a nature to be hated will automatically arise there.

It is said that there is still a possibility of an earthquake in the northeastern parts of India, in the Himalayan slopes. However, this destruction will be spared in the areas where our prayers from here can reach. If we pray somewhere for a thirteen years, a lot of destruction in India will be spared.

The method of worship in India is what has caused this destruction. This hasn't just started now. The events that caused the sea to take and place, causing destruction in the Asian continent over many epochs, and becoming many known countries today, have been going on for twenty-five Chatur Yugas.

The Chaturvakyas are the words that belong to the essence of India, aren't they? These are the sentences that came when a truth was discovered. It is good for us to understand what the historical context of it is.

When the third Chatur Yuga of this Vaivasvata Manvantara was completed, a great man named Satyathranan was born with the influence of five gurus per yuga. He had to look back and forth a lot regarding times. After all, Satyathranan is a sage who came as an acharya of the yuga. As far as he is concerned, he has to see what the ancestors had done. For that, he took and examined three Chatur Yugas by births and by times. In all times, he himself is an authority who handles all matters. The changes and the great souls in the three Chatur Yugas have all come completely through the lineage of Manu itself. He himself has corrected many things through his births. He has come to power now too. He wanted to give a novelty to the actions that have passed now. That is how the Chaturvakyas came. It is gurus like this who have the authority to know what, where, and when everything happened in the proclamation of times. Only they will be completely told this.

The Vedantic suktas completed by the Chaturvakyas thus entered all our texts. Since all the Vedantic knowledge imagined and formulated in it belonged to Manu Dharma, and since it belonged to the Karma Kanda which he himself had worked on and settled, he saw everything as his own. Thus, the Chaturvakyas became the creation of Satyathranan.

Later gurus doubted to correct this. Although this has been shown to many acharyas, when looking at this with prior acquaintance, they see that there is no karma in which they are not included. When it happened like that, a natural mistake occurred. Even when taking and looking at the three Chatur Yugas backwards, it is the cycle of time that came to the memory of Manu that is seen. In the form of karma and in the form of imagination, thus in the six chakras, they caught and looked at the usual nature in the form of karma starting from what is caught as Muladhara.
The Disciple: What is the usual pattern in the form of action?

The Guru: For example, we usually give examples about some children - it is rare for them to be born together like this. Like that, when looking at the three actions of creation, preservation, and destruction, the usual pattern is to look at the post-deluge part that existed before creation. This was also written about the trinity. That is, the formation of the four times called Nanmukham. The six chakras are also depicted and spoken of like that.
The Disciple: What are the six chakras?

The Guru: The recollection of a human body. The science of Yoga is seeing how that power operates in a living being, or starting from an atom. One sees God within one's own body. What is said in Patanjali's sutras and other similar texts is also true concerning himself. His capacity for action in that period is also correct. This usual pattern is what was indicated. When we take and see each one and work it out, and when it comes to duties and actions, one is seeing oneself about oneself. But the later gurus were in a position where they did not know that all this was the imagination of Brahma's creation. Then they imagined, gave form, and caused form to be given. This is what was meant by the usual pattern.

This usual pattern can also be seen in the text called Patanjali's sutra. What is said in Vivekananda's Raja Yoga is also this same acquaintance. How will a scholar correct this? How will a knower of the three times correct this?

When it was formulated again, it was seen where, how, and in what the form stood. In the atom and in the infinite, one sees oneself as the karma one does reaching out. Among what was seen like that, the four sentences starting with Aham Brahmasmi came about. This is that usual pattern. But it became impossible to say how it sat in the infinite. When scientists took it and looked, they did not understand. Therefore, they felt the four sentences were correct.

Millions of books like Patanjali's sutras came to be in the karma depicted and written as four ashramas, for sannyasins whose mantra initiation is over, and for brahmacharis who study until the time of sannyasa. To prevent that writing from fading, many more books followed. That is the great books written and kept on copper plates. Written like that, they even wrote the first Manu as the son of Brahma.

It is said that the body is indeed the first instrument of dharma. Because the body was very carefully protected, he got the opportunity to be born as a wise man. Knowledge must be understood in various ways, and it can only be obtained if one looks at where it comes from. The certainty mentioned in the Yoga Sutra was assumed. When scholars interpreted it, it became Sat, Chit, and Ananda. But in each of the chakras, there is the karma of whichever sky is mentioned. When it reaches here, it departs from anatomy. Standing on this logic stated by the author of the Yoga Sutras, one should not think that Lord Krishna is like that. Lord Krishna is a great man who completed all this over many periods. When Yoga was formulated and written down, anatomy and the science of the respective spheres became one. These became usual formulas that came through over many periods. When Patanjali's sutras and many other sutras became usual formulas like this, no one in the world had the courage to say that it was wrong.

When looking creatively, all sorts of imageries of similarities in form that came in every artistic creation repeatedly brought by Lord Krishna, are seen to have come even in Patanjali's sutras. When scholars determined its time, they said the name of the four-faced one. That is Brahma, who wears the imaginary name of Brahman. That was called the four-faced creation. Then, they depicted and brought Subrahmanyan, the radiant gem, as the son of Shiva. When Subrahmanyan attained perfection in radiance, he explained the meaning of creation, preservation, and destruction to the Trinity. In that measure, all three times were also seen. When these three times were analyzed to see which they were and went to the Chaturvakyas, there it was created with these three times and stopped. Then the scholar who did the literal interpretation found an easy way. It went into the literal interpretation called Ra-mayanam, Ra-ma-ayanam. The morphology completed its meaning. That is how the Amarakosha came into being. When the meaning of the words was explained and Amarakosha and Siddharupa came creatively, the first word about Amara also came. Amarā nirjarā devā is the first word in the Amarakosha, interpreted by giving it an imagination. It has become clear that no scholar or thinker can go beyond this. When it came there, Subrahmanyan questioned the karma formed as Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshwara. This is how the history of Subrahmanyan came about. When it came there, the scholars did a small job. One is that there is ego in the sound without 'Ra', or there is ego in the sound with 'Ra'. Then they tore the meaning of Ramayanam and gave an explanation. Guru is Sakaladharmatma

It is said that the Guru is Sakaladharmatma. Whatever births we have passed through, seeing all the good and bad in those births ourselves, dedicate everything to the Guru. The Guru brings about the experience and breaks the karma in that experience. Our life has been becoming bad over many births.

Let's assume we are good. Even so, if we don't respect anyone, will it be good? Our mind will get caught in various things and remain tied there. How can we elevate this stagnant mind? We are continuously being born, living, and dying like this. So it is said that after many billions of years, one will get a Guru.

One who comes perfect after taking billions of births is the lord of ganas - Ganapathy. But Ganapathy cannot bring us to that state. Because he is worshipped as a god. The lord of ganas is also the lord of twenty-seven stars. This should be worshipped as a Guru. It is said that even when Shiva got married, he offered to Ganapathy. But we have shown Ganapathy as the son of Shiva. The Ganapathy Shiva worships is Moola Ganapathy. When he was made a god, Shiva also fell into that path. This is where the incident got tangled up.

Shiva was not born in a time to hold on to Moola Ganapathy. He was born in the time of the god. And Shiva came as a great one among gods. When the god was practiced, Brahma, Shiva, Vishnu or Shaktheyam, Shaivam, Vaishnavam were worshipped. This worship has been done for millions of years. What is picked up and worshipped here and there is what falls under this.

It is said that there are thirty-three crore gods. Will counting their number ever end? Just like this, the lives that have worshipped this and gone are standing countless. The devil in the form of a devil, the god in the form of a god--going like this, it has become extremely bad. None of the gurus who came here have been able to leave this. Subrahmanya worships Shiva. That scene has not been removed. But we have not been able to see it like this. To remove this, the souls of the ancestors worshipped earlier and the god included in those ancestors must be caught and given liberation. Keeping only the good souls, the rest must all be destroyed. Who will do this? We will get the knowledge of someone who does this for us. This must be useful for life.

How is it said that it is useful? We will see this with our eyes and see it with our mind when we sleep. When we sit in prayer, as said in Tamil, we will see it in the state of 'thoongamal thoongi' (sleeping without sleeping). That is, when sitting in meditation, all this will pass in front of us. What is the meaning of this? When we are thinking of our Guru, all of them will come.

There is a calculation called Nakshatrapankthi (line of stars). When reaching the place where this Nakshatrapankthi joins, this sight will stop. No one has told this calculation till now. Then everything we see is through the lineage of this Guru. By the compassion of the Guru, we are seeing this through the Guru. Then again, seeing this god, goddess, devil, and sage, we will suddenly see the Guru again. We are seeing it like an atom splitting and standing.

We have been taught that Kali is destruction. In the old days, gods went in airplanes. So didn't we understand that our time is better than the time of the gods? Man has the obligation to pass even as a god, goddess, sage, sannyasi, jnani, and mukta. The Guru is the witness for that. That is Guru Sakaladharmatma. Having all dharmas. The god, goddess, sage, and sannyasi we say we saw, all merge in the Guru. If merged in the Guru, the Guru will break this away from us. He will measure all karma. In the place that says husband is god, if that husband is good, he will cross the position of a god. If such a husband is not found, the father should rise in that path. We didn't get that either. Then what should we do? The children should reach that position. What if it's a woman? A woman should not be given a position, should not be touched, should not be taken. This is how we have been taught. It is not like that. You should not even assume so. The Guru should be ready to take that up. That is its aspect.

Who should the Guru be seen as? The Guru is God, is Brahma, is the Brahman of the Supreme, is oneself. This is what Narayana Guru has said, everything is not different from oneself. That truth, where everything ends counting one by one, should be in oneself. Otherwise, it won't work if it goes outside. He will give it to you as a Guru. Only the Guru can give it. No one else can.

We must get the form of the Guru standing in this atom and the form of the Guru standing filling this whole. This should be seen in the three states of Jagrat, Swapna, and Sushupti. In whatever births we took, is it possible for this Guru not to come at the stages of those births? Coming there, the Guru will break and break that hardness, purify and purify it, and keep it elevated again. Until the next yuga comes, the hardness of their generations will be broken and kept. What is going to come next is Satya Yuga.
Before Kali Yuga ends, all humans in this world will work and settle. How? They will cross the state of this god, sage, and sannyasi, and this Grihasthashrami will get the position of the Guru.

Kings who practiced dharma are above the god. Proof for that, Dasharatha. They will even give boons to gurus. He is a Grihasthashrami, a king. This is the greatness of the Guru. We don't have to count and serve everything one by one, the disciple will get the position of every god and goddess from the Guru.

I cannot clear any flaws in my life myself. The stain of my father, mother, and ancestors cannot be cleared. I must walk straight. I need a mind to walk without deceiving anything. We shouldn't have enmity towards anything. Nor should we love. If we love, we will be in that danger. If at the time of death one cries out that my child didn't get anything, it's gone. Or my husband, or children, or wealth, or lordship, or how do we know which devil's thought comes up at that time? To prevent this thought from coming, Sakaladharmatma. The Guru can be seen in all dharmas. This Guru will make it light and light and make us equal to him. This is the Guru and disciple. This Guru cannot be got always. Even though Sree Krishna came, it couldn't become like that. Sixteen thousand and eight births are souls to whom Krishna gave advice in many births. They should not be given mukti. That is the plane they stand on.

We would have made mistakes. Mistakes would have happened in our ancestors and everyone. But that can be changed by our life. If a good son or daughter is born, our clan can be purified through them. Clan purity is not just for us, it is for the purity of our country and the world. Only if a woman comes straight can we do that.

God worship is practiced in all forms in any logic. That is, whichever devil is worshipped, we do it calling out 'Oh God'. God worship is knowledge done according to justice. This has been done for a long time.

Whatever pains have come due to our birth, there is a reason for all of them. An effect will not occur without a reason. So knowing what that reason is, Santhigiri's way is saying how God worship should be done according to our capability and capacity. That shouldn't be done just suddenly either. Because we should respect whichever devil or god or whatever we respected and worshipped. And only after giving what needs to be given to it and moving it aside, should we do something else instead. You shouldn't think you can just do it like that. What is there to discard from it, what good is there to do for it, doing both of these, we will establish dharma for a karma we get by struggling with our life. We don't need siddhis or blessings or curses. We have nothing to get from that. The karma we take with pain, we live in a way that not only our countrymen but even our children cannot recognize it. You must consider it as a path given by God for recognition.
