The Sun Concentrated in the Soul

There are people who have laid bare the truth of life. The pleasant blessedness that came through experience is being shared with them forever. That is what you have been informed of until today through the birthday message. The most concentrated subject is the Guru-disciple relationship. The purpose of Brahman (Brahmoudeshyam) is to show that. Santhigiri's path of resolution is something that has come to be ordained by Brahman. It is the truth of truth, the source of blessedness, and pure brilliant genius.

There is no doubt that we are all entitled to the Guru-disciple relationship. Most people do not know this. When speaking of the Guru-disciple relationship, most people mock it. But this Guru-disciple relationship is true. It is because many of us learned in various fragmented ways that it became unknown. In the old days, learning was for the sake of learning. It is not so now. It is like some sort of business.

Religions are indeed destined. If there is destiny, we can see it. Seeing is also destiny. There must be a destiny to strive and attain what is seen. We do not need base-level experiences. Whatever is seen, there is nothing to say as more or less. It stands according to each person's measure. It can only be taken like that. Some do not make an effort. Some lack the qualification.

People say it's enough to live somehow. It is not like that. It is the composition of the soul. No matter how much some people study and write, they will pass. Some won't pass even if they stand on their heads and write. That means it won't be of use to them at that time. Even if they study a small subject, it won't be useful for them in time. My childhood was a time when most people did not study much. If one wanted to go to college, one had to go to Trivandrum, Ernakulam, Kozhikode, or Thalassery. Or else, one had to go to Madras. Even after trying so hard, some didn't get it.
Back then, legal studies were very strict. Therefore, some will get it. Some will not get it. We can take anything only if it is destined. Even if destined, there are some problems in taking it.
Some people reach here from very far away. That is a fortune. Even if that fortune occurs, to take it, one has to suffer a lot. This is being said for your familiarity.

One must remove all the baseness that has come in the Trinity system and others, and take the essence from it. If it is said that one should remove the baseness and take the essence in that system which has crossed so much time, shouldn't one be an authority for that? It is a system that has passed twenty-five Chatur Yugas. In that, three Chatur Yugas lay idle without any action. What will we do for this? We must get God's permission. There are no other ways to correct this mistake, the permission of Brahman itself is needed. For that, disciples must also arrive. Every Yuga has a Dharma. If one studies Puranas and epics and starts following them, one cannot fulfill this divine ordinance.

Seeing the cause and effect of Kali Yuga, one must perform dharma by standing in that very effect which is the cause. One should be able to know the reflections of each yuga. We don't need to take that of Satya Yuga. It is enough to respect it. If mistakes occur in Treta Yuga and Dvapara Yuga, what will be done? Kali is not like that. The karma of Kali is to untie everything, throw it away, purify it, and deliver it to the next Satya Yuga. That is, the karma of the three yugas must be untied and purified.

The sun is the proof that the evolutions of life over a long period of time have come to an end. It spreads and strikes the revolving moon, as darkness and light. It again comes to the earth and takes birth. The Guru is the one who evolves on this earth in such a manner.

All the periods of Satya Yuga have been divided into parts like quarter, half, three-quarters, and one, and have come as three yugas. The karma of these three yugas is the evolutionary action brought to the end of Kali Yuga. This evolution is what needs to be reclaimed. Being born in every yuga, the course of karma of that yuga system should be taken. A lifetime strictly wandering and getting confused in this yuga system and grasping only its truth. A soul acquires merit as a result of many such lifetimes of suffering.

You may ask, aren't everyone human beings? We can just say human beings, but are they really humans? What do they do? They just do good and bad according to the times they live in and pass away, with the attitude that "I cannot look into all this." The easy bag will become a bag of mistakes. That is what is called sanchita karma. It is not like that, the easy part is yours. Then what should you do for the world? When the Guru and oneself attain evolutionary action, what should one do in evolution? This is a big subject. One should see this and ask to know.

This knowledge is beyond fate. It is beyond intellect and logic. One will get what is suitable for one's yogic power. One can take up to that yoga. One should not go and struggle for a yoga that does not exist. That requires luck. That yoga is given to life as luck. So, a fortunate life is what is given to us as a Guru. To know if it is a fortunate life or not, one must see it. Has one struggled in the evolutionary theory of that seen life? The disciple must see. The disciple should know if they have done any service for the Guru. If seen, in what all ways? That means the Guru's idea has been taken and preserved to that extent. That is, such a right has been obtained. In the meantime, the proof of Gurumukham is bringing the soul out by breaking it after falling into many pits and struggling. Where does Gurumukham become clear? It becomes clear in the atomic circle.

At the time of making a movie, imaginative action is given, right? How much time's effort is needed to give that imaginative action. Thus the work brought over time. Then the truth of repetition brought by birth. This is the meaning of the disciple taking and preserving the Guru's part. That repetition passed away like a dream. Jagrat, Swapna, Sushupti, have returned to Turiya. From there, it is seen as an evolutionary action.

From which sphere did this evolution come? From which animal-like life-seed did this evolution come? From which altered acharya karma did this flawed karma come? Completing this dharma by taking it—this should be understood as the disciple having to dissolve in the stream of light with the Guru's face to reclaim that dharma. That soul has come after being in much darkness. With whom did that soul come? With the Guru. What had he preserved with that Guru? The Guru's idea. The idea preserved in that way is now coming with us. Ran on the banks of many rivers. Ran for many times. All these rivers that have been run to must be crossed. The evolutionary action that crosses like this is the relationship between the Guru and the disciple.

So all these small and large skies must be crossed. After that, one must reach the pure sky. Having reached there, one must see what relationship they have with the Guru who stands bearing witness. This is what is called, "Oh man, your mind." This is what is beyond thought. Karma is the Guru and oneself sharing that altered state which stands beyond thought. That is a karma that cannot be shared with anyone else. That karma will always be referred to as karma, karma. This is its aspect.

We must be born on this side. The problem is here. We are born. We have money, capacity, education, all wealth, the Guru is with us for guidance, we have everything. But only the evolution of life is not right. What to do? No matter which science you go to, there is only this much. Not just medical science, even the atom theory cannot go beyond this. A command must be given here.

The evolutionary theory of the solar system has entirely come to the planetary position. Gaining strength for the atomic radiation of each sphere of a solar system, evolution has been completed within the distances. Who has completed it? Who has organized the tools to complete all this? Those tools are of a life that has aged through births in a way that can organize them. Who has that soul caught hold of? Its Guru! He is seeing who that Guru is. Reaching there, this Guru stands encompassing crores of suns in a way that cannot be broken out. This Guru is one who has come spinning through the inter-planetary divisions. How can this glory be broken out? Crores of stars are contained in this solar system. Their planets stand revolving around them. Even in today's discovery, a length of fifty thousand crore years has been assigned to this life.
Question: Is it possible to travel far with the mind (knowing by seeing everything) other than with the body?

Answer: The things inside a universe can be seen. Cannot go beyond that. At that time, his mind is empty. It is said to be beyond thought. Not thinking at all, then. Seeing without thinking. Beyond thought, beyond intellect. You cannot say things like it is what I think up.
Question: Is there any difficulty in imparting that state?
Answer: It is that state which is imparted.
Question: Once reaching Satya Yuga, will there be knowledge to see all this and know the Guru? Is this state permanent?
Answer: When we say Satya Yuga, it is the karma of a period. The karma of Satya Yuga is doing only what needs to be done and rejecting what is not needed.

What is the miniaturized karma sun? The subject here is that sun being shown for so many times. Crores of stars, all those stars must become the Guru's. When it becomes the Guru's, the disciple must see who that Guru is. What is the use of seeing the Guru if there is no one to copy it? The disciple who delivers the Guru's glory must know it and act. What is the point of knowing the calculation of a thousand years or ten thousand years or a lakh years? If the calculating theorist is not willing to see and know, let it lie there, no need to see. From the light of this truth, let those who want the calculation of ten thousand years take it. Let those who want the calculation of a lakh years take it. It is the theorist who has spun through all this that comes as the Guru. So how should this Guru be? This stream of light is what evolves and gives to the disciple by preserving the birth dispositions and birth sins alike. How many colors, how many distances that is - all this is a subject known only to the Guru and the disciple.

Some doctors have simply mentioned some things as a trick. If you go and stand at the base of the Sida cordifolia (Kurunthotti), it will say that I can be used for this--I am for this, I can be used for that. Beyond how much evolution is this matter? The distance between these evolutionary differences is what cannot be known.
The dispute made by the doctor by centering for a long time is in his life. For one who has studied everything, this centralization of knowledge will not be in life.
Question: Can he know the form of man?
Answer: No. Man has also sat like a tree.
Question: A tree near the Himalayas has been sustaining life for crores of years. Why does it stand like that? Isn't that sacrifice?

Answer: It is not sacrifice. This soul is one that has done crores of evil deeds. You stand there and experience, experience suffering and stand there and go to hell - this is it. The inquiry into this will stop when the fragments of intellectual exercise completely end. So this world has an evolutionary theory that turns into stones, thorns, forests, and thickets. Seeing that, preserve only the subject given to you and the measure of life given to you.
Question: The fundamental principle of science says that one cannot be created or completely destroyed, right?

Answer: The later evolution is material division by turning into chemicals. Mercury, sulfur, vermilion--these belong to the nine arsenics. Organizing and preserving that, standing for crores of years, then decaying, being born again, and the life coming in a systematic course of karma becoming trees and plants, coming in animal nature and becoming an animal, then becoming neither animal nor human, and finally the repetition continues as a human. So how will the first human birth be? This figure looks just like a carved piece of wood. All this shown is the evolution of life.
Question: What is the course of karma of those who rule collectively? There are also some aged people in it, right?
Answer: We can see what has happened a little and what has not happened. Is it enough if the postman does the work of the court peon? Aren't both peon work? We must take it like this.

Now how will we take this? First, feel that this is the truth. Then, feel that it is needed. Must feel so many times. Desires capable of respecting the truth must arise. Think that truth is needed. When it feels like it is needed, it is needed, it will take you to the side of 'needed'. When you think it is needed and do it, that much is in your hand.

He doesn't even have enough to eat. He also needs to eat. Thinking that he should not only eat but also give is sharing. He must give a share of what he eats to another person. When giving like that, the expense became more. I only have enough for myself to eat. But two people ate it. The matter of that day was over. Just because it became the sustenance of life, it does not mean it was a sumptuous meal. It was barely enough. This is the arrangement of life. It is the evolution of life. He also produced to give to dogs, cats, elephants, and everything. This is the evolution of life. Doctors studied medicine, studied and went on, and reached the karma of cooking. Like that, the relief of karma cooked for so much time, for crores of years, lies here. That was plucked and brought from forests, streams, and lakes.

Thus, life is the action of many past births. If something is done, it is that life that succeeds. Shouldn't there be a care to do and succeed like this? What is care? Care is for the achievement of life. That belongs to God. If needed, can't all this be given to God? Can't the father know that he is the father's son? If there was a desire to become a father, a mother, a husband, and a wife, the one who desired must also have that care. One must even have the care of who one is in the inter-yuga dharma.

Here we must know: what is the relationship between disciple and Guru? After all the evolutionary actions, the disciple and Guru have come. Now? It is the karma that has entered the disciple through the Guru. That must be shared between the disciple and the Guru. There is nothing else to preserve. Only the Guru's word--don't do that, you do this, I will do it. The whole world should roll up like this.

You, who live without precision even for a single atom in the world--can you count and determine even the atoms in a small circle? What can then be said about the evolution of life? All those determinations are caught only in the relationship of Guru and disciple. It has gone as Guru and disciple in an indeterminable action of past births. The qualification of life is coming back after going like that. This is what is meant by doing penance for ten thousand years. Why do penance for ten thousand years? An evolutionary theory that lived intermingled in many births, with many Gurus, as that Guru and disciple! What can we do here? If the disciple feels that it is a suitable Guru for that, everything is my Guru, I will do it and manage--this is my stubbornness, my care.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
Our Culture

There are some great men who think they can make people believe them using magical tricks. I don't believe in any of that. Because if I show tricks, you and I are not connected. People have assumed that Narayana Guru Swami passed away showing tricks. He showed some things like this thinking he could bring them together and set them straight. But no one became straight. This is not wisdom.

Until now, a matter where all religious theories merge has not come. We cannot even say these theories are one. Only after the position of the Trinity can we say everything is one. This ignorance has happened to every religion. Christians will say their God is the greatest. Islam will say theirs is the greatest. Hindus have considered the position of the Trinity as the greatest. In this state, the ignorance we have acquired is not small.

Ramana Maharshi has not shown any distortion. Ramana Maharshi's spiritual form itself is highly capable. Narayana Guru has praised him. This is the Municharya Panchakam--what is the routine of a sage? Even after saying all this, how many have been able to take it? Because we have kept it divided into sections like this, today Narayana Guru Swami has become of the Ezhava and Chattampi Swami of the Nair, and then it became a helpless acquaintance.

We must think about how the status of our land and country has turned upside down. As a result of that, the character of Asia and India changed into many lands in many ways. That is, it caused Asia and India to appear as if cut into many lands. It came in many forms of worship. That form of worship, regarding India, was divided into four as Bhakti, Yoga, Karma, and Jnana, and then turned into many sub-divisions. This is what we did to catch God. If done like this to catch God, it will never be right.

If we get a chance in this way (in the state of the Guru) to get God as destined, it is a great fortune. For us who have crossed crores of births, to get a chance to be born at the time a great soul is born. Many great men have grown and reached the historical truth of the same period in the same place. We have no knowledge about them. What should we do for that knowledge? We expect Vedanta sutras to say this. But none of them are useful to us in this way. Sri Shankara and Sri Krishna themselves are examples of that. How have those who have no knowledge about Krishna learned it? We are telling the history of great souls who have been ruined by being spoken, sung, and studied in that way.

One group assumes that if you become a sanyasi, then you don't need anything. If necessary, eat raw leaves. The water oozing from it itself is plenty for them. Finally, if you swallow Nux vomica seeds, you can sustain the body. You know what the toxic richness of this Nux vomica seed is. When these poisons are swallowed one by one, how poisonous will the body become! You keep the history of making people crazy by showing all this and showing wonders in a brutish way. Taking samadhi in seven places, if necessary, appearing in another place, in a street. Some miracle stories like that are told about Shirdi Sai Baba too. If this is the belief of man, what can be done? Do you think it has become a reason for spiritual merit for you and your children? This is a method of taking people into one's hands by deceiving them. That should never be done. If you want God, just believe. Even if you don't believe, no mistake will happen. Just don't become bad by believing.

It was indicated earlier that the history of dividing Asia into many parts is here. Sri Krishna ran all over India. What is the reason to run like this? He was running standing as a support for the Pandavas. Why did such a great Guru run? After running all over India, he went to another shore and built an island (Dwaraka) there. Dwaraka went under water. Today we know the depth at which it lies. Who melted that iceberg enough to submerge Dwaraka? It is said that a twilight is the reason the water rose.

Twilights are of two types: one is morning twilight, the other is evening twilight. There is a yuga transition in both these twilights. For one yuga transition, if calculated in human years, it will take a minimum of one crore years. But what we have got here is not that calculation. If we look at the history of Manu, we can see that. Manusmriti is a book that has recorded history clearly like this. But we are unable to recognize the truth in it.

That knowledge will only come from the source of love. That love must be flawless. If the dawn of that love is not considered a great blessing for us, it will not stay in our hands. Caste and religion are no barriers to this love. Class hatred has absolutely no place in this love. Such a true path has been shown as God before you. You must grow according to that gift of God. It is to grow like that that you are made to pray, at least as a namesake. You are not great enough to come forward through your conscious actions or karma proficiency. You are also not familiar with such an ashram life.

Our very old concept is that an ashram is a place for taking sanyasa. The concept that an ashram is a place for sanyasa is correct. But that talks about the ashram method in Treta Yuga. People of those times did not have this much cultural elevation. Only very few people would wish for good things. Most were not like that. But we have assumed that people in the old days were very good. We have been made to believe that people today are not as qualified as them.

That is a matter set by talking about the ashrams of a few ancestral great souls. Regarding those ashrams, it was true. We have a past experience where women among humans never went to the ashram. The knowledge we have been taught that it was the time when the best people lived is not correct. It is today that humans live most culturally. That culture did not come as ours alone, or belonging to any one section. It is a mixed culture of all countries. But when this culture came, what happened? We are unable to impart goodness to our children to the extent of our intention. We also do not know what the karma capacity that has grown today is for. Even regarding language, we do not have a unified language. So many languages in India. Among them, Kerala's language is very small. Although we can say there are four languages in South Indian culture, there are many sectarian languages within that culture itself. Similarly, whatever subjects there are, they all stand mixed and complicated. But looking at it in one way, this is good. It feels like we are each sharing the culture of the world. In a broad sense, that is true. It is also good. But our growth is not enough for that. That is also not enough for our growth. Because that is not the culture that can or should come to our children. Anyway, if they are not skilled in their respective languages, we will be unable to love the language.

As far as Kerala's language is concerned, we can call it a very great language if we want. There is no other culture with this many letters. Ours is almost a language equivalent to Sanskrit. Developing all this to that level cannot be done with a small governance or a small program. It will take at least three hundred years for the Malayalam language to reach the true part of a culture. It is very good that we got the opportunity to be born, grow, and know in this stage of growth.

Most of us assume that an ashram is a place to take sanyasa. An ashram is not for taking sanyasa. We need an ashram connection essentially from a very young age. In the old days, children of kings were kept in ashrams. We must know the ashram as a distinguished place to respect and know the dharma of Kali. But we haven't been taught like that. We are taught that Kali is bad, people living in Kali are bad, etc. This is never true. Such a karma has never existed in this world. That karma is not going to exist in Kali either. We have reached a disadvantage of not being able to recognize what the dharma of Kali is. How so? We were made to believe that Treta Yuga culture is great. Although it was a culture according to the time, it is not great. Dvapara is also like that. But the refined karma could not change those times. Along with that came poetry and literature. Language itself was used to mock. Language can be used in any way. It is mostly used to mock. At the same time, there is some good too. What did we gain by mocking? What did we gain by saying a language and denying or mocking someone?
Given this situation, there must be a change with the world. That change must be through the ashram itself. Otherwise, it will have a shortcoming. That effort is our effort here.

A great karmic capacity of great souls who manifested in two yugas, or operated in an incorporeal nature, stands here ancestrally. This karmic capacity must be corrected. But if corrected in the path they followed, it will not turn. It must be corrected through the ashram itself. That effort has been going on at all times. Whether knowingly or not, we have ashrams of many types today. But all follow the old system itself. Old is just old. It cannot be renewed. Therefore, that is not what we need. It must truly become the culture and language of the world. Culture of the world does not mean the culture of the world should unite, but it must become a karma that delivers the culture of the world. We don't need to get tired thinking about how this culture will be delivered.

In the time we have got, time is valued and acted upon only briefly. In many places in the Puranas, one word is said--among the times, Kali is good. But in what sense is this Kali good? We are afflicted by an ignorance of not knowing this. Our effort must be to change that.

Some people come here believing. They are not those who come in the name of caste or religion. Those who come here have a mindset of change. They are those who come to know what this is. We must give that change to the world through our children. There is no difference of male and female, small and big for that. When their culture grows together, the old people might not understand it. Because the growth of knowledge in old people is only that much. How old must they be for the knowledge of small children today to come to adults? Thus, children have a change along with the world. Whatever this change is, it cannot come without God knowing. God has known and come. We are unable to decree why God has known and brought it. That is not enough, we can firmly decree it. This is the time permitted as God for us to know and behave.

Kerala is a very small place. The change in Kerala has not come anywhere else. It seems a bit difficult to understand that Kerala has such a virtue. Kerala's culture is a good culture. But we will say it is bad. It is not bad. Some youngsters born before nineteen seventy-three absorbed some mischief and became as bad as they could be. Their ignorance is never respecting anything good they see. A feeling has reached them that if they respect, some mistake happened or a shortcoming occurred.

This ignorance has come through two things. One is rationalism, the other is liberationism. Both these groups have no liberation, no devotion, and no wisdom. Nothing can be done to these ignorant rogues. There are also some people here who praise and eulogize that they are the great people here. Like them, some people get into politics and do all kinds of useless behavior in the world, reflecting it in whatever way they can.

For over fifty years, what are our rulers showing with the freedom gained by so many people sacrificing their lives? Adorning the most vile actions to tear it apart and see the size of each political party. To justify that, they are throwing even great culture before the people. To show that even though we are many parties, we are people of great culture, what kind of obscenity are they showing to hold hands and show that they are one? This is today's government. They are brimming with the perfection of culture! This is getting into adults and making them do so many things! So what if this baseness gets into children?

In this matter, no set is bad. They show something or the other to win. Not even a trace of this is fit to be copied in life. The people also know that this is unnecessary. But this is regarding children born before nineteen seventy-three. All of them behave like this. The situation in any country is the same. But children born after seventy-three have a change in all places. This is the biggest thing for us.

There are people who used to convince others in the early days that coming to this ashram was barbaric. Today they have started feeling that it would be good to bring their children here. We must evaluate this. Those born before nineteen seventy-three are the children of those who arm themselves to fight and win. We cannot do anything to them. Even if convinced that it is true, they are people who have no hesitation to intentionally say it is not so. They talk like a kind of rationalism. This is not rationalism, it is a kind of nonsense. They will argue for days and waste time to establish that people in the old days were very good. If there is a place where ten people gather, they will conduct big yagnas for it. Culturally too, they conduct many yagnas in this model and study. But, for whom, how, and when should all these yagnas be used? Yagnas are fine. As long as the use of this yagna is not known, why do this! If those who get tired preaching the Gita memorize it a bit, will all its culture enter inside him? The culture of his life means that the most corrupted culture has grown. The culture before nineteen seventy-three is the most corrupted. But after twelve years, this is growing in another way. You can understand that just by looking at the kids in your house. They are truly greater than you. But you are spoiling these children.

You should not take raising children as a small matter. Parents and rulers must know that. Not everyone can become a minister, not everyone can hold a job. But they are participants in all the affairs of this land. In what way should this government impart this to these children? Do not consider them as mere males or females. College is the place to impart culture. There they should not just become male and female. If that happens, it is difficult to come back as they went. There are so many children and guardians who suffer this difficulty.

This is where the importance of the ashram culture lies. Many old theories have come and gone. To change these theories, we need a novelty. We need its own intellect, we need the knowledge to copy wealth of love. We need a model to copy that. Some kids need a fan; to wake up in the morning, they need to hear a song that beats them to death--those who say all this might be loving towards their own children, but their knowledge, culture, or environment are not favorable for this. Even then, how do they consider it? In the concept of raising a kid from a big house. Big does not mean grown as high as the sky, but in money, capacity, and wealth. In this state, how can this poor man's kids be raised? Therefore, we don't need it like that. These guardians should not see all this and say they want that too. Decency is saying that my children should study like this and impart culture like this.

Going to study in Shantiniketan was a culture of the old days. But those who studied and came from there, apart from brimming with manners, do not have enough information regarding culture. They do not know how to act in that culture or do it. Then what is the use of them? They studied and came back and became a group that talks about culture at the door, unable to fit anywhere. Our culture is not that.

Our culture starts, I mentioned the calculation of a time, nineteen seventy-three. I was very sad about that. When I say sad, I felt that there is not even a child in life to love me. I could not ask why this misery is like this or grow in that state. I know one thing, those who should love me the most hated me. This is my experience. Not only being hated like that, it even felt that there is no way out, cannot even live anymore. There is no way out but to endure this. There is nothing else to do but endure according to my knowledge. Didn't say anything to any human being. But I have a courage in my mind. That courage is there from when I was a small child. Then there was also a knowledge that everyone is good. If you ask how everyone becomes good, I don't know. Ready to suffer anything for that. If I see someone being beaten, I cannot sleep that day. A feeling that I am the one taking the beating. Fear, love, and respect brimmed so much that the mind got blocked.

The thing is that it can be changed even to the manifestation of Gods and Goddesses. How did these theorists understand this? They don't know how to understand. A glance from this God and Goddess is enough is what our ancestors knew, and ours too. Nothing can be explained here. We are people with family temples, tutelary deities, ancestors are from old families--which means the family members were arrogant. Saying they are from family and then seeing another kid, the kid of this family walks around arrogantly kicking and stomping. It is people like this who have gone and studied in Shantiniketan. The knowledge told here is not this.

I indicated earlier, when hurting thinking that I can't even live anymore, a word, 'Hey, no one has a native land they were born in, that is for you'. Whatever sorrow comes, I have no difficulty in experiencing it. I cannot even tell anyone that I have sorrow. Everyone who knows me knows that. There are twenty-five years lived like this. Before that, seventeen years lived in Varkala and other places. Drank only sorrow and grew up for so much time. If you ask what this is for, I myself don't know. Some kind of life. What kind of life, I am also not sure. If you ask how I felt like sacrificing so much, I don't know. But this is the truth.

In a position with so little knowledge, saying that I, with so little knowledge, was able to do this is foolishness. But I can say now that it is not foolishness. Because God has made my experience the truth today. At least some of you are able to know that. This is an achievement of mine. It must be to impart this that you are motivated to bring your children here. However loving parents you are, you will bring your children here.

There is no discipline here like the old ashram. In the old ashram nature, you know the story of even Krishna going to chop firewood. How much Krishna even suffered and lived then--none of this has been taught to us. But this ashram is not that. You come here and change the form of worship that has existed till today. That change is coming in the children themselves. You are directly seeing that karma which even our sages had reached through that form of worship. How is that seen? Jagrat, Swapna, Sushupti, Turiya, Turiyatita--seeing the karma experienced in three periods in such karma. The fourth karma cannot be crossed. If that is to be crossed, the presence of the Guru must also be there. Otherwise it won't happen.

When the three periods are repeated, we should be able to reach a level of knowledge about what has completely passed, what currently exists, and what is yet to come. This knowledge should be imparted to children. When Sri Krishna stayed in Sage Sandipani's ashram, he experienced such and such hardships, or the story of Sri Rama — thus about great souls and their sufferings. Even the great souls of Western countries still mix some raw medicines, pour them into a vessel, and give the mixture. This itself is the ashram method of the olden days. Seeing that the medicine has such and such qualities, giving that medicine just like that. In today's culture, giving such raw medicine is not enough. As our lifestyle itself has become very modernized, more poison has entered our bodies. This poison will invite numerous diseases. We also need our bodies to remove these poisons.

To change Kali, a body is needed. For that, what old sanyasa has taught you is, no need for clothes, no need for food, nothing like that is needed. Then who can you culturally refine? There was a time when nothing was needed. That is the sanyasa of Treta Yuga. Even if you starve, sit on the road, or sit inside the forest, you will only get the culture of that time. You will not get the culture of this time. The proof for that is the ashrams in the land and home today. We have made it in such a way that we can try at home from the ashram. There is that difference in the ashrams in the land too. Whatever special rules are there in the land in various ways, some models of that will be practiced in the ashram too. Even if it hasn't reached the side of knowledge, it is there in the side of each action. The joy of that action is coming into their hands. Like a farmer--the joy he feels when a sprout breaks in the farming he is doing.

This is the method of this ashram. An effort must be made to copy this into your children according to their knowledge, and make them suitable for the land, country, and world. That must be copied at home itself. What are the things you have injected into their minds. I once saw the struggle of a woman going to beat coir putting her child through. She was forcefully pulling up a shoe. That kid was in unbearable pain in the leg. As it cried, she pushed it in forcefully. Then she somehow sang it to sleep. But neither she nor her husband can afford to buy a shoe. If we do not change our girls from such a culture, what will their lives become? They say it is the life they dreamt of. What all is there in the life they dreamt of? However the world is rolling, they have found and swallowed all that. Then fights between the husband and wife. These mother and father behave into a knowledge of telling each other's flaws and making the child hear that it is the child's flaw.

A change must come from here. What must we become for this to come? For that, we must completely make them understand the nature of the ashram, and also understand that it is our effort until the end. That is the ashram. Our effort until the end means, reaching each dharma through this karma, and that merit and the luck in it mixing in their lives, and imparting that life to this land. Thus, the father and mother together mold children suitable for the world. This is our goal.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
The Karma Theory of Sanyasa Diksha
Regarding sanyasis, the convention is that if sanyasis leave home, they should not go back home later. We do not know what the truths behind this are. I am telling a subject that I have understood.

The assumption that if sanyasis leave home, they will automatically get the quality required for a sanyasi is not correct. Whether male or female, if a sanyasi leaves home and starts living in a way without time connection, do you have the right to demand their quality? As for me, it has not come to me like that.

The assumption that the quality of a sanyasi came somehow is also wrong. Sri Shankara came home when his mother died. Then others left the house. This is an ignorance brought about in the Hindu system. What is the intention behind saying that a person shouldn't enter the house even if his own mother dies? Similarly regarding the father. If one moves away in the state that there is no right even on parents, then what is the field called human relationship?

Leaving as a renouncer. Having a father and mother entitled to a karma that allows one to leave like that. What is that? They can be good, they can be bad, they might have sown destructions in many ways. But isn't it dangerous to fill with prohibitions in the nature of a system? If this family doesn't know the reason why this son or daughter left, perhaps if those souls do not have the right for liberation or release, how will they know? If a fault has occurred because of this, how will they know? This is a trick done to play with people who do not know all this.

What I have to say about this is this. Taking Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga, and Kali Yuga, these three times, saying Kali is in the Shudra, they reject it. When the fourth part comes for the Shudra, we should know what it is. One might feel if all this wasn't done out of a single stubbornness that this shouldn't be known. We must think about this.

The Shudra class as a whole is considered the nail of ignorance. He has no information about anything. If a Shudra says sanyasi, says he is going to become a sanyasi, they have seen it as the complete triumph of ignorance. Once I heard with my own ears someone saying that when a person went to become a sanyasi (from the Shudra class), he walked around as a fat scoundrel and now says he is going to become a sanyasi. Another one says, when ruined without means to eat and wear and becoming nothing, one should go lie in some wayside inn and die. This is what is assumed as part of sanyasa. If sanyasa is copied from his hands, how will it be?

If you go to Ochira Padanilam or Chengannur, you can see a hundred of such people. They are all living like sannyasis doing whatever they can. Nobody knows the meaning of this. It is not at all right for life to turn into sannyasa when there is no means to live. Sannyasa should not come like that. Believing that a sannyasi is a beggar, keeping them ignorant, they have become an insult among the people. So anyone can say anything. There are people who deliberately walk around thinking that they can say anything to those who wear saffron or practice like that. What ignorance has spread in this society? How will you change this? You are sharing a dangerous situation.

Suppose the greatest sannyasi enters your house. Actually, no such sannyasis will come. It is difficult for them to come. Perhaps, when desiring an ascetic life, if he wanders and enters based on the word received to walk out, and if your mind's perception is like this, does that house need any other reason to be ruined?

Similarly, there is a group of people who say that father and mother have sent their children for sannyasa. They were not sent. He himself left the house. After being useless to the land and home for a while, he came wearing the saffron of a sannyasi. Will he become a sannyasi? What is the use of becoming a sannyasi like this? Sannyasa does not come running like that. Sannyasa does not come like that. Such a sannyasa is absolutely a fourth-rate nonsense.

When it is said that the dharma of Kali is in the Shudra, you might have assumed that Shudra is a caste. No. There are four varnas--Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra. Among these, the Vaishya and the Shudra have been handled in an absolutely useless manner. Eighty-four percent of India is Vaishya and Shudra. Hasn't it been portrayed that these eighty-four percent of the people lead a worthless life?

Someone left the house for sannyasa. You have no knowledge about them. If they live carelessly, that life too will wander and bring ruin to that house. What will happen to that house if he does not act right? Walking along the road claiming sannyasa is not good. The house will be destroyed. What to say to those who talk about sannyasa without knowing any of this?

There are those who take up sannyasa when father, mother, and children quarrel. This is not sannyasa. Sannyasa comes on its own by the grace of God, by the power of a virtue acquired through long periods of penance. That virtue is exhausted according to the time given by God.

Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dwapara Yuga, Kali Yuga--in this, the fourth quarter, Kali Yuga, is completely destroying the manifest dharmas. What is it that stands manifested? This manifest greatness is entirely seen, in Kali Yuga, among the Shudra class.

Whether beaten to death or dead, there is a custom among us to cover them with a saffron cloth, bury them and call it samadhi. When any of the children belonging to this becomes rich, a blessing will come upon him. It is the place where his grandfather or grandmother attained samadhi. Then he will take a stone and worship it. When these rich children come, it will become a temple. Then it becomes a family temple. What will happen to all these scoundrels who develop this family temple? If a child is born in it, who truly wants to live as a human being, he will be made to do some work and brought to a state of karma where he cannot survive. How many people who were ruined this way have come right here! This corrupts girls the most. Boys may sometimes learn to do things for themselves. Therefore, you should not do this dangerous act. Whatever sorrow comes to these girls, they will go and lie down and cry at this grandmother's samadhi. Is God buried there? These girls get born in the place of the soul that has died and gone destitute by crying like this.

Another special thing is happening south of Thiruvananthapuram. They call this too by the name of sannyasa. Melankodu Yakshi. She will wander the whole world and cause trouble. A number of them came here with this trouble. It is not known how they came to know of this place. They came at a time when no one knew about this ashram. About fifty people possessed by this demonic force came here at the same time. When I started changing it, a lot of its trouble came here too.

Why am I saying this? These are all ignorances created by us due to our own ignorance. Having created God for caste, then God for each family, acting arrogantly on a personal level, conducting worship, and learning to live in disorder, how will these demonic entities be when they die? Those houses will become houses ruined by birth or death. More than birth, that house will be ruined by death. A misfortune will come where girls cannot be raised in that house. Or if a girl is brought to that house, she will either be one who makes money by selling the family, or this girl will not be able to live there. I am familiar with some such houses.

Thus, claiming fake sannyasa, people who have no karma sannyasa and who left home desiring to live without working will arrive at that house. Anyone can guess what will happen to this house. Most houses in places like Palakkad and Vaniamkulam have been destroyed like this. If you inquire about some houses in Pattambi, they tell the history of those who went seeking sannyasa like this.

They are not going in search of sannyasa. Like watching a play without knowing the story, they are a group who set out thinking they can beg and eat when they have no means. They just set out using the name of sannyasa for that. Houses destroyed by learning Kalarippayattu and making people live like thugs are also like this. This is the paradise of fools who set out to reform the world. What all disasters might have happened to the world from all this? But these families will also have small religious beliefs. But their inside is something else.

If a hundred houses are examined, at least thirty are houses like this. They do not end up here knowingly. There are households that justify however men and women live. For them, what their own children do is never wrong. They will not correct them either. They will go out and praise them. This is something many people have told me themselves. In truth, he is not fit to be let into the house. Who will you become through the karmic destiny of giving birth to, living for, and making such a child live? If this is taken lightly, it will become an act of ruining the house entirely. If the children are useless, say that they are useless. You should not do the job of destroying the existing life by speaking highly of them. I am sharing something I have experienced and grieved over. Our life is lived according to the core of ignorance that extends up to Kalarippayattu and the shrine where martial arts are practiced.

There is a shrine near Vakkom. There is a heap of iron weapons there. They have been placed for the deity's oracle dance. How did this parampara of such ruined ignorance come about? There are two such places. One is Velivilakam. A place where God is revealed and dances. If we look at the members of this family, we will understand its effect. It was when I thought about why this family dances with such mistakes despite having so much education and knowledge that I understood its reason. These are things I could understand by experiencing and thinking about them.

These are some kind of gods of this time. Or the gods of the sufferings we have accumulated. Otherwise, we cannot call it the glory of goodness. This is the remainder of our dancing in the name of God. If one of our men or women gets into a trance, the elder of that house will go and inquire about the matter. This is all an excess of ignorance. Manifesting this, the god dances and speaks.

Our land has lived in such an ignorant manner. Not just the land, the whole world. I know the tricks shown by the ghost named Kalliyankattu Neeli. When entering fairly reputed families in Thiruvananthapuram, what we see is a cat's head being worshipped. We see the slavery of the stuff that ruined life there. What can be done if this does not leave you? All the children born through this are those who live by citing caste. Then, since citing caste is not fashionable, it has been modified into another form. If they see that they can get something, they will impersonate and swindle money.

What was the reason for this original mischief to spread? When Sri Shankara entered the house at the time of his mother's death, why did these priests leave? Therefore, this body could not be lifted alone. They cut this body into pieces, placed a camphor block on each wound, laid them out one by one, and set them on fire. Others stood far away and watched.

If sannyasis enter the house, others will leave. Who taught this wickedness? It is the mother who gave birth to such a great man. When it is said that there is no one to bury her when she dies, how do we understand this? Being ignorant fools, an ignorance that does not share even a drop of love. What does this Shudra class, who invented all this, do? Loving in the name of community. This ignorance invited destruction. And a big language for it too. Splitting hairs and reading accounts. It is the uselessness of dirty words.
Citing caste and getting accounts settled with the government. Without any shame to say all this, living like animals. You will not like it when I say this. I cannot say this to please you.

You have assumed that one who goes for sannyasa is a tramp, a beggar. A sannyasi will never come before you. If you can see sannyasa with greatness, that is your luck. A sannyasi is a bhikshu. Everything will come to the place where a bhikshu sits. Good and bad will come. Ancestors who died and stand as ghosts will enter some body and come to the place where this bhikshu sits and die. I have experienced this in many ways. I am speaking from that experience. A woman came here, jumped into the well, and died. That was the last attempt of those trying to kill me. People tried to kill me, tried to set me on fire, framed me in a theft case. I somehow escaped from all this.

Why is all this conducted? These ghosts standing as inner controllers will stir up all these people. What have these ghosts shown to Sri Shankara? When Vivekananda sat in meditation, this ghost came and said that his mother had died. You say Vivekananda is great, nothing can be done near him. The next day when he sat in meditation, they came again. Why did you lie to me? We did not lie. You told me that my mother died. Who are you? Who are we? What is our job? All this itself. Vivekananda should offer a sacrifice in his mother's name. They must accept that sacrifice. This is the fraud.

If anyone comes to do any good thing, this is the experience. Why was Jesus killed? To justify this, another lie has been brought up. That sins were washed away in the blood of Jesus. So you think that by killing all the good people, all sins can be washed away in their blood? What foolishness! We are the owners of the ignorance that carries and stabs this kind of fraud. Killing the great Jesus washed away the sins. What foolishness! What to say to the people who stand ready to carry such a huge misery?

Thus the history of each great man--Dayananda Saraswati, Buddha, Sikh Gurus--what all they have endured and brought about, even if it is after their time. I have nothing to say to those who say that goodness will be achieved by sharing the misery in this caste and praising it by carrying it high.

If caste evils and class evils are to go from our midst, the grace of God itself must be there. We could not achieve that grace even after bringing so many of these great men. Sri Krishna was born in a royal family. From the beginning, the father and mother of Krishna, born in a royal family, were in prison. Seven were killed. The eighth was Krishna. They didn't get him. When the circumstances are like this, is it right to describe the blue-complexioned one all over the country?

How did such a destitute familiarity come among these Hindus? What is the ability of the intelligent men who could make you dance, sing, and jump in such an incompetent manner? As long as we fail to understand this path, we will not know what parental duty is, how to turn it into karma, or what the guru-disciple relationship is. You have a karmic destiny of educating your children and marrying them off when they cross twenty years. While this karmic capacity remains, if you become the tails of a doctrine caught in the defect of karma, developing a karmic course just to earn money by growing whatever culture and injustice passed down from any country? A mother died because a child got fewer marks. Then how bad have you become? If this child studies, gets more marks, and then dies, what will you do? Where are you living, living as donkeys without recognizing karma and forgetting your role as father and mother? Even if all these people study and come, the job is within the fence. You should not teach like this and make the land and home devoid of people. When you do this to your children, what won't you do to the world!

God gave us knowledge to get rid of all this ignorance. I am not talking about sannyasa. This is not sannyasa. How you should be to become householders. I have arranged everything for that here. I am speaking the pain of a house that does not care for the house. Yours is a status of seeking salvation by worshiping a ghost that died mad. That is, the karmic defect we have completed worshiping belongs to the ancestral generation. Each of the children born in the zodiac of that karmic defect is. The father and mother must try hard to change that. How has your ability been equipped for that? A woodcutter will say, no matter how much I struggle, I will raise my children like Nehru's children. What to say to him. Similarly, both father and mother will educate them, make them climb the steps, raise them worthless for money, and place them before the world. He will walk the world, do all sorts of foolish things, and get destroyed. Whichever house he enters, he will destroy. Wherever he stands, he will destroy. You are raising and sending out such children. And then you will praise them. Ignorance of this level has grown and stands mature in the midst of your household dharma. An opportunity given by God to bring a change to this is being utilized here. How is that? Whoever is ready to absorb this idea, the defect of his ancestors is being removed. Then you are making those ancestors do good. It is by looking at the merits and demerits of these ancestors that your children are married off. Here they don't look whether the boy matches, the girl matches, the father matches, or the mother matches. If there is any child in that house destined to be born to these ancestors, it should be born to them. The karma for that is what is done here. How much can you struggle in this karma that God is waiting for? The karma being done and made to be done is to give direct liberation to those who have been beaten to death and kept aside. That is, to ancestors like goddesses, gods, sages, and sannyasis.

If you have noticed one thing, you will understand. Children born after the fire at Guruvayur have more intelligence. Did you, their parents, have the intelligence at their age that children under twenty-five have now? These children are absolutely useful to you. You should think about how this should be useful to you and how you should take it. The fire at Guruvayur was twenty-five years ago. You will know other things regarding it later.

I am telling you the things that pained me. What pained me is for a result to come through your children that you will not get even if you all suffer together. It is something decreed by God. You must inquire and know it. Children born in any world, in any religion, in any caste, in any house after the fire at Guruvayur, they are entitled to good intelligence. Thus, when some eight or ten Jupiter cycles pass, a century changes. The situation then will not be like what we see today. Thus, when some three hundred and fifty years pass, Kerala and India will come to the forefront in the world. God is helping us for that. You must be careful about it. God is measuring and letting it out like this in front of you. Thus, not only in Kerala, but children born in any part of the world, this will come forward through them. The world will know this idea through them. It is as the beginning of such a karma that we are now performing the karma called Sannyasa Deeksha here.

What is the karma called Sannyasa Deeksha? The Namboothiris say that family members should not come, should not touch, should not see. That is not right. Family members must come, they must know, they must do good for it. Otherwise, their family will be destroyed. You don't have to be great for this karma. God will give you greatness. You are seeking virtue in the part of that knowledge. The measure and weight of that virtue are coming to your grandchildren. Then all the acquired virtues of the world are being passed on to the world through your children. This is the subject happening here under the name of Sannyasa Deeksha. This is for householders, not for sannyasis. You must understand this.
Guruvani
