September 1999
Take care not to break the staff of resolve

Some people, individually or collectively, often get a desire to improve their lives. For some, this is a way of escape. Some people, after earning a lot, giving, and receiving, see some deficiency in life. They are the ones who set out seeking the reason why this deficiency comes like this. Apart from this, people who have acquired virtue through good deeds may have a determination to make their own lives blessed, or to do at least a part of whatever they can do in the concept of God for the people, contemporaries, and those yet to come. There are those who think that there is such a world of savings and that we have a part to play in this scheme of karma. Whatever we do, even if one is a perfect sannyasi, we have to leave this body (cage). When leaving the cage, what fortune was earned inside that cage? What were our good deeds? What all exists in it? What is the part we can play in the scheme of karma we have accepted? We should become a saving object for our own size, or for ten, a hundred, or a thousand people. What is the qualification for this? We must think about this too.

The effort practiced for a long time according to the dharma of the era, is the effort continuing through the times when one did not even know how to wear a cloth, did not know how to inquire, or did not even know whether clothes were needed or not. That has come through food, clothing, and civilization, and today we have reached many stages. Even the material and the spiritual have come refined.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition September 1999
Atmospheric Pollution

Whether what our ancestors have done and established is true or false, it is justice. How did we behave in this? The fourth period is Kali. When we say Kali, we have assumed it is a period of ignorance, or the period of the ignorant one. This assumption is entirely wrong.

There is a thing called the four Vedas divided for four periods. The person who divided it like that is called Vyasa or Krishna Dwaipayana. Anyway, this knowledge has amazed us. How can we celebrate the dharma of this Kali anymore?

Saying Kali is in the Shudra, they have acted in a way that Shudrahood can never be changed. When it was said Kali is in the Shudra, some felt they were great people and some felt they were the worst people. Some felt like a group of a subjugated class.

What is the dharma of Kali? The other three periods have operated and passed. If any shortcomings occurred in what operated like that, Kali and its inheritor, the Shudra, are the ones to clear that shortcoming. For that, the Shudra must acquire knowledge. The Shudra who acquires knowledge like that becomes the authority of Satya Yuga as well. No one will simply become an authority. One must acquire the intelligence, ability, and capability for it. It must be in the knowledge according to a divine decree. It is because this system of God is not known that Kali has been made out to be bad. The whole world is spreading this ignorance and it has become a flawed karma. That flaw has come over many periods. To be exact, that flaw is twenty-five Chaturyugas old. Therefore, it is impossible to calculate this. Even if you go to the moon and study, it is impossible to calculate this. The duration of one Chaturyuga is twelve thousand divine years. One divine year is three hundred and sixty-five human years. How can this be calculated?

We live on earth and will leave our bodies on earth itself and go. We are learning things up to that point. We learn each thing, small and big, day by day. First, we pray, respect, honor each other, and it is a great karma of practicing an ashram character towards those who teach us, parents, and gurus. Through that karma, we ourselves can master a few things. What comes next is a vast knowledge that we divide and learn with home, land, and country after we grow up. That knowledge is what we must develop materially and spiritually. Showing mischief and dancing as an oracle for that knowledge should be done carefully. Anyone who has stayed in an ashram for even one day will understand that this is useless by seeing all this. If those who have experience staying in an ashram dance as an oracle joining them, they will become worse than the others. Because they will do all sorts of unnecessary tricks to win over them. By that itself, they will become bad and become useless to the country.

The ashram and what is learned in the ashram is to resolve and complete all the shortcomings in our home, all the shortcomings in the country, through our intelligence, hardship, sacrifice, and karma. This is the primordial knowledge acquired from the ashram. That is not sannyasa. Coming, believing, and staying in the ashram is not for taking sannyasa. It is to learn through life. That is what kings in ancient times did. It is said that even Sri Krishna studied in an ashram. The ashram is such a great institution for people like Sri Krishna to study.

‘Aa’ shramam (That effort) is the ashram. The core part of every ashram is to accomplish that effort. Passing on mutual love, respect, and humility in what is being accomplished, acting in a way that brings goodness to the world. That is the education gained from the ashram. Other than this, there is no use in making it seem like I went to the ashram, studied Vedas, studied Vedanta, studied singing and dancing. All these mentioned can be obtained everywhere.

After starting to do the prayer currently done in Santhigiri without fail, there is a release from all kinds of difficulties. During the time when we were following the Trimurti system, we got results initially. Later on, mistakes started happening. Including curing diseases, nothing became effective. This prayer mantra was received by speaking for two people. It was received in Varkala itself. But since my name comes in it, I didn't allow it to be chanted. But an instruction was received that it should be chanted and strengthened. I told this information to Pattani Swami. Then Swami said, you won't understand what it is now. The time will come when it will be understood. It will be fully understood only after your time. This is for the world. It was in nineteen seventy-three that I became convinced that this Akhanda Namam is the most correct. The realization is that nature had precautions regarding this much earlier. There are people here today who have been doing the prayer without fail since the beginning. But most people haven't understood why this is being done. There are many reasons for that. Most people have heard that prayer means just a glance of a god or goddess is enough, and everything is done. Another thing is the knowledge of being satisfied with making vows or offerings and doing an inner pooja for one day and a closed pooja for one day.

When we say a closed pooja for one day, there are plenty of temples in Kerala that do this considering it the greatest. Such temples exist in Travancore at places like Thiruvananthapuram, Vaikom, Ettumanoor, and in Malabar starting from Kodungallur up to Kasaragod. Parasurama temples are also included in this. Built as huge temples, filled with four-sided enclosures, outer enclosures, and plenty of decorative works, we or those more knowledgeable than us do not know why this is done. Our ancestors, or consider them Kshatriyas themselves, they also do not have the authority over the Vedas. Just to show that authority. Those with authority are called royal preceptors.

A trick has been played here to unite us using the Vaishnava system, Shaiva system, and Shakta system. Humans will not unite like that. Because all three have come in three different natures. What is needed for uniting is a knowledge. What knowledge can be gained from this which has been decorated and turned bad, going on with songs, dances, plays, and clamor? Let's take Kathakali itself now. It has been decorated as the identity of Kerala. From the knowledge copied from it, calling each section and each sub-section by different names, dividing it into Theyyam dances and various folk arts, and with even governments encouraging it, to what extent have we grown, what have we taken, what have we been able to see? Has anyone got a chance to even think about this? Or even if thought about, a great bad period where we cannot unite has bound everyone and turned them towards the path of destruction.

We all know the dharma called Sanatana. But what is Sanatana, what is Hindu--unable to distinguish this, we are confused. Sanatana means to act knowing the times. But we do not know what this time is. We also do not know how to carry it forward. Satya Yuga went according to its merit. From Treta Yuga, we have been acting and suppressing it like the karmic destiny of origin.

We are the ones who have come through so many ages. How much time do we have in this birth? What can we study within this time? Is what has been crossed through so many ages a subject that can be studied and finished? The subject we must study for this is Kali Dharma. The dharma of Kali is not something that should turn into caste or religion. It is a good aspect that should happen to the whole world in human dharma. However much they try to suppress this in the name of freedom or anything else, we should look at the changes in the last fifty years. Especially, we must evaluate the intelligence of children over the last twenty years. Whether it is good or bad, their intelligence is greater than ours. This can be understood in a visible way in two-to-three-year-old children. Even with so much change visibly happening, we have been made to believe that Kali is bad and Kali is destruction. This situation has been served to the whole world. How will we change this perception? Most people assume that we cannot change it. We can change it. This is what we must work for. If we cannot change this, what is the benefit for the future generation because of us?

Within the last twenty-five Chaturyugas, how many crores of Mahatmas themselves have come. They themselves could not change themselves or change others according to Kali Dharma. Then what about the condition of ordinary people? Worshipped in a misguided way as demonic or divine, millions of souls that have died off and stand like a flood disaster are in the atmosphere today. That stands as atmospheric pollutions. The disaster of this atmospheric pollution affects all of us equally. We are talking about the human world here. I do not know how many of us know a part of such knowledge. It is when this situation persists that I say this can be changed. This is a big subject.

If we speak about the knowledge of our ancestors, do they have the karmic capability to state an account of ten, five thousand, or ten thousand years? How can we tell them how the karmic destiny of the Yuga has reached dharma and stands? What is called the karmic destiny of the Yuga exists as long as life exists. In which way can this be changed? You must pass on this knowledge to your little children as well. Do not push the children growing up in front of you into the knowledge of the past where you grew up. For children under twenty or twenty-five, regardless of whether they are male or female, caste or religion, a change must be brought about that helps everyone reach goodness. Crores of souls who lived on earth with a life span of under a hundred years, committed karmic defects, and returned, stand as this atmospheric pollution. That is not a pollution of a thousand or ten thousand years, but there are pollutions of twenty-five Chaturyugas itself. Even if we have to face some difficulties and hardships, we can change this pollution. There is a grace given by God here for that. That is not for one caste, one religion, or one dharma. If one dharma is completed, what will we do with the other? Kali is completely a time given to make that possible. This truth is what I have seen and experienced through my life. God has allowed to settle this Kali Dharma. Take this up so that an ability to act upon it reaches everyone, to settle it through your children growing in front of you. No matter how much you burn and suffer, you cannot remove this acquired special pollution from them. If you can believe this as a great dharma, that is the greatest fortune.

Everything we have seen and heard in the world so far is just a procession of the miraculous deeds of entities from demons to gods. The oracle dancing that shows trials is one such thing. I am recalling the things told and shown directly to me by those possessed by gods and goddesses at Santhigiri in Varkala. A woman possessed by a ghost named Madurai Meenakshi, and another ghost of the same state and weight--Kalliyankattu Neeli. People of South Travancore usually call this Yakshi. There are numerous tombs of this same nature. If you go in front of all these and think carefully, these demonic forces will come forward, speak some words of homage externally and internally, make some special kind of sounds, and make us hear things we have never thought of or heard of. They will accurately tell things done in some past time that we do not remember, karmas done by ancestors, and that this is our presiding deity. If it is a believer of a prophetic religion, it will take two words from what the prophet said and speak illustrating it. All these are antics shown by a ghost that has no knowledge or ability in that direction. If it is a ghost with some knowledge, then nothing needs to be said.

If this is the case concerning a ghost, we will not even be able to understand the things said by a soul that has passed in the state of a god and a sage. The reason for that is the ignorance about the essence of the four great sayings (Mahavakyas) that came through a preceptor in the lineage of Manu. Aham Brahmasmi, Ayameva Brahma, Ayamatma Brahma, Tat Tvam Asi—the humans who think about how these four sayings came or how they were implemented are few. Then what can be done in the part of the knowledge created by a group of scholars who have no knowledge at all?

In this way, mixed with right and wrong coming through ages, having become gods, goddesses, and sages in many yoga-jnana systems, it is impossible to express how many souls there are. It is also not possible for man to recognize and act upon all this. The Brahmarakshas that came to disrupt Vishwamitra's yajna during the time of Sri Rama, and the story told in the Ramayana caught in Hanuman's magic of Siddhis are just a few examples. They tell of an incident where Hanuman brought Marunthuvazhum Mala (Maruthwamala). A soul like this will appear in front of a good devotee and say that a certain thing will happen in a certain way. It will happen truthfully as well. When four or five such things happen truthfully, is it surprising that he feels an ego himself? He has truthfully seen the cause of the dosha.

There are not ten, two thousand, or four thousand of such, but crores of souls in this atmosphere. We must understand that standing in the atmosphere, they can mislead the children who are born and growing up in any way they want. Hanuman Seva, the magical powers of gods and goddesses, and the Siddhi systems of sages are all these paths. Any human who follows these paths will go astray. The truths seen immersed here and there in the history of Sri Rama are parts of this going astray. Are Rama Tirtha and Shirdi Sai bad people? There is a popular story among Christians that when water was scooped up in a cupped hand, a pit appeared in the water to that measure. One can easily guess what will happen if such things enter a mind that preserves even small things as big.

Such matters of knowledge and powers are happening abundantly not only in India but all over the world. These are all things that always happen among humans. Whether believed or not, people attach very great importance to these matters.

Agni Kavadi, Garuda Kavadi, and Manushya Kavadi are some of the celebrations popular among Hindus, right? There are people possessed by gods and goddesses who take huge chains heated like glowing embers, wrap them around their bodies, dance, and show miracles. If all this is an application exerted on a human body, what can one do but be surprised? Our knowledge considers this as a great divinity. Walking on water and walking inside fire are applications like this. How will a rationalist who goes around preaching logic know the inner urge of this? Why didn't A.T. Kovoor, who lived amidst all these happenings in Ceylon, change these magical powers? Wouldn't it have been better to change all this right there rather than coming to India and giving speeches? What can be said other than that this is worse than bursting firecrackers in front of deaf people?

I remember seeing such a subject in person. An occasion where some pooja is taking place in my family temple. The priest there is an oracle who comes from a kilometer away. He blessed and then slashed his own face with the sword he held, and the flesh hung down. When others tried to take him for treatment because the flesh hung down, he did not agree. When he came outside the temple, the face where the flesh had hung down from the cut remained as it was before. Seeing this, who wouldn't feel surprised.

Another thing, they take a large spear and first thread a string through it. The other end will be pierced through his cheek. Then it is given to the next person's hand. He will also pierce a lemon, pierce his cheek, and give it to the next person's hand. I have seen three or four people standing pierced on a single spear like this. This mostly happens in Subrahmanya temples. The setup that shows 'our God' is like this. What all will a mere illusionist show in front of us! Who doesn't know that there is no great good or small good because of this?

The manifestation of God that has been happening among us for many ages is like this. What should we do, how should we go? If the one who stands and dances like this dies, he too becomes a ghost, a severe ghost. This ghost will stand in temples, mosques, and places where tombs are located, and show many things. It will only seem to be true. On Thursdays and Mondays, if you go to Nagore Dargah, Beemapally, and the tomb of Peerukannu Sahib in Thuckalay, from six o'clock till three o'clock past midnight, it is all dancing and jumping. After three o'clock, they will stop. Or if they show anything after that, it is physical antics, it is a lie. Ignoring all this, do philosophers and elite scholars think that if they fill pages writing, all this will end? Saying that none of this exists will not end it, nor will sitting around claiming it exists make one a Jnani. Because these are special qualities that remain filled as atmospheric pollution. This will not change just by walking around giving speeches. This will completely subside only in front of a Jnani. That Jnani will not show any dancing or tricks. If you go to a Jnani, this will end. If you go to a Jnani, without doing anything, this ghost will slowly wear away and disappear after some time. But if that family does not respect it, either it will come back exactly the same. Or something of the same nature will come.

Crores of such demonic entities stand as atmospheric pollution. This is the state of the world. If this enters the body strongly for a few days continuously, he will behave like a madman without stable intelligence. When this comes and matures many times, they will bite and tear their tongue, lips, and teeth and die. Can any rationalist, scholar, or philosopher say that this does not exist? Can doctors who nurse the sick do it?

It is this ghost that caused Sri Krishna to be killed, and caused the Prophet to lament saying, 'Alas, Jinns rule the world.' It is a fact known to religious scholars and theoreticians that the Prophet then had no choice but to do penance for three months and give up his body. We have nothing to gain by establishing that all this exists, or does not exist. We should at least have the knowledge to say that such things will not change.

Tetanus (rheumatism that bends like a bow) is one of the many disasters caused by demonic entities. This happens when epilepsy matures. Mostly, these kinds of diseases exist in the houses of great people. When this comes into the bodies of some children and a little time passes, they become blind. It is because of this that whether male or female, they become deaf and mad, and have to live with symptoms of madness until they die. This can be seen abundantly in children living now. Then what is the benefit of rationalism and salvation-ism?

These kinds of patients are mostly seen in foreign countries. When all these die, who knows where that soul will go? Understanding what all diseases these cause in humans while standing in this atmosphere, I wish they would at least stop the arguments about whether these exist or not.

When such ghosts increase, there is a tendency among people to dismiss it as madness and lunacy. The mentally retarded mostly seen in doctors' houses, the antics they show because of it, the disproportionate swelling of the head—none of this will respond to treatment even when small. Or if it responds, it can only be called God's help. Others will only roll that head until the end. What justification do the great uncle, the rationalist, and the scholar have to say about this?

These are the disease natures residing in the children in the houses of very big capitalists. Take care not to pass on this wealth to the coming generation and destroy them. If you happen to read this note of denial written to highlight the lineage of ignorance, you should think. Looking at the children who dress up as father, uncle, husband, and wife showing heroic valor in a big way, do you think it will change if spoken in a scholarly manner calling them scoundrel, thief, lowly, or 'is this a Bhadrakali'? Fools say that these lowly souls growing up and completing in modern civilization is civilization. We should all think what name to call this human who is raised as a tiger or a lion by ignorant, despicable-natured intellectuals who have learned to deny whatever they see.

For this, there is only one thing we can get by God's grace. Try to absorb the truth that exists without denying it by saying it exists or does not exist. If we see any such nature, we should obey the great one who has informed us in the nature of Jnana. There is only one way for that mistake shown through Sri Rama, Sri Krishna, Rama Tirtha, Jesus, and the Prophet to leave our midst. That has been said here. That is, to remove atmospheric pollutions, you who have come as contemporaries of the great man who is a Jnani, maintain a guru-disciple relationship with that great man. There are many things for you to understand through such a guru-disciple relationship.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
What is targeted through the householder's stage of life

If father and mother raise children without thinking about how the householder children, the children who are going to be married off, or the children who are going to be brought in through marriage should be, they will fall into the mistake I mentioned earlier. No one can save them. No harm should come to our family because of them. You should know at least that karma. If they go somewhere and act nonsensically, can you reform them to this level? Along with that, one should desire to see them as a mother of the world and a father of the world with more goodness than our own mother. This is our goal. You should not travel away from this goal. If there are any bad karmas in what you have done until today, they will end, and along with that, the knowledge that God has bestowed all kinds of goodness upon us, you must raise them as children who are ready to act in a way useful to the land, home, and country and give it to the world. This is what is to be said about a householder's dharma.

The story of this guru-disciple relationship from a thousand births ago, the story of the vision, God is giving this knowledge to various parts of the world, including the one who saw it sitting on the other side of the earth. Those who have not seen this place before come after seeing it from their place. So many people came here, saw, and left. Looking at South India alone, there are over four hundred people who have seen it enough to say that this is true. Such a thing growing through you, growing through your children, the effort you should make is capable of giving the fortune of this virtue to the children of the world. If you do not understand this karma, if it is not useful, what will I give you? For that, I will scold you as much as I can. That is my ability. I have not praised you till now. I have said that there are no bad humans like you. Who am I to have the guts to call you and sit you down and scold you like this?

In what beggarly manner have this father and mother raised their children. You, being a householder, should not think that it is enough to just live somehow. No matter how useless they are, there should be at least some use to another person because of your children. You need not put any other justification. You need not look at good and bad or anything. Only then can we change the face of this land of ours. Otherwise, keeping a mobile court on the road is not going to reform the country. When I say this, I cannot say it to please you. You are all scoundrels. If you are not scoundrels, would you keep this court on the road like this? Building all this danger, keeping it on the road, and bringing punishment there. Which fools' invention is all this? Is this what should be conducted in a land where humans live? You tell me what I should do with your children who have become so spoiled. I have experienced it and torn up the card.

What all you made me do for your land. What all I changed. Through that, goodness should come to the future generation. This god and goddess should be born as your children. This is the goal. Not just doing mere business here. You are being entrusted with such a karmic course. If you don't take it up, what will I do? I have said many things, I have done many things, I have made many things be done. But we haven't been able to use any of it to a stage of fruition.

There are people living in many systems of worship in the world. Are they all practicing this and going? They say God exists and does not exist in this world. Who knows? If it is like this for the great souls who did very great things, then why are we doing all this? This might be your thought. We shouldn't think like that. Regarding you, the first karma done before keeping you in this ideology is Guru Pooja. It is not said that by doing Guru Pooja everything is complete. That is a karma in the first step. After doing Guru Pooja, if you live without understanding the method taught from here, it can go into wrong later. Whether male or female, it will go wrong. Even if they don't explicitly speak against this, a misfortune will come where they cannot accept or take it. When ten, fifteen, or twenty years pass like this, those mistakes will spread to their children, and then they will turn into people who live without obedience. Or they will turn into children where the people are of no use to them and they are of no use to the people. They will start troubling each one. Saying they will trouble doesn't mean they are ones who fight, but if they borrow from someone when they have no means to live, then there will be no way to return it. Because they lived without knowing the story. They want to become rich quickly, or become something else. Therefore, you don't need any of this, live with what you have and come forward slowly. Your children won't become bad. No trouble will come. If that understanding is not firm in you, the one who joins you will be someone who grew up in some toddy shop. When you marry off your children, you should be careful that this doesn't happen. If he is poor, that is enough. Some may have some histories, lineages, and family prestige. But we don't have children in our hands who can be useful to us from all that; neither do we have the knowledge. No familiarity with predecessors. Regarding you, all this might be like a new knowledge.
The Vedic period is spoken about the time of Vyasa. So many Vyasas have come and gone. The time of the Vyasa we know now is not long ago. This Vyasa came close to Krishna's time.

The Veda is divided into four. These four Vedas are for the four periods. The Shudra class does not know that. However, the Brahmin knows it. They will not accept it. If accepted, the Vedic religion will be gone. Then they will not be able to stand in the world claiming to be Vedic. They will not allow such a situation to arise. Dayananda Saraswati and Vagbhatananda (not the Vagbhatananda known in Kerala) questioned this. Our people did not understand that. After that, it was Madhva who said this. There was no one in that society to take what Madhva said. Not saying there is even today. To make it appear that we are ahead of all other Vedic religions, they are celebrating in the name of Madhva with all decorations and all kinds of processions. Even its pontiff is hesitant to say that this is the truth of it. The karma they have accepted today is itself proof of that. They have held on to Vedic and taken control. What Madhva has said is not Vedic. He has said that it can be taken using Dvaita. One should not say Advaita.

When Advaita is mentioned, many doshas will occur there. It has been justified with a single word. Madhva's people made up many antics in it without understanding that. In Tirupati, they have closed the eyes, nose, and mouth completely and applied a full paste. If all this is closed and shown like this, what will the children who know nothing understand? There are many such doshas among us. We are handling it today in a way that even those who came to correct us cannot bear it.

Thus, all the human beings and great souls who have come so far have fallen into a trap. The experience of the Sikhs is no different. Whatever mistakes happened to the gurus or prophets who came to correct this, or the results of their hardships, have been twisted and established in another way, with religious scholars writing and recording that their religious doctrine is the greatest. How can we tolerate this?
Guruvani
Guru Jayanti Edition
September 1999
How many have seen the truth?

Where and how did the Dharma of the Hindu begin? Did that Dharma enter the Guru-disciple relationship and reach the disciple from the Guru? The Dharma of the Hindu was changed from the Manu system, brought to the Trimurti system, and started from there.

What is called Manvantara is a familiarity that is caught in human innate tendencies. It is Manu who brought all human innate cultures. That culture went wrong. In its place, some intellectuals functioned back then, just like today's intellectuals. That is the reason for the change in the Manu's rule. It even changed karma. We did not know this. Following that mistake, three Chatur Yugas remained inactive. One Chatur Yuga itself is twelve thousand divine years. So, after such a long period of three Chatur Yugas, how can we know the progression of time? Moreover, the calculation of time according to the Manu system was also lost.

We collectively say Hindus. From Chandala to Brahmin, they are Hindus. Where do each of these sections stand? We have not gained that knowledge. We did not get this knowledge because we did not get the account of the three Chatur Yugas that remained inactive. Blaming anyone will not fix this. Without getting the account of these three Chatur Yugas and not knowing what the time progression is, it became unknown where and how the Hindu system should begin. The Hindu system could not even explain the destiny of this Manvantara. That very mistake was repeated again and again.

When three Chatur Yugas remained inactive, it was the order of the Manvantara that remained inactive. Therefore, the way of life in the Manvantara was not understood. It has been made to start from scratch for us. This knowledge is given to us through vision (Darshana). Therefore, we must be very careful about the part where this vision is obtained.

Where did Darshana begin? It started in the forest. If we do not know its primitive nature from the beginning, we might say many things. What is called Darshana must be true. Because its transformation must be brought about through those who handle the Darshana. There were places back then where the sea and backwaters did not reach. Even the nature of the earth's surface was not like this then. What would human karma have been like in the early stages of the transformation that started from forests and fields?

Into how many continents has the earth changed today! Who cut the earth into such continents? Nature. When there was agitation from nature, the earth became continents, each section getting a culture. Each section magnified the culture they received. Each land bent to a culture and brought about a different kind of worship. The one who accepted worship from the forest got that culture. The one who got it from the sea got that culture. One who saw it from the top of a big hill imparted that culture. One who cleared a small circular area imparted culture in that way. This is a culture born out of a curse and agitation from nature because the original culture was distorted. That mistake came from Satyatranan. As a result, that lineage was lost. This is the foundation of all the troubles.

The Hindu doctrine came after overcoming this mistake. In this doctrine, considerable time passed without anyone to act directly. Thus it became impossible to transmit culture back and forth. How could it be transmitted? Back then, there was not even a vessel to cross a backwater. Therefore, people copied the culture they saw here and there. As this grew a little, and humans, like migratory birds, went back and forth and grew a bit, spreading it as culture, it became difficult to know what was right and what was wrong in it. Then they gave positions to individuals and made them kings. When they start ruling, they will summon the rascals, the rich, the scholars, and the poets in the land. The matters added according to their opinions later became the doctrine. Otherwise, this has no distinct history of its own. Everything is a mistake that happened to us in the absence of history.

We are taking this as the only thing. The share given by God is its foundation. There should never be any adulteration in this. Nothing that exists so far is non-existent. Everything does exist. We agree to its weight. But we are not going after it. If today's Brahmin does the work of a Chandala, where will we go searching? If today's Chandala discovers a new clown and comes through that, what will we do? There is something for us to think about in this. If we just go without thinking, the result will be repeating the old beatings. We should see both of these, and then we must master well how to carry forward the path we have received as divine without making mistakes.

Literature has come in two or three ways. Shakta, Shaiva, and Vaishnava. They are fiercely opposing each other. The part called Jñānamukham (Nānmukham) remains without gaining strength. Instead of Brahma, it is Nānmukhan who is supposed to impart the knowledge of creation. The literature here says that this face was pinched off. How can it be pinched? Will knowledge go away if pinched off? We must understand this with our intellect and see what karma we have received in the visionary planes of Jagrat, Svapna, Sushupti, Turiya, and Turiyatita. The doctrine says that the share received in this direct vision transformed into Jiva and Para in the parts called Panchabhutas, Panchendriyas, and Panchakoshas and functioned. How did it function without the calculation of these Chatur Yugas and without the knowledge of the progression of time? What about in the Kali Yuga? Why is Virinchan (Nānmukhan) not shown outside? Thus the Chatur Vedas ended.

The Nānmukhan who was handling the position of Brahma was sidelined, and the functions were carried out with the other three faces. If I don't say this, it will become my mistake. You who stand with me and work as my contemporaries may be poor, simpletons, good, or bad. But nothing but good should come from you. If it does, you, I, and the generations to come will have to function as successors to the past mistakes. Do not see this as a small matter; you must protect this karma by giving your life and flesh.

This is a vast subject. Science should not be lifted and placed on top of this. We have no connection with this science. We are creating a special science. How? We are holding onto the entire karmic capacity currently present. Only by holding onto this entire karmic capacity can we move forward. The Trimurti system, the position of Devendra, the position of Parashakti, the position of the Ganas, the twenty-seven stars—the karmic wheel created by these is what stands strengthened today.

It is said to be twenty-seven stars. Then how did so many stars come to be in this sky? This science has proceeded by ignoring these star clusters that cannot be counted based on the calculations discovered today. This calculation has not been introduced in any of the sciences belonging to these systems. This sage cannot cross over there either. He stands unable to cross. This is the Yogishwara! These souls are standing unable to cross this karmic capacity. These souls are standing as if life and karma are severed. How will we bring these souls to earth? This is our subject. The biggest subject of our life. The biggest of all the births we have taken.

Looking at our experience, God made us do many things. None of it was done knowingly. All the religious doctrines that have come so far have a foundation. Man can only function standing where the headquarters of this foundation is. However, a state of ignorance occurred to all of us regarding what happened in our outdated history. It happened in the west, east, south, north, everywhere. What we do not know is how this happened. Although the Hindus' calculation states a long period for the distance of this mistake, it is not mentioned accurately anywhere. What we see here and there are some things said together by the poets and seekers of respective times. The lack of magnitude of these created doctrines is the reason for our lack of awareness about it.

A great king is known as Vanavaramban. A king of the earth that stretches to the horizon when viewed from one place is Vanavaramban. An emperor is one who conquers four or five such kings. What knowledge can we get from a history confined within such a limited space? Similarly, the time span of history. If we look at Western history or the history that followed it, it does not speak beyond a history of ten thousand years. From this brief history, how can we understand the karmic course of this landmass that has travelled across many places?

Our history is a very long story. A history as old as the Manvantaras. How many Chatur Yugas are in a Manvantara? How many Yugas are in a Chatur Yuga? We have the complete calculation of its duration. No other doctrine can claim the clarity of this calculation. The doctrines here follow the practice where Westerners took this calculation written in Sanskrit from here, prepared a calculation as far as their thinking reached, and imported it back here.

For what purpose did this Sanskrit language come, and through which path? What all did it become the cause of here? We don't know this either. We have understood the one who has studied Sanskrit as a great scholar and a wise person. The status of divine language (Devabhasha) has also been attributed to that language in the Devanagari script. Whatever it may be, what is the reason for its glory to be lost?

Did each country, separated in various ways by rivers, streams, backwaters, and oceans, just break apart and separate like this for no reason? Anyway, it wasn't due to creative reasons. Because water still flows into the sea itself. There is no way for water to flow upwards from below. This water has flowed down by making various channels. What is the matter with this channel? So, we must understand that God created an opportunity for this to flow by making many kinds of channels. We also don't know how all the countries, divided into regions like Arabian countries and European countries, have been included stating some reason or matter. They said the earth is round, drew a map on it, and rolled it to show us. All this is correct indeed. But amidst this, there is an excessive amount of water lying like this—in all parts of the world. We do not know how this came about. This water is one of the damages that happened purely because our ancestors could not manage the progression and reclamation of time.

There is evidence to show that wherever the human society that has grown so far has settled down, they have maintained some capability, ability, and faith in God. It can also be seen if one examines the old records. But despite having so much karmic capacity, the Manvantaras slipped away from them. Why did the Manu lineage disappear from the midst of human society? We also say that it was Manu who created the original nature of the human lineage. A mistake happened somewhere. As a result, the spheres came to behave closely with each other. When spheres come close, something will happen due to their pressure. If a lot of water stagnates in one place, it has no option but to flow down. The ocean divisions we see are the result of such flowing. This phenomenon has occurred in all places. It has been pulled into a sphere and deposited inside it. This is the meaning behind the division into continents and countries. We cannot even think and complete what this process is. A historical truth giving such knowledge has not convinced us. Even if we take the account of ten thousand, twenty thousand, or a hundred thousand years, we will not get any information regarding this.

When coming to the calculation of the Manvantara, when it is said that the karma divided entirely into four periods has a distance of so many lakhs of years, is it something that ends in a day or two? If we have not received information about it, we must absolutely get it. What is the way to get it? The problem increases when we think like that. But we have no choice but to reclaim it.

The knowledge that God has given to the people of this world from time to time has come through Gurus, prophets, and visionaries. We cannot move on saying we have not seen them. No one can say that what they have said is non-existent. It is also a part of history that they have done and made others do things to the extent of their temporal prowess. We can even take some of its signs as true and see them. But this calculation has come in a way we cannot fathom. Therefore, you have not been able to take it as the truth.

What is Yugadharma? The Dharma when the Yuga changes. How has that been taught to us? Where has it been drawn and shown? We don't know any of this. Or if it has been drawn, it is wrong. In my place, all the mothers there travel long distances. There is a place called Chenganda nearby. Calling my mother, an old mother is saying, Karthiyayani, when I went to Chenganda and looked south, there is still more space. These mothers have raised us. This is what affects our country as a flaw. If these mothers raise us, how far will we see? We must clearly understand such a flaw. We have not been able to fill this gap to this day. However, saying that we haven't been able to today might be considered an accusation.

One science says that the parts of the vimana that existed during Sri Rama's time have not been fully discovered even today. Another science says no, they have been discovered. What is the thought behind the triviality that there is nothing left now? They went to the moon and brought back something from there and kept it. What more is there to get beyond that? We cannot blame them either. They are right in depth and knowledge as far as they have seen.

Where all did the statesmanship that came like this surpass us, and where all did it pave the way to destruction? Based on the calculations existing today, there is a lack of knowledge to explain any of this. How can we make this knowledge a witness? When four or five crores come in the name of great men, there will be two or four people who have seen the truth. How far can they themselves take it? They cannot do anything. Because travel facilities themselves were very limited until recently. When we hear in poetry about a Pushpaka Vimana in some era, it might seem like a vimana made of flowers (pushpam). Some sort of design was made. When seeing it, it felt like it was made of flowers. Who knows what kinds of metals existed then? When speaking about this metal, it is said they were familiar with a metal like a looking glass. Even if hit by a bullet, this mirror would not break. If such a worthy mirror existed then, we have not been able to see how much this would have grown as a nation.

This is a true distinction. Then what we look into is the era of the Acharyas, the Pandavas, and the Kauravas. We cannot even do a fraction of the karma they did. Because, caught in a karma that transformed into streams, rivers, backwaters, and oceans as mentioned earlier, an era ruled us in such a way that we could not gain the ability to think or know why we came to be like this. A situation affected us where we could not recognize anything beyond this era. Due to this, the karmic course we lived and learned entirely as strangers has created us. If we wish to know the truth from this, the language we discover when distinguishing between the Vidya and Avidya present in it will not be of use to us. Discovering both of these, Narayana Guru and the Ishavasya Upanishad say this—those who discard both and discover what Vidya is are the learned ones. Vidya and Avidya are not non-existent. They do exist. But what we can see in it is only the distinction we have learned to artificially create with the help of something. The reason for this is that intelligent people who stood behind or grew up like the Gurus of later times, who came and went during certain periods, have caused some troubles in between.

There is proof for this. There are ten avatars mentioned in the Hindu doctrine. There is a problem that Hindus do not know how many avatars there are. Catching everything seen, keeping them as avatars, and not knowing anything about these avatars. If Hindu doctrine has suffered such ignorance, can one criticize other doctrines? Because they have written and preserved an era according to the depth and magnitude of their doctrine. Hindus have not even been able to do that. The only assumption Hindus have is that there was some part of an old goodness, and someone picked it up and took it away, dividing the country into pieces.

This is not what we need to know today. If we do not see the past, we cannot say anything about what exists before us today and what is to come. Among the great men of the past, we value those who have money, capacity, and wealth. But that is not how it should be. A great man is one who preserves the greatness of life through birth up to its worthiness, and at that preserved point, tells us who each of us is, how we came here, and what we should do next. But we are completely strangers to this knowledge. Because there was a period when we couldn't even acquire the meager education that existed among us. That is a situation caused by the Varna Dharma system. When it was established that education could be done by one group and not by another, education itself became alien.

The theory of evolution that has returned due to the Varnashrama Dharma and the caste system that came through it is not in a manner we can accept. So, when finding and completing a distance within this solar system, the nine planets in the solar system cannot be completed. There are many solar systems. Only the matter of one solar system was mentioned there. Beyond all this, there is a place. A plane where everything has merged. Then there is nothing left to merge into it. That plane has been mentioned in some places—Vettaveli (the vast open space)! How can that Dharma be completed?

A System Beyond Thought

The system of governance existing today has come as a completion of a karma over ten Chatur Yugas. To this day, no idea has emerged to correct this system of governance. It should not be corrected except through an idea that has attained the qualification for it. There must be an idea with the permission of Brahma to correct it. Otherwise, there will be more trouble.

The existing nature of governance needs to change entirely. How this will happen is that by continuously reforming the affairs of governance, eventually a situation will arise where the government itself functions included in the divine will. Thus, the system of governance will change for all time. Not just for the system of governance, but the Chatur Yugas, the solar system, and the Manvantara themselves will undergo a change. This is a subject beyond intellect and thought. Therefore, no one will be able to comprehend it. Even the existing government will not be able to comprehend this. But such a system will come into practice within a hundred years.

Democracy was brought in saying that the supremacy of the people is what is needed. Because it was not corrected and taken forward according to the times, it went backward, and trouble occurred. A government that is beyond the distinctions of caste, religion, and race must be brought in. That is the broad vision regarding the functioning of society. It has to come through a specific path. That Guru Margam is not a Guru Margam that follows any single idea. It is a Guru Margam with the karmic capability to reclaim the idea of the Trimurti system that was completed over ten Chatur Yugas. Only this Guru Margam will have the ability to impart the consciousness of the progression of time to governments.

When a government endowed with the consciousness of the progression of time has ruled for a hundred years, this karmic governance will spread and stand in nature as a disciplined distinction accompanied by the commanding power of Darshana and Realization.

It will also correct the foresight that came mixed with the karmic flaws spread by the Chatur Yugas. It will also have the ability to mix and examine what the scholar and the scientific theoretician say and see what the truth is.

This will be a system of governance prepared by five or ten people sitting and thinking according to the will of Brahma. This will have a foundation of knowledge based on the logic of revolving around twenty-seven years, twenty-seven stars, like this. The Swamis, Siddhas, and theoreticians seen in the world have a certain knowledge. This will never accept that knowledge. Moreover, there will also be a visionary tradition to implement this over a long period.

This system stands isolated as a part described as beyond thought. Only an inter-planetary distinction according to the will of Brahma can create such a foundation. Neither the world governance methods existing today nor the people suited for it will be there then. Children born after every Vyazhavattam (Jupiter cycle)—every twelve years—will be the ones who become capable of taking it forward. By then, this will be theoretically corrected.

Manvantara is the ordained decree that comes inclusive of twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and nine planets. Dividing Manvantara into Chatur Yugas, the ability of a Jnani or a Guru Parampara should be to state how many Chatur Yugas make up a solar system. By preserving the Chatur Yuga as four periods, the Dharma of Kali must be determined.

Kali is a time meant not just for realization, but also for liberation. The karmic capability of the Chatur Yuga and the solar system is formed by harmonizing the vision, the word, and the light received by the will of God. Three solar systems combine to complete a Manvantara. The gurus of later periods, who completed karma by taking and applying the Chaturvakya (Aham Brahmasmi, Ayameva Brahma, Ayamatma Brahma, Tattvamasi) from the time they departed from the truth of the Manu lineage, did not get this knowledge. Many gurus who were their followers did not get it. This knowledge must serve the Guru Parampara henceforth. We have been informed that it will indeed come.

It is the Guru Parampara that comes for the light of times. If only one Guru wills it, the structure of change through light will not take shape in nature. We have been told that a Guru and Guru Parampara will come in all times to impart goodness according to the Yugadharma. The knowledge imparted by Santhigiri is the visionary part of that. Whatever the era, the government will have no choice but to accept this.

Life, Star, Solar System
Guru: It will take a human soul so many lifetimes just to cross one sky.
Disciple: Does the nine planets mean nine steps?

Guru: Nine states. You can call them steps. If needed, they are nine skies. It is the twenty-seven stars that are said in the Trimurti system as belonging to the sky. The earth has planets revolving around it. At the same time, we see crores of stars. All these stars are a description each. That is, each soul. This is what Vedantins call Yogishwara.

The Vedantin says Neti, Neti (Not this, not this). Merging and merging, it ceases to exist there. It doesn't just merge and disappear like that. He merged as far as he grew. Then he became independent and left, and he will shine there. This Yogi is not a Guru.
Disciple: Are the twenty-seven stars great souls?

Guru: That is the concept of Brahma. Rishi, Sanyasi, Yogi, Jnani, Bhakta—a Guru who has passed through like this and completed it. A star is one who has completed each of these. Haven't many people come like this since the world began? The one who comes as the Guru of later times is the one who has experienced all these things mentioned. The Yogi, the Jnani, and each such person are subordinate to the Guru of later times. None of them can cross over without submitting to the Guru of later times. All these stars belong to the Guru of later times.

Each star is coming as an inheritor to each Yuga. Star clusters! Seeing them standing in one place, when you go there, they are not there. This is this Neti, Neti they speak of. They don't have the fortune to reach there—this is the truth. Without fortune, how will they discover it? They can't. Then they will say it is not there. When you go there, it is not there. After a period of crores of years, it became complete. Then it became the inheritor of a solar system. Only these twenty-seven stars will come as inheritors to the solar system. We see crores of stars. It takes crores of years for it to reach our eyes. But none of them have names; they are not included in the calculation. Only twenty-seven stars are included in the calculation. This is the will of Brahma. Each star will be seen up to its own expanse. Only someone who comes in the measure of a Manvantara can speak about the expanse of these twenty-seven stars. Twenty-seven stars within a solar system.

Disciple: You said that the stars not included in the twenty-seven are not stars according to the will of Brahma, and that Yogis will not see them when they go there. Do they take birth? Do they get destroyed?
Guru: They will stay and get destroyed. Some are grieving and doing penance from there, thinking, I couldn't do anything.
Disciple: A star would have its own time period, wouldn't it?

Guru: It will. When leaving the sky within a solar system, it will change. The twenty-seven centrally standing stars have twelve zodiac signs and nine planets. When a soul acquires this, this star will change. By then, souls with the spiritual power of two thousand, three thousand, or four thousand years will not remain. That is why it is said that these souls will stand only up to their time.
Disciple: Then how do they come down?
Guru: That is something to be seen and known. Not something to be asked and known. The disciple must see and know where the Guru stands. It shouldn't be known by hearing.
Disciple: Does that mean the past gods, goddesses, and stars will change by themselves?

Guru: That is each state. There is no need to spell it out. It is each calculation. When each sky changes, they will also change. Take the earth itself. The earth is connected with twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and nine planets. Once a soul acquires this much, then that soul will not be seen there. Brahma is setting that soul aside from there. Then that soul is Brahma itself. It can be seen in all living beings. It then merges. Saying it is set aside means it is kept merged. When the time of need arises, Brahma will bring it back again. That is what Aurobindo is said to have seen. The part where he saw Sri Krishna bringing them. Twenty-seven stars are coming as twenty-seven great souls.
Disciple: When Brahma sends a soul, does a set belonging to that soul come here along with it?

Guru: Yes, they come like that. It will not always come. No one will be able to know how it is determined as belonging to Brahma. When you go into calculating this, it will be wrong. That is why they say science will go wrong.
Disciple: So will those who come along be complete like this?

Guru: Why should we know if it is like that? If you can see it, it is enough to know. These are all things that lead people astray. We shouldn't say any of this publicly. Now, I said it because you asked like this. If you grasp the power of one star, you can see all that. The zodiac signs will come according to the calculation of the twenty-seven stars. That is the will of Brahma. We have no need to look into any of that. It is enough to know only what is shown to us. That is the Guru and the disciple. We must always be able to proceed by testifying only to the Guru. Otherwise, you will just sit there like a tied-up bundle. If those who show Siddhi (mystical powers) don't go decently, he will have to sit counting the time that this Siddhi has a position. He will lie there, he won't be saved. Grabbing onto what will he be saved from there? The one who shows this Siddhi goes to the position of a Deva, catches all these Devas, and makes them his Siddhi. All of them have to bow down (do ethmidam) before Brahma.

When Jesus's disciples drew water, a pit formed there. What is the result? There will be a pit equal to the water drawn. If you draw a handful of water from the sea and it forms a pit that much, will the water run out? Drawing means, he will see only as far as his vision extends in his visionary side. How much will be visible to his eyes? There is no point in saying big things. We don't need any of this. You hold onto the Guru; let whatever is obtained be obtained.
Disciple: The world began from seven Sanyasis; one Rishi sat and conducted all this—is it true?

Guru: Yes. There is such a story. But we shouldn't hold it as permanent. How can we know how the will of Brahma comes about? We shouldn't speak beyond that determination. Whomsoever we see, we should say it. Everything exists, it is true. Your mind only reaches a certain limit. What can I do? Don't tell anyone to validate what we say. It existed according to our knowledge. Then the Guru was this, I was this. Only this much should be said. In some situations, some things will be useful to you. Sometimes they won't. You might not see anything. Sometimes you will get scoldings from the Guru. Sometimes you will get a hit. Sometimes you will get good things. Sometimes he will take and give grapes. Sometimes he will give dog feces. We will not oppress anything to become an authority. We are becoming an authority by grabbing on ourselves. Work and grow by yourself. This is the word on this subject.
Guruvani

A Knowledge for Man to Think About

Some people belonging to the Aryan race are called Sanatanis. Wherever you go, there is only one karma of hoisting up this Hinduism. That is a karma that has deviated from the Sanatana Dharma. It is impossible to bring it back to the right path anymore. If anyone thinks so, it is a misconception. Its value has been lost. The people who practice Hinduism as a whole speak and preach as Sanatanis. We desire Sanatanam as a great merit for all time. My understanding is that the whole world thinks so too. But what is the truth? Neither of these is happening here.

The idea here is not something I came to know or was made to know. I didn't even have such a notion. I only had a consciousness to say that this is true. That consciousness is my experience. It took twenty-nine years, starting from Santhigiri in Varkala, to realize whether that experience was right or wrong. Before that, seventeen years in Sivagiri ٹ Many people used to come during the twelve years I spent at Santhigiri in Varkala. Not that many people would come to Sivagiri then. It was a time when the Gurukula was famous. Nataraja Guru was there then. Yati went to the Gurukula for a change from Sivagiri. They did not understand what they were doing while standing as propagandists of Narayana Guru. To function in that state, one needs a tendency that is attached to it in some way. To put it into practice and reach the people, there must be an idea slightly ahead. This idea will not just be useful like that. As an example for that, Narayana Guru has said a word:
The lamp that shines when the Tripudi (triad) is destroyed
Will not be attained by a deceitful Yati-
Remember this secret statement of the Upanishad

Whoever justifies that a course of karma that has come down to this day does not exist, is certainly a pseudo-ascetic. The person who performs actions must definitely have the understanding that even if the gross body is discarded, the subtle body remains with us. This is an essential matter. What proof should we give for that? I have closely known many of the people who call themselves believers of Sree Narayana Guru. I will say with certainty that they cannot do this. I am saying this standing on a truth I realized from efforts over a long time.

How have we understood the aspect of the manes (Pitru)? Today, we often depend on the lineages of Devas and Rishis to correct the aspect of the manes. Many people have exerted themselves and made others exert for the acquisition of knowledge. One of them is Gandhiji. Another is Rabindranath Tagore. But the aspect of the manes could not be corrected. The karma that has come through the vigilance of our ancestors is contained in the divinity resting in the Trimurti system. That is, Shaktheyam, Saivam, Vaishnavam—or Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva.
Question: Does Guru mean that one should move forward by understanding where and how the mistake happened?

Guru: Yes, that is the solution for it. I can only give you an introduction to that. Other than that, I have no path like Siddhi (miraculous powers) to offer. Under the guise of the path of Siddhi, many like Raja Yoga, Hamsa Yoga, Chandrika Yoga, and Hatha Yoga have emerged. But none of these have improved the land to date.

We know that Sanatana Dharma has departed from the people and what supports have been given from the presence of God to repeatedly restore it. That support was given through Sree Krishna. The history is that Sree Krishna was removed from India without being retained, bringing another aspect, and Dwarka was submerged. Since then, so many great souls have come, so many Guru lineages, the Parayi petta panthirukulam, the eighteen Siddhars ٹ and numerous great men known through reading and writing have come. One of them is Rabindranath Tagore. Vivekananda is a disciple of an unlettered person. We are trying to establish that by giving a great price. Only by seeing the soul form of these great souls who came after Sree Krishna can we understand what it is like. Its benefit lies in visualizing their soul form. What is the use of simply singing Kilippattu without seeing it?

There is a knowledge here that has seen the soul forms of those great souls without any distinction of caste, religion, or class; that is, we have reached a path that reveals this soul form. That is the path here. The guidance provided by crores of souls—Gods and Goddesses, and the paths traversed through Siddhi principles and Yoga ways—is present here. I am conveying a knowledge to state beyond any shadow of a doubt that none of this has reached complete fruition.

I only know how to speak like this. Mine is not a way of speaking in any other manner. There is also evidence here to prove this to you. You will get that evidence only if you love and believe. There is no other karma here. It is not I who should give that proof. Someone else has to see and say what this knower of the soul is.
Question: Is Guru saying that one must reach there through Karma Yoga?
Guru: Yes. The one who sees in whom, where, and how the karma rests, is the one who should say it. The Guru who stands as a witness to that must be capable there. Did you understand that?
Question: Am I capable of saying anything?

Guru: Still, we have some knowledge, don't we? We have at least a little discernment to say what is truth and what is untruth. The evidence for that is the families who have come here as believers today. Over five thousand families come here who are able to say this is the truth. But one cannot say that there is even a single family that lives fully absorbing that truth. There are many families among them who are followers of other religions. The courage of these people of other religions comes from Jesus and other prophets. If they don't understand it through the courage of this experience, they will start saying everything else is bad, that is not complete, this alone is complete. With that, everything will be ruined. This is what I am saying. Narayana Guru has said it in one word: Everything that exists is indeed there. But, it should be useful for the seeker of philosophical truth.

Who stands, where, and how in the aspect called the Guru rising in principle. This is the subject. This is beyond thought. Do not apply intellect, do not bring it into thought. Human intellect has a limit. If pushed beyond that, it will go crazy.

When the time comes, we need someone in front of us based on our predestination. Otherwise, it will be lost. Whatever is done, it will go in vain. This is why I say to bring these great souls in front. Shouldn't we see what all they bore? No matter how sick someone is, if they come to me, I will arrange a setting for that. Someone among you must see it as an experience—I am not saying in the sense that everyone will see. We can develop this path through the goodness of this Kali Yuga. But we have been made to believe that Kali is bad. Kali is never bad. What I am saying now is proof of that. If Kali were bad, this would not happen; Kali is what is guiding us. Unless one understands that Kali is the best time that guides us in every way, no matter who does what, they will not be saved. It is that lack of understanding that prompted Gandhiji to try to bring Ramarajya. There is a notion that this will not happen in Kali. But that is the delusion created by Puranas and Epics.

The Puranas and Epics have completed three phases. The fourth phase is completed in Kali. Man was brought repeatedly to complete the dharma of Kali. But it was not established here. It still continues to function up to the fourth part. It was also judged that the fourth part is useless. The statement that the fourth part is useless has been a mistake since the time it was made. That is, by holding onto the Trimurti state, three eras were completed. For the fourth era to be completed, Kali must be set right. That is part of knowledge.

The first era proved that truth is indeed truth. That is exactly why it is called Satyayuga. Satyayuga functioned as Satyayuga. After that, up to where did this Manu lineage, or the Trimurti lineage after leaving the Manu lineage, function? This must become clear to us. Otherwise, what is the use of just giving a justification and making do? It is not I who should say this; someone among you should say it, and through you, share with the world a curiosity for the lineage to take it up and act upon it.
Question: That curiosity should be cultivated.

Guru: Yes. For that to come, shouldn't we know what was wrong and what was right in past events? We must know what capability the Manu lineage had and how that capability was lost. Without knowing that, the Trimurti lineage cannot be rejected. This is the knowledge here.

When the Trimurti phase came, Kali was described in a way that made it seem entirely bad. How will these negative aspects called Kali be taken up and removed? If we say let it go on without doing that, how will it go? What is this flaw, what is its remedy—this can only be understood through experience. There must be someone to show this experience in front of you.

I am stating an experience. After I experienced it, it became impossible to escape from it. Ever since this started, it has come as an adversity. But there is no escaping it. Therefore, I was experiencing it by stomping, kicking, knowing, familiarizing, and enduring it. There is no other way. There is no one else to tell me. But when this was reached, everyone came.

Just stating this experience is not enough. Saying that what existed before does not exist is also not enough. The flaws and merits of what exists must be highlighted. Only then can one say that what is starting is correct. This is the subject. That karma, which becomes personally convincing and attains dharma in action, must reach you. For it to become personally convincing, one must be convinced of the recurring stages of the life of the great souls who have come so far. Growing from there, one must reach the part called fulfillment.

Fulfillment of what? Those standing with me know what the fulfillment is of. But they have not been able to be convinced of it. Continuous effort and such awareness are not strictly required for that. It is enough to have love and respect for me.

On one occasion, I went to Maruthwamala. Five people were with me. One of them was looking at a description in a vision. Then he asked me for advice. I wrote it down and gave it to him. That man had also gone to my Guru. But that is a different method. Mine is a different method. But it should not be denied. I have not denied it. Where else could I go after denying it! But he stood up to that part and then moved away. Those with experience will understand if they think a little this way and that.

After seeing the description, that man became an experiencer. After that, he thought about getting married. Having thought so, he came to me. But he didn't mention that matter. He spoke about what he saw in the vision. When I understood what he had seen, I felt I should not get close to this person anymore. This is a huge trouble. Since then, I haven't been close to him. If there is conscience, truth, and love, one will get this. And that too, not for everyone. The cyclic capacity of the Yugas must have reached the soul in an atomic nature. Only such people will get this. This soul must be an authority at least to the size of an atom. Intellect, capability, or efficiency are not the criteria for gaining authority. As mentioned earlier, it is a soul where the cyclic capacity of the Yugas has reached at least trivially. With that cyclic capacity, one must see the nature and karma of the Pitru. Under what, where, how, and up to where does the Pitru stand, what is the flaw in the karma performed by worshipping and causing to worship, where did it go and attain the form of a soul, where has it taken root? There is no point in just saying Pitru and dismissing it. Deliverance must be given to it.

We know the story of Agastya's effort and hardship to give deliverance to the Pitru. If Agastya had to experience such difficulty, how much more difficulty would ordinary people have! It is said that through Agastya's capacity for action, four people like Sri Rama could be given birth. If one has the authority of the cyclic capacity of the Yugas, that will definitely happen.

In this cyclic distinction here, the network of Siddhis has absolutely no place. If you are guided by networks of Siddhis, you will be mesmerized by Siddhi and cease to exist. Among us, so much about Yoga Vidya, Karma Vidya, and Jnana Vidya has been talked about and the essence of Vedanta has been written down. Nothing is to be achieved with this. Therefore, this will be set right only if you bring this through your successors, the children, in a way that convinces you.

By practically studying all four Vedas, studying what the karma of the four time periods is, and finding no salvation in it, the Upanishads came ٹ One must remember the secret of the Upanishadic sayings. So, it will be sufficient only if one sees what the secret of this Upanishad is. There are no other justifications for this. It is the lamp that shines after transcending the Triputi. Science and consciousness that are like dramatic acting—if all these are bundled and spoken, they will not enter the minds of the people. The secret of the Upanishads cannot enter like that. A color is specified for each of these. In the Narayanopanishad, this is stated a bit more. Those who speak of color must see it. It is not enough to just see the Deva and the Devi. Seeing this, one must be able to save at least one family by seeing what the destruction, survival, and description of this Deva, Devi, and Pitru (manes) are.
Question: If one family is saved, will its benefit extend to other families as well?

Guru: Yes, that was just said. Regarding what is seen here, they themselves must see and say. The same application holds for Socrates as well. I am not saying it that way either. You must see how such great souls and thinkers were on the path traversed by your predecessors. Socrates is highly placed among thinkers. Experiencers are of a different kind. People like Nostradamus and Aurobindo Ghosh are experiencers. Otherwise, if you think based on what someone said, this will not work. We must see that all this is true.
Question: While assimilating all this, one must reach the first conclusion.
Guru: We can say that in our thoughts, but it is not possible. This must definitely be confirmed by realizing it through experience.
Question: Is this possible just by us hearing someone's experience?

Guru: No. His experience is according to the magnitude of his soul. It must be thought about at least up to the point of differentiating between those with intellect and those without. Would it be right to take a fool and give him the position of the most intelligent person? This is entirely about authority. What is seen today is the deficiency of not acquiring the knowledge to become an authority.

There are more than five hundred people to say this is the truth in this manner. It doesn't mean they have all attained the truth. If their course of action is not right, even they will go wrong. I tell this to everyone. They themselves must understand it and behave accordingly. My thought is, what can be achieved by just creating a situation to prove this is right?

Those who have not known, seen, or heard me come here after seeing me in visions. Some ten to sixteen people come like that. It's not our language, not our dress. People who don't even know the history of Kerala or India. This is the proof. The effort here is to prepare them, through our life, to make their children take up the traditional karma of ours and our children. For that, what is done first is Pitru Shuddhi (purification of the manes).

When Pitru Shuddhi is performed, five purifications take place along with it. It is not like knowing from the Vedas. Pitru Dharma, Gruha Dharma, Deva Dharma, Dana Dharma, Atma Dharma. These five Dharmas must descend from a household. The ones through whom it descends like that are the men and women in our homes. It is being proven here that we can achieve this without the help of ideological paths. I never think that I can call ten ascetics here, give them advice, and get them to do this. Capability or incapability is not what is required here. The truth is about how to reach the part of the goodness of the mind.

You might know many great people who are your contemporaries. I am not saying all this is bad. But it won't work out with that. This is my experience. This is said for human thought. It is the duty of those yet to come and others as well to think, know, and inform. This is being said so that they and you can understand it as one. Let the realization of it through experience come according to their respective eligibilities. This is a knowledge that man needs to reflect upon.
Guruvani
