Life is the Recitation of Vedas in the Soul

When considering the knowledge of the land, home, and family members where I was born, it is certainly difficult to say that something like this grew out from there. Because their knowledge and familiarity are like that. The knowledge passed down from them is of no use to us for anything. However, there is another matter. It is a special quality of that land. Speaking of the special quality, its name is Chandiroor. The land (Ooru) in the shape of the moon (Chandra). It seems like such a name was deliberately given to this land. But the nearby places are also 'Oorus'. The nature of this place is not attributed to any of those Oorus. If asked what is the reason for Chandiroor to have this nature, we must believe that it is God's intention from the early times. What is the reason for this?

Religious theoreticians know how long it has been since prophetic religions started. There is a lack of people to say what the knowledge, familiarity, and degradation of the Hindu religion are like. That deficiency has affected all religions. In any religion, it is natural for the successors to follow the path taken by the predecessor.

The source of India or Asia is the imagination of the Rishis. What is the reason for such a concept to arise? We are not certain. If we look back, tremendous ups and downs have happened not just for India, but for the entire world. India is at the forefront when it comes to culture. One cannot even imagine in what all ways that culture was torn apart and to which all paths it was led. It has gone that far away. If your desire is to change this now, Chandiroor itself must become eligible for it. That land's eligibility must become an eligibility according to God's will. Otherwise, if it becomes the eligibility of individual persons, castes, or religions, that eligibility will cease to be the eligibility of that land or that person.

Out of the twenty-eight Chaturyugas in this (seventh) Manvantara, twenty-five Chaturyugas have changed and functioned. If asked where the harm caused by this change has reached, it has reached a state in a way none of us can think of, in a way we cannot even imagine. Let that be however it may. How should we take the occasion we are born into today? This should be our focus. We should not waste time singing about what has passed and what is yet to come as its continuation.

We must definitely believe that the time we are born in is truly blessed. We must live in the light of that belief. When we say belief, it is the embodiment of love. Or it is a path of truth that can unite with God. In such a path, it is not right for each of us to turn against each other and fight, or to say that mine, yours, and others' are not right, and only someone else's is right. If someone says that no one else's is right, it is wrong, and only mine is right, no one will be able to accept it. For us, there is no place for such talk. Religious theoreticians have not been able to impart this. When I tell you a truth, I wish you to listen carefully and implement it in your life to see the results.

What is called God? It is the karma where the five senses, five sheaths, and five elements work together with the soul and spirit. This is a reality without the distinctions of male, female, small, big, caste, religion, or class. When this reality was somewhat stretched and summarized and presented to eminent scholars, they pushed it into scientific consciousness. What is called scientific consciousness is not modern science. It is the history belonging to the six Shastras, four Vedas, and such epics. How can we lift this history up? There is no need for us to lift any of this. You are not the authorities to lift this up. Because our ancestors are not those who lived their lives copying it. What you should do now is that you and your children must achieve this without perishing due to casteism and without destroying the Vedas through religion.

We know that any religion and any caste that has worked for the awakening of man is for the upliftment of the human race. But the scholarly mindset cultivated all these religions and executed manipulative tricks to belittle them all. What is that manipulative trick? We have heard, haven't we, our parents go to a school or a religious institution that imparts education and plead, "Please open the eyes of my child." Does the child have no eyes? The child has eyes. Then what needs to be opened? It is the eye of his heart that must be opened. But that cannot be achieved by this person we approach. Then where should this be addressed?

What should parents be, as far as this child is concerned, even before birth? Without getting entangled in studying castes and religions, without class hatred, how should we absorb the journey of truth, what all did our ancestors do, what do we have left to do now, how can we handle things to cultivate the achievements willed by God through us—parents must understand this with pain, communicate it, and according to their capability, impart it to the children. But it cannot just be taken and given to children like that. Then how can it be given?

First, understand a karma we have. All the knowledge we have received till today is the complete form of human effort. Through what was it first received? Through Sanatana Dharma, or Manusmriti. So we have a historical truth that came through Manu's Smriti. But what is the use of talking about Manusmriti without letting us know what Manu is?

Manu's karma is the resurrection of man. Manu is the primeval Guru. Who knows that such Gurus existed in India? Do Hindus know? No one knows this at all. It is this knowledge that needs to be brought to light. What all must we bring into our course of action to illuminate this knowledge? Do not assume that we will get any benefit or divine help if we start arguing, proving, and winning it in any way. If such a shortcoming has occurred in the ancestors, we must remove that shortcoming, create a path, and guide the children through that path. We should view the entire lineage of preceding Gurus and prophets with the love of God. Then we must take upon ourselves the failures that have occurred in it till today. Teach this to the children.

How many years of history do we need to retrieve? We must have an account of the eons for that. Calculating twelve thousand divine years for a Chaturyuga, seventeen lakh years have passed since the time of Sri Rama. If this calculation has gone wrong, where did it go wrong, and why was it made to go wrong? Each of us is a point of this karma that has gone wrong. Standing firmly in this truth which is a human right, we must carefully observe, act, and make the future generations act, without ruining them by speaking of caste and religious hatred. This is the greatest karma and duty that parents must indispensably perform. Why should children who do not know caste and religion be informed of it, aren't women the ones giving birth here—when such a notion is brought up, they immediately fall into the two castes of male and female. Divided into classes like this, then escalating and ruining it, we are all residual figures of an acquired habit.

Before the Hindu religion, which claims that its essence lies within itself, asserts this right, it must know what its history is. Why should one who doesn't know this become the spokesperson for that dharma? What do those who have accepted the prophetic religion know about it? Despite struggling so much, these historical theoreticians haven't been able to understand what harm has befallen that history. Every opportunity you have received is arranged for you by God. In what manner? During the time of Sree Krishna, Sree Krishna said for us: Whatever aspects our ancestors worshipped, see all of them in me. When he says in me, it refers to this color of the sky. The sky has a blue color. But the sky has no color. It appears blue due to the depth of the sky. If that is Sree Krishna's color, it appears due to the depth of that soul. There is no Pitru, Deva, Rishi, Sanyasi, or devotee who has a course of karma capable of merging into this color. Many great ancestors have seen, known, agonized over this, and stated it for us.

'Udalodu poyora parameshande parartha bhakthano' (Is it the supreme devotee of the Supreme Lord who went with his physical body)—this is said about Ramalinga of Vadalur. It is said that Ramalinga of Vadalur went with his physical body. But he did not go with his physical body. He went into the room and was not seen again. When they entered the room, only a lamp was burning. This is why he is known as Jyothi Ramalinga. What is the difficulty for this state to come to you? We must think like this. When great souls come in each era, it is customary for them to look at their predecessors to see what they should do. The method of a head of a family, a party member, or a ruler is also the same. They look at what their predecessors have done, discuss its rights and wrongs a bit, and then take it up and do the same themselves. They have nothing else to bring forward. Similarly, we also say and study this. We not only say and study it but also firmly stand by the action of how to take it. We must see how the distress occurred in the complete form of the karma we firmly stood by. If a great soul comes before us, he must look at the history of his follower from the beginning and tell him, 'You are like this, and you must complete it like this.' A problem has occurred where religious theoreticians cannot step down to this level, nor can they climb up into it. In that position, what have these theoreticians done? They got caught up in the broken thought that God must come through my caste, through my religion, through my class. However, you should not think that this line of thought has completely broken down. Because you are putting immense effort into it and lying crushed within it. To escape from there, your this karma must be shattered.

Who can shatter this for you? At the very least, one must reach the position of Buddha, Jain, Nabi, or Guru Nanak and then come and tell you. Someone who has not even reached that position should not give guidelines to break this karma; it will bring harm. If such guidelines are given, not only will he go downwards, but he will also be unable to accept that prophet. Because of that inability to accept, what all is happening in front of us today?

There is no one to take this up and say it in this state. It is not possible to say it using history or science. It is said, "Sasthirangal shathakodi kattalum uthavathu, uthavathu, uthavathu" (Even if one learns a hundred crore sciences, it is of no use, no use, no use). Where did the science that stands useless like this go wrong? How did this kind of destruction happen to Divine Justice? Such a destruction should not happen to Divine Justice, should it? We need such a thought. That thought might become the reason to correct ourselves. There must be an idea to come to such a correction. An element that fits the state of truth that evaluates everything and connects it to one. One must be able to connect the disconnected forms of variations in whatever our ancestors have done to one, purify and adorn it, and merge it into that after adorning it. This is the Guru. No one should think they can just say something and merge it, or study the Vedas and Shastras and merge it; it will not happen.

There are plenty of hardships that have come upon us due to our inability. It is not just in education, wealth, and nobility, but it has filled all individuals, and the prophet lineages or other lineages we boastfully grow into have turned into a stage of ignorance. The offering of it to God is not happening. But this is a time when God stands compassionate for us. We can certainly offer it to God. For that, men, women, small and big alike have certain things to do without going bad. Whatever absurdities of the caste system our ancestors played out by being in various prophet lineages, we must see them with our eyes, grieve in our minds, and attain a maturity to ask ourselves: what should I do now, where should I submit it, what should I do for my children. An introduction is needed to reach this maturity.

All religious theoreticians have the acquaintance of Darshana (vision). But the knowledge we lack is how far these religious theoreticians have envisioned. For one who realizes the vision in five states—Jagrat (waking), Swapna (dreaming), Sushupti (deep sleep), Turiya, and Turiyatita—the virtue of the soul is the dharma of seeing and verifying how the five sheaths, five senses, and five elements function together by observing the life-force. If the aspect of vision is explained in this manner, you won't be able to grasp it. Then what should be done? You should not reject anything you have accepted so far. If you reject it, you won't be able to move forward. Without rejecting them, submitting them all where they need to be submitted, purifying them, removing all the embarrassment from them, it is a life of recitation of the Vedas of complete spirituality—discriminating that the material and the spiritual are not two. It is because we do not know that this is our life that so many things have happened to us. All that must be changed by mutually enduring and forgiving.

Our land is Bharatam. Some think it got the name Bharatam because Bharata ruled it, but that is not correct; it is a scholarly opinion. So what is the truth? This Bharata came after so many Bharatas had passed. We don't need to know all this, do we? Which Bharata is this? Are you talking about the ones born as these four people? What all histories and created stories existed here even before that? So many eras have passed since Sree Krishna. What all happened within these five thousand years. So many great souls came. The count is that two thousand four hundred and forty-four Gurus or prophets have come. If we disrupt this count and falsely attribute it to someone else, what will we become, what will our way of life become? We will drift away from the truth. Understanding this reality, each one of you is the complete form of a contribution to be given to the land, country, and the world through you. If you do not believe this and act upon it, we will destroy ourselves, but no harm will come to the truth.

What we have got is Kali (Yuga). Everyone has been made to hear that Kali is bad. If Kali is not good, how will we take it forward? What is the use of us living in this time? Kali is good. It is good in every way. Freedom in every aspect, religious freedom, class freedom—everything has already come. Now, which way should this freedom be guided? Who should we be in that action? If we are to ascend in such a dharma, what all tasks must we accomplish? This should be our goal.

Regarding me, there is a knowledge I received as God. That is what I am conveying to you. A negative aspect of the karma committed by my predecessors and yours stands spread all over the world as barbarism. You can firmly believe that the knowledge to correct this barbarism has been given as God. You should not assume that I am saying what I have in my hands. I am saying this so that you may have a great sense of agency that needs to stand in harmony with your own dharmas and karmas.

I worked at Sivagiri for seventeen years. I didn't get even a part of the vision from there. I know many people speak and teach the aspect of vision. I have also tried following that. None of it proved fruitful. I had the experience through a great soul wandering as a fakir, known as a Pattani. With the effort of twenty-nine years after having the experience, I could know what the true path to God is. Do not think this is yesterday's effort or today's effort. Just understand that when it was known, it was a very difficult one.

No religious theoretician has the authority to say that what we have been worshipping does not exist. Give deliverance to it; if it is entitled to liberation, give it liberation; instead of polluting the rest and leaving it in the atmosphere, destroy it for the good of the atmosphere. That is the decorum for it. This is the activity happening in Santhigiri. You must try to do this and make it yours. For that, the most minimal beginning has been completed here. You must understand this completed task as the completed karmic course of a personality.

Karma means actions done with words, mind, and body. All that must be appropriate for you too. There is no need for you to look into sin or merit. There is no need to work with honesty (in the worldly sense). A time is coming right behind when the goodness of that work will be accepted not just by this land, not just by this country, but by all people belonging to all Guru lineages. You must see and know that. It is impossible to think that everyone alive today will see it. Yet, everyone will be able to be convinced of it—that there is something in this, and we are going after what is real. You should not follow this without maintaining the love, respect, and certainty that we will never deviate from it. That is a danger. A similar danger occurred in the beginning. Beginning means twenty-five Chaturyugas ago. I have told you numerous times that this mistake is the cause of all the dangers seen today. How will the reciters of the Vedas speak about this mistake? How will the theoreticians speak? Who can speak of it, keeping what measure?

If a prophet or a religious theoretician comes, they can only speak of the influence of the time allotted to them and leave. They cannot say anything more than that. Those who come later might say what will happen after that. Even our greatest theories are only up to this much. Let us get whatever it may be through whichever path. You must understand that this is the course of karma that saves our predecessors, sees what the merit and sin in that soul are, and resolves it.

This is accessible not just to our children and mothers, but to all people who follow customary practices. You can definitely take this up. I have never deceived you by speaking of things you cannot take up. I told you how you can take this forward and who you must become. You must ensure that your male or female children do not perish by drifting apart in the name of caste and religion, but make the God, divided and kept as each one's own, available to everyone equally. This is a huge effort. We must be able to reach at least the imaginative realm of this effort. The knowledge to reach there is available here. I have never told you knowledge that is not here. You can definitely harmonize with this. People belonging to all religious doctrines are here. That is the proof of it.

The method here is not what is taught in the existing ashram doctrines. It is a method that tells you to do this and that in the path shown by God. About five hundred people had experiences in that. There are those who have moved forward quite a bit. This is not a job for earning rice. Not just rice, but it is the task of becoming the authority over the Navagrahas by acquiring gold, land, and everything, and removing all karmic doshas.

While the earth is revolving like this with the sun and the moon, the historical truth of telling the time at any moment lies here. Through that historical truth, after explaining how many times it has to revolve to make a year, a month, and a date—it must have shown at least one divine year in it. For a human, a month is two fortnights. The bright fortnight and the dark fortnight. Thus, with twelve months, a year was determined, and with three hundred and sixty-five years, one divine year was determined. You must carefully preserve without losing this truth that God imparted to you for our children to cross all these years and think whether there is any reason or meaning for this time and this merit.

Seeing the karma completed on a small scale here, perform a primal karma like Gotra Shuddhi (lineage purification) to produce whatever you can from it and make it your own. Keep it as your contribution to the world. An opportunity will come sometime to give it to the world through you. Let an understanding of taking and giving whatever you need remain equally inside and outside you. That goodness is to be attained by hearing, knowing, and practicing. You must do it. These words of mine are my love for you, up to the limit of my knowledge. However much effort you put into taking this up, let it become something ordained by God for your welfare. Do not pollute it with caste and religion and ruin it.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition
September 1999
How the Trimurti System Originated

When I started the ashram, I received an intimation: you should think a little about your life. I didn't understand what it was back then. I asked my Guru, Pattani Swami. He said, 'I have only received two things. You will get the rest. One, it's not enough to seek only the spiritual; two, you will have to change your ascetic attire.'

Here, prayers and rituals were performed thirty-four times in the name of Poortheekaranam (Fulfillment). On the seventh day after starting the prayer for the thirty-fourth time, an intimation was received to place a Kumbham. For four years after receiving the intimation, there was no capability to do this. In the fifth year, it was done on a small scale. This has shown us a nature that acts and resolves through the five elements, the five senses, and the five sheaths for the sake of humanity. This karma is performed here by bringing a change to the customary practices of such karmas conducted till date. Not everyone gets this authority.

This is a path where matters of Siddhi cannot be handled at all. Siddhi is not Jnana. Even those accompanying me have insisted that some Siddhis should be shown. I asked the Brahmam if I may do it. I also got permission to do it. After a short while, it was also said that it is not good. Thus, stopping it right there is the history here.

A detailed explanation of placing the Kumbham was revealed a few years ago. It was said that it must be done with the firm resolve that our lineage must strongly possess the capability to bear this. Among Hindus, the Trimurti worship system is strongly prevalent. At one time, this stood strengthened to the point where it was indispensable. When it was hidden under the Varnasrama Dharma, it failed to take root in the soil of Kerala. It was with the advent of British rule that the Varnasrama Dharma suffered damage and wore away. This damage has not completely vanished even today. Theoreticians have kept this in a way that it doesn't become known outside. Although freedom was achieved through the political thinkers who followed this, with that benefit, it hasn't been possible to touch good things until now. It can only be brought about through children with innate aptitude. It must be understood based on a family and taught to the land and the children. A lot of effort has to be put in for that. Because the impurity in the manner of the land is hidden within the people.

All the forms of worship that have come to the world, and all the past Acharyas and their achievements have been shown here. From the very beginning of Kali, Gurus were born for this purpose. It was later revealed that the fulfillment karmas mentioned earlier were performed to give birth to children who are free from the baseness of a certain stage of Kali. Even I was not informed of its actual meaning. If I knew it directly, arrogance would arise. Therefore, the Brahmam made it happen without letting me know.

Nothing will happen without the gross, the subtle, the cause, and the effect. The ones who must emerge as the most eligible are the householders. They have become corrupted along with the world. However, the form of truth is being proven through the householders who believe here. There are also householders here today who have fully understood it. Even experienced householders who receive the divine word are here today. But due to a lack of innate aptitude (vasana), they are unable to affirm and do this. Only the Brahmacharis will get the affirmation.

As mentioned earlier, when the intimation to place the Kumbham was received, it could not be placed as there were no circumstances for it. This can be done as an offering for the incurable diseases of the people. It can also be done for those who have suffered mental breakdowns. This can also be done for changing evil habits. Besides, it can be done for the fulfillment of desired matters. It has been revealed that whatever the people wish for, it will yield results.

Such a thing happens only very rarely across eons. It is informed that you will get an opportunity through this to correct it whenever a mistake happens in the divine decree. This will bestow upon you a portion of merit that never perishes in any era and an accumulation of wealth that never decays. Thinking that let whatever needs to come, come, and whatever needs to go, go, you must bravely carry this forward. Everything we do here has been made to be done by making us experience and believe it. All this is for you. You are the ones who need to nurture and sustain this in an organizational nature.
Question: What is the reason for all four yugas having the same repetitive nature?

Guru: This question arises because the tradition of Hinduism has become immeasurably old. Sanatana Dharma means the culture of the great souls who existed in their respective times. History explains that the cultures which came and went in the forms of Shaktheya, Shaiva, and Vaishnava tried to reform mankind to an extent. In between, the way some acharyas followed the religious lineage can also be seen. However, those who came that way do not belong to the lineage of the original Manu. In the lineage of Vaivasvata Manu, the original Manu of this Manvantara, precisely due to some flaws that occurred to an acharya named Sathyathranan who came at the end of the third Chaturyuga, he went towards selfishness, and hence the reign according to God's will did not happen. Sathyathranan's concept was like a theory of evolution. Therefore, in order to implement the will of Brahman, the Trimurti system was brought in during the seventh Chaturyuga.
Question: Did the Trimurti system not exist before that?

Guru: No. Manus are those who fulfill the ideas according to the will of Brahman regarding the growths and declines of the world up to a certain period. Through such fourteen Manvantaras, the origin, creation, sustenance, and dissolution of this world have been brought about.
The nature of the soul according to the will of Brahman has also come about in this way.
Question: Why is it that most people do not know that there is such a Manu lineage?

Guru: As mentioned earlier, the feeling of "I" (Aham Brahmasmi) happened to the Manu lineage. In that ego, it was seen in the state of knowledge that all the acts of knowledge that had occurred in this world until then came through it. If you look at any Vedanta books, you can see this feeling of "I" standing out. You can see this independent feeling of "I" coming to the forefront if you speak to any ordinary person. When coming to the term Brahmachari, such feelings came through the Guru lineage. The deity I hold, or the goddess I hold in the lineage of deities, has more capability and glory. As a result of this coming to each individual, Chamundi, Yakshi, Pey, Marutha, Madan, and Mantramoorthi all became lords. This happened due to the ego and selfishness of each individual.
Question: Why did it happen like this?

Guru: As I said earlier, the Trimurti system was created by the command of the Brahma power when the will of Brahman did not materialize due to the ups and downs that occurred in the Manu lineage. Vedanta ceased to exist for this Trimurti system. Its nature became worship, prayer, and manifestation. When that nature changed to showing tests by making even Marutha dance, mankind was unable to fully see the glory of God or accurately know or study its measure, or the centers of knowledge.
Question: If the Guru says so, doesn't it mean that nothing that has come so far is correct?
Guru: Yes, what was said so far is that it is not correct.
Question: You said that the Trimurti system was formed to execute the will of Brahman because the Manu lineage made a mistake, right?

Guru: By bringing the varna-ashrama to the people who were worshiping in the Trimurti system in such a way that they could not act according to the merit of the time, caste and sub-castes were introduced into it. Prior to that, fabricated stories were created through sruti and smriti and made into authorities. Before that, empirical arguments came and some sannyasins themselves handled the siddhi systems. By the time it reached this point, the Manu system faded away even from memories. The current degradation is the result of not changing the systems that should be changed according to the change of time, and doing it with the vain idea that the position of Brahman should always remain in the hands of the Deva-Brahmins.
Guru Vani
Guru Jayanti Edition
September 1999
Vow and Prayer

It was hinted earlier that doing such a prayer here is according to an instruction. You must remember while doing this prayer, during this prayer time which rectifies the mistakes of a long time, if even a small scratch of ignorance enters your mind, it will spread. It will spread in many ways. We are doing the prayer to rectify the flaws that have occurred in all the actions of the householders, and similarly in all the actions of the sannyasins and brahmacharis. This is not a matter according to the capability of your mind. Therefore, some ignorance and mistakes may occur. There is nothing else to say other than that it is God's will making us do a special thing at a distance that no one can say. You should always think that may God give an opportunity for this Guru and the Guru lineage, which God has given us, to impart double the goodness after removing not only the shortcomings of mine and my ancestors that have occurred over time, but also the overall shortcomings of the people of the world. The children you raise and who are growing, and the children standing here having accepted sannyasa are equally participants in this noble karma. You must also think about how it should be done if a way of redemption is to come through the karma you all do together. You should always think, while doing any work, that if there have been shortcomings through sannyasins and their lineage, or through any parts of this world, all of them should be destroyed, and in that place, the goodness according to the will of Brahman should come through the Guru lineage. When studying children do not get knowledge in their mind, they should pray like this. You should pray that not only the children in this lineage, but wherever there are children who have gone astray, they all get goodness in this way.

This is the word God told us. You should pay special attention to boys and girls separately and pray for them. The karma coming from me, who is a woman, should correct the mistake of the woman in this world. The man should also think the same way. That should be your qualification. This qualification of the man and the woman is advancing together here. At that time, our mind should not become bad or we should not fall into circumstances that make the mind bad. Especially the men and women growing here are the ones to make judgments for the world. We should become great through this sense of dharma. Standing in this dharma, our constant prayer is that all the mistakes that have traditionally occurred not only in this solar system but also in other solar systems should be resolved, and we should be given the knowledge, familiarity, and experience to do what we need when we need it. When we have that knowledge and God tells us and makes us do it, we should be ready to do it. Other than this, thoughts like rubbish lying on the road should not be allowed to enter the mind. If this prayer is done on a full moon day, it will yield full results.
Guru Vani
October 1999

About forty years ago, a number of people came to know in a visible way about the experiences I had on a small scale. That was at Varkala. When they knew it then, quite a few people came and went during the time they knew it. The people also felt it in a good way. But very soon after that, that is, within three years, ten times the number of people who came with love became opposed. If you ask what it is, I don't know either. Others don't know either. If you say it is like that or like this, and ask why it is so, one doesn't know what to say. But after this continued for four years, I came here after being told not to sit in a way that two people could see. When I came here, this was the acquaintance I had. I know some ten or twenty families here. I called and told them. I intend to stay here doing nothing for two and a half years. That is God's command. I had told those who have faith and love to bring something for me to eat. But as locals, they did not decrease it, they kept increasing it. But when it became three months, it started coming a little more than what was required for this. When it started coming like that, I told them not to bring anymore; what came is already more than needed, so don't bring anymore - so they stopped it. After that, a total anarchy came here in a way I don't know how it happened.

After that, how many incidents some people belonging to this place themselves - shouldn't say everyone - a number of them did in many ways. What I understood is the secret of all this - I saw that all the powers worshiped till today were opposing. So if opposition comes like this, what to do? It is not like that. An order came from Sree Krishna that we should calm down a bit. We have some things to do. If it is not done, they will turn into a group that troubles again. That is not needed, we can do it. So before starting it in that way, let me say one thing. That first started like this. This Prabhakaran - most of you know him now. At that time he was studying. He also participated in that ceremony. Like him, seven boys and seven girls. Unmarried people. They were made to stand together like that. Then it is called a completion.

Even I don't know what this completion is. Then some gods and goddesses would start coming like this and show something and go away. Like that, this completion has happened here thirty-four times. If you ask me what this is, I don't know how to say either. Completion is the name. Then Prabhakaran himself asked, what is this called completion, I don't understand it. He was told it will be said later, it is not time to say it now. A good answer could be given for this only three years after he asked. How is it means, worshiped till today - that is what you need to know - there is a scene here built up and worshiped till today as the Hindu system. But there is an application itself before us misleadingly called Sanatana. We hold it as Sanatana. It is not so.

This is purely special uproar created to build up the Hindu religion. So when we say the deity of worship touching this, it is up to the Trimurti. So how to change this karma that has gone up to the Trimurti - it is impossible by anyone. This is the incident. This is what is called this completion, making us do that karma and completing it. How it is means, even the yakshis, gandharvas, and kinnaras will be finished off with one opportunity. Then what is added with the divine elements above that will be finished. It was completed in thirty-four times like this. But by twenty-seven, it reached this said Trimurti system or Devendra system. That was finished. Then I was told to keep quiet for two and a half years. Sitting like that, I was told to do two or three completions again. After that is when we started in the way seen today.

How it is means, this Sree Krishna himself came and told them like this. I am not the one doing this. The children are here. So, you might ask why I couldn't do it. That's not it, the Guru-disciple relationship means acting by knowing the Guru. It is not enough if someone knows that Guru, the person who is a disciple himself must know. Only then will he get mental firmness. Making those who made their minds firm in that way do it was Sree Krishna himself. Like that, many things. So Sree Shankara and Rishi Saibaba had to be taken as the last ones.

In the meantime, everyone from other religions came and went. Everything came and went in a loving manner. No one denied. At the same time, this Sree Shankara took seven days to change. Do you remember, Prabhakaran? What is it? Coming and standing. Not allowing to do anything. Then what is said, that is the matter you need to be careful about. They are all great people. We will have to oppose them. We should oppose only if seen. If they change on their own, let them change. When the pooja took place at nine o'clock on the seventh day, he changed on his own. In the same way, Rishi Sai was also changed. If you ask why it was changed like this, Sree Shankara is said to have shown siddhi. But a jnani should not show siddhi. That is the scene tried to be changed. Not to change Sree Shankara.

It means no siddhi should be shown in the part of this jnani. Siddhi glories or any other act of service or seva vrithi should not be done. This is what is understood from Sree Shankara. What is it, when Sree Shankara went to the forest; a story has been written. And people have held it as a siddhi. True, it is a siddhi; you all know about entering the king's body and all. But that is the aspect that should not be done like that. Therefore, Sree Shankara could not cross this state.

What is called this state is the full form of the seventh sky. Those who have studied Vedanta know that. But although it is said, nobody knows how they will calculate and take it regarding it. Speaking about this seventh sky. So after this seventh sky, then the second sky. That is what is as completion. No one has done that. Just went to the seventh and looked. So if seven is completed, this karma will not come. The dosha of this siddhi karma will come.

There is a great person unaffected by this dosha, that is the Prophet. That dosha has not affected. Difficult to show siddhi. Then the jinn servant who came after that might have shown something. Other than that, the Prophet never showed it. So there is this person called the last prophet as one who does not show siddhi magic. But this could not be crossed. Going to the seventh, that is when it is seen that this world is entirely ruled by jinns. There - sitting there is what is done. In that land, it is called a graveyard; sat there. Did not even go out to urinate from there. So such a thing happened to a person who did not show this siddhi.

At the same time, this Rishi Sai means someone who showed thousands of siddhis, but that, we have considered those siddhi magics as belonging to God. So there is a karma of deceiving man with yogas and such practices and various such siddhi magics and making it seem that this is God. We should not do that. Till then, whatever destruction comes, will not do anything that should not be done. That it will not be done, the items I had worshipped and all of it, I took it and threw it away, but did not do unwanted things to it. Will not do. Thus siddhi should not be shown. If it is God's will, it should come on its own. That was the desire. But now I am not trying to convince you. But I have a matter to tell you the truth. Because some of you have heard and kept the applications of many sannyasins and many divine elements joined together. You have held all this and kept the uproars of a religious system that you have considered as God's aspect. None of this is work done by God. God will never do so either. If we want, as humans, we have no authority to do anything other than seeking God's compassion.
Guru Vani
November 1999

So it is meant that there should be a disciple for us to directly see and know these things. For that, there were two children who grew up here like this. I got all this done by them. It was Sree Krishna coming and standing and doing it; making them do it. After doing it like that, I was again told to keep quiet for two and a half years. Kept quiet. Later, this was started and brought to today's state. What is called today's state is nothing else. To say it, much has to be said. What is called today's state is the dharma of Kali. Because we were made to believe that this Kali dharma is bad, we kept it in some way - except that some Puranas say something - but it won't stand under them. That will just go away like that.

If asked how this came about, when a great soul looked whether his karma itself is complete, he saw it like a completion. It is a mistake that happened then (the usage of the Chaturvakya and the subsequent events). It's not that he wished to do wrong. The truth we received is that twenty-five Chaturyugas have passed since that mistake. No one among us can slip away and escape from that truth. The meaning is that many Kalis, that is Kaliyugas, twenty-five Kaliyugas, have come. Out of that, the twenty-fifth Kaliyuga is the current one. Through that Kaliyuga, despite bringing many people, a change could not be brought to this. Though these gurus were brought by giving some teachings and knowledge, they went up to the state of Trimurti, spoke, and stood there. Only the matter of light was spoken above that. All the Upanishads say only the same. Wherever you look, it's the same.

What is this light? What is the nature of this light? What kind is it? Which color? How many colors will one color change into? This will move forward only if we get to know all this. Other than that, siddhi magics or other types of things are not for us to maintain. Nobody should hold such thoughts. Due to some holding such thoughts, a huge mistake occurred even among our people. What do they see? Not one deity or a thousand gods or goddesses. Considering why what was achieved with one deity cannot be achieved with millions, they tried to handle it that way. But it was lost. They could not do anything. It is then they understand that it is something that shouldn't be done like that. What we have heard and known are some things from the stories of deities. None of these stories reach the presence of God perfectly. It will only reach somewhere else.

Now, this is briefly noted down for you to understand. There are only a few brief words of this in this book. It is not easy to fill this by writing. If needed, some children who have to be born in a great divine conception must come and write this. Otherwise, the educated people of today cannot write it. The reason is what they learned and taught is the job of speaking the wonder of this by studying it in various transformed states like Pandita Mahopadhyaya or Pandita Siromani, through the Sanskrit aspect repeated since the form of siddha seen till today. And not their experience. So it is said like this and twenty-five Chaturyugas have passed. This is its truth. For you to get this from this, some people who will become your children will come. That is what you must watch out for. How? For each of these, people will come to any house belonging to this Guru lineage. That is its lineage. After getting married, a thing you don't hear about is happening here now. After getting married, without sending them home - some stand for seven days; there are some who stood for a month. Let it be however. When they are seated in a sankalpa, they themselves see their deity of worship and the things they believed in. From then on, an achievement is happening for them. That achievement is arriving in their karmic path of origin. It is coming back as your children. This is its subject. Most people won't even be able to understand it. It is God's will that this should come in your children themselves. It is not I who have to do it. So you must behave worthily and take it. It is a path shown by God. You will have to accept many things to keep this path.

What is our order of life? One, employment opportunities set apart as good and what can cause harm in it. How should this be, how should you do it and take it? Similarly, education, you cannot determine how long it will go forward. There is such a state for this. Times have changed. Now this caste cannot bring a karma. There will be changes in education and corresponding employment sectors. That will be coming within a few hundred years. It is not the way we can see today. So that too won't happen unless it comes through your children. That is why, the householder is not to take sannyasa, but it is the householder who lets out various aspects of sannyasa, or considers and implements and makes it work. That householder life sits in you. Through such children of yours, the path of travel of the world is being shown. Rather, there is no magic trick or special siddhi in this - or a nature of blessing and cursing - nothing of this is in this. You will be able to know what that blessing and cursing is. As proof for that, there are people sitting in this group now, among you men and women who are householders, who have seen Rishis, Tyagis, Sannyasins, and Devas up to this Trimurti status. But to go above that is a different way. You can understand that and achieve it only with this karma. This mentioned householder system is the opening of the door of a truth to make your children work forever to implement this dharma. Otherwise, it cannot come through a sannyasin. The sannyasin is not the one to bring it. Many people acted out all such aspects of sannyasa and did it for all this time. But none of that is the lineage of sannyasa. You have thought about all this. By hearing it told, you have acquired an ignorance making you believe that one who attained God-realization doesn't even need water, are people who don't even need dry leaves. All that is wrong, and wrong on top of wrong. We cannot even ****************** what wickedness the karma adopted to avoid needing this water is. This started with Tulsi leaves and reached up to Kanjira leaves. Similarly, it reached all bitter roots and again taking its fruits and purifying it, eating it and then making siddha medicine and eating it, and after that, building a cave with nine faces and inside it. Then this person has to be shifted - shifted here and there - and kept. Cannot get up and move. All bones will become like cotton. Then cannot lift up. Therefore, he is being picked up and shifted. Thus the cave with nine faces is being shifted day and night. This theory speaks of an individual growing like this. What is it? Yoga knowledge, or various such sleight of hand - this is all it is. You have misunderstood that this is sannyasa. None of this is sannyasa at all. Nor is it any karma from taking sannyasa. If you think so, it's a mistake. Till today, our posture of each one is by looking at these swamis who show these wonders. It is something that shouldn't be shown. Go truthfully, let what has to come, come. Let what doesn't have to come, not come.

In this one karma, you firmly have been gifted by God a great karmic siddhi to give to the world through your children, through your generations. You must get this done. For this, there are those who organize in whatever ways in these lands and wander around blabbering what they consider correct based on their own intellect and nonsense they caught onto by talking too much. None of that is ever correct for this lineage or this goodness that is going to come. Till today, whatever karmic flaws are there, we are to take all of them. So when we step down for it, we will get various kinds of sorrow, difficulty, trouble, lack of love, everything. Taking all that upon ourselves, as warriors of this karma, as a woman being the mother of the world, it is a true path given with the facility to work and settle it. This karma is an item gifted for you and me by God to give to the world without making mistakes. It must be guarded.
Guru Vani

0: The ceremony performed by Brahmins lasts for nine and eleven days. This ceremony involves seating boys and girls, reading out a summary of the Puranas and epics, and explaining them both materially and spiritually. A summary of the six Shastras and the four Vedas is read over ten days (six plus four). The eleventh day is the wedding. They also perform a specific ritual during that wedding. Although not everyone does it at home now, it is still practiced in the homes of chief Tantris. In other homes, the father, mother, and closest relatives sit together, fill a large vessel with water, catch a fish, and while chanting Vedic mantras, make the bride and groom scoop it up. This symbolizes the birth of Vyasa.

However, the ignorance they imposed on the Shudra class includes Kettukalyanam and Pulikudi. This was done to prevent Shudras from attaining Brahmajnana (knowledge of Brahman). To announce that a girl has come of age, relatives and friends are invited. An ada (a type of pancake) is made using nine types of grains. The girl who has come of age is seated on a mat placed over this ada, and everyone gathers around and showers flowers on her back. This ada is then given to the Nair of the Illam. The remaining adas are cut and distributed to all relatives and friends. The name of this ada is Poriyuda. Whoever eats this Poriyuda will never attain Brahmavidya.

The ritual we have initiated to correct this misguided practice is Gurukula Brahmaniveditham. Brahmavidya is the knowledge acquired through the practices instructed by the Guru. For this, the girl must be protected as a Brahmacharini. Children worthy of Brahmajnana will be born to such a Brahmacharini after marriage. These children are called noble offspring (Salsanthanam). Such a ceremony did not exist among us before. Therefore, God has revealed this ceremony for us. It also signifies informing the parents and the community that the girl has reached the age to acquire knowledge. By following this path of instruction, one can at least reach the state of Saraswati, Parvati, or Lakshmi. Knowing at least this much, we must raise our girls and boys in a way that benefits the world. They can proceed as Brahmacharis and Brahmacharinis, as householders (Grihasthashramis), or through the stages of Brahmacharya, Kaumara, Vanaprastha, and Sannyasa. This is the knowledge we have received. This lineage in particular, and everyone else, must know this. The position these children attain is also acquired by their parents. The purity of the Gurukula Brahmaniveditham lineage, as that soul takes birth again, is intended to make this lineage universal. This is the purity of purpose behind this ritual. What they see through the vision they receive is the culmination of millions of years of sacrifice by not just gods and goddesses, but the entire lineage of prophets. This is why it is said that they should at least attain the position of Saraswati, Parvati, or Lakshmi through this vision. Even without making these sacrifices, children here who have the vision are attaining this state. This ritual is meant to bring that into our children through action. However, not all children may receive this blessing. For the lineage of children whose souls do not have this right, this ritual helps them acquire it through action. The Brahmacharis, Brahmacharinis, and householders here are proof of this.

What have the authors of the Puranas in the Vedic religious tradition done? The Puranas and epics are crafted in a way that does not equip children to distinguish between good and evil, nor does it make them worthy of the Guru's karma. Through the Guru's effort, while the Guru is present, we all receive this blessing. But what when the Guru is not there? Even while the Guru is alive, through disciples or visionary figures, all forms of karmic proficiency in the Guru-disciple relationship are attained by the disciples through the Guru's grace. This karmic proficiency in nature

It keeps it dissolved. One should consider whether the right to such a great ceremony is needed while the Guru is alive. All this must be made a right in Karma, included in Dharma, and given to the world through the Guru Parampara. Moreover, the goal of this ceremony called Gurukala Brahma Niveditham is to sort out some of the flaws committed according to customs included in the Vedic religion and to complete them in the Dharma of realization.

Through this karma, we are completing the karma of Chaturvarnya to serve the complete knowledge of the Satya Yuga. For this, parents, guardians, men, and women, without distinction, make the Brahma resolution the cause of world creation, and this Guru Parampara is the foundation for it.
1: February & March - 1999

The righteous should not seek Dharma in Tantra Santhigiri's concept is not a religious karma. It is a karma that points out the mistakes that have happened among the people and corrects those mistakes to help people come forward. Correcting the mistakes of the past way of living is what should be called reform. When it is said that pointing out mistakes is reform, that statement itself becomes a mistake. One should be able to say that there is such a way out to correct the mistake. That is Dharmic karma.

If reform is to be called Dharmic karma, the testimony of that karma must be the light form of life that stands as a continuous flow in the nine planetary spheres. We have a knowledge that considers everything as full of light, described as a special feature of Jyothi. This feature is mentioned from the first sky onwards. It is obtained from the light form of life that is filled continuously in the nine planetary spheres. It is the knowledge that the light inside a green tree is exactly the same as what is inside all living beings. The knowledge that does not understand this is what is found in Vedantas, and in the karma where historical truth was written by mixing Puranas, epics, and Vedas. Our knowledge is that everything from a blade of grass, to the water content shared in the five elements, and the five sheaths namely Annamaya Kosha, Pranamaya Kosha, Jnanamaya Kosha, Vijnanamaya Kosha, and Anandamaya Kosha, sustain life. Scholars have also tried to divide the five sheaths into six. Although that attempt is good for showing scholarship, and fits logic and intellect, it does not align with the truth. The extreme struggle of Yogis to develop life and make it a mere accumulation of knowledge is unbearable for man. This is a mistake that occurs in the course of completing scholarship by combining Yogi, Karmi, Jnani, and Bhakta, and understanding that it is the covering of one.

Scholars should at least see it this way. Today's science has grown by taking each atom from the atomic cells and working on it, understanding through intellect that the storage of new light happens from a single atom. Scientists had also established that this atom cannot be split. Now, who split this atom? The theory that an atom cannot be split is like the completion of Advaita. There are things said based on science. The path taken by one who speaks like that is not right. What is understood from this?

There are examples of this happening in nature without a tree. What it is like is that the objective application of emotional charge should only be spoken by a truthful person who classifies and makes the life experience felt. It is regarding the matter that travels a long distance starting from the Annamaya Kosha, operated in each cell by the great effort over a long period by truthful souls who sought the source of compassion in such great men, that it has been brought and stopped in the Anandamaya Kosha. The mathematics of the language created by Gundert is done in the same way as Vedanta is included in the Amarakosha, a dictionary of synonyms beginning with 'Amara Nirjjara Deva'. Rejoicing by taking many reservoirs and calculating that all are one is a flaw in karma, just like rejoicing by stating the mathematical description in the Amarakosha. One reservoir is not like another reservoir. How can a person who does not understand that all these reservoirs are taken and flowed into the sea, and that even this sea is contained within the earth, classify and shape life?

Beyond the seventh sea, there is an Ezhilampala or Ezhinampala. This is an imagination that is added to each person's logic. Does writing like this mean that they have seen it? Similarly, rejoicing by calculating the light of experience that occurs when crossing each sky, and only when the repetitive capacity of the past three periods reaches the fourth quarter, will one see that there is nothing where the Advaita religion speaks. Why does this scientist calculate sitting in a place where there is nothing like that? Will one become wise if this is called a vision and the empty or non-empty karma residue filled with scholarship is fitted into the intellect and created? The Amarakosha and Gundert's dictionary are fitted into the intellect in this way.

The science of the soul stands beyond that - beyond intellect, beyond thought. There is no room for thought there. There is no room for the intellect to work either. Here, the scientific scholarship of creating calculations in imagination and the scientific scholarship of creating a great language among languages (Sanskrit - the refined language) are not different. Both these sciences were confined within the covering circle of the Trimurti, whose face of knowledge was lost. This is scholarship. Therefore, no one understood the aspect that needs to be worked on in the fourth period. This is the mistake that has come to lie in the Trimurti system. This has never worked in the fourth period.

The meaning of Kali, the fourth period, is manifold. It is how karma works in each cell and reaches. If the capability of the grass is seen and its description is given, it is complete. When each grass is given each medicinal quality and completed, it is complete. Then it was turned into plants. When the repetitive capacity of plants comes, it is a different completion. For example, Ramappacha. When it itself undergoes renewal by joining the two fortnights, the bright fortnight and the dark fortnight, it becomes another completion.
120 years are stated for the completion of a human's life. If a human lives for these 120 years and exercises his intellect, of his vision or

Can the layers of imagination or evolution be completed? A layer means a lunar month equal to one year, a lunar month equal to 100 years, and a lunar month equal to 120 years. Just because this could be scientifically noted, is it possible to calculate and say how the special repetition of four eras, which a fool, a highly intelligent person, and a rogue with a cruel nature alike considered as truth, worked in the interplanetary division? In the state of time when a four-era cycle like Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dvapara, and Kali has passed, a great revolutionary song of a remnant of karma from salt to camphor, as our old uncles say, is resounding. Having discovered this, what can the knowledge-practice tainted by the sin of karma, which assigns the same position to truth and untruth, do?

So how will we believe anymore? Suppose we pick out all the good things and reject the bad things while classifying them as good and bad. Can one take an account of a lunar month by picking out only the good? Or if one picks out and shows the bad of a 100 years, will a person become wise? Similarly, even if one operates from the Annamaya Kosha to the Anandamaya Kosha inside the sin of karma corrupted by serving pedantry, it will not be enough. One must act. Vision is the means to act like that and bring an end. That is what is calculated up to the seventh heaven. This is a truth that resides only in a few era-men who happened across eras.

Because Sri Sankara spoke Advaita, if South Indian people who reach North India as sannyasis are asked which guru lineage they belong to, they will say Sankara lineage. If one says Sankara lineage, then there is no obstacle. One can go in anywhere. This is an over-trick used by all the Shudras in South India.

How would it be if this over-trick is put into caste? There are people who have acquired knowledge in each. In your own language, an encyclopedia. Just like a botanical garden that preserves plant diversities by writing and studying the names of plants, each movement in the name of these wise men is an encyclopedia that preserves each course of karma. Each is a system of karma where this knowledge and ignorance flow mixed together. Each will attain purity, distribute purity, and attain purity again.
Poornamada Poornamidam Poornaat Poornamudachyate Poornasya Poornamaadaaya Poornamevaavashishyate Om Shanti: Shanti: Shanti:
If peace is attained three times like this, where will the Vedic's peace reach?
This is completed by saying it in another way too; Antarjyoti Bahirjyoti Pratyagjyoti Paraalpara Jyotir Jyoti Svayam Jyoti Atmajyoti Shivotmakam

Is it enough if it is completed in this Tantric way? This is the completion of dharma caught in the Hindu's sin of karma. Other religionists who believe and do not believe in rebirth. What is the difference between the two? The seriousness of completing dharma in the Tantric way like this is only like a child playing with sand, making appam and puttu, and doing milk abhishekam, running away leaving it if given a beating. Therefore, these ignorant children

In the verbal spectacle of a vision completed through play... in the linguistic ability that is established, the downfall of human beings is completed. In this action where scholarship and ignorance cross swords and perish, let not the righteous fall! It is good for all human souls to think about this.

What we see from history and vision is that no great soul has ever found a place in their homeland. All religious theorists speak about vision. But very few say that such a vision is in such heavens. Some people convince themselves of certain visions about themselves. Because we did not understand their sacrifice, we could not accept their dharma with love. Not only that, some scholarly actions show the past Treta and Dvapara yugas that create miracles or show siddhis. When it comes to the place of truth, it is maya, mahamaya, blessing. Blessing is just making people worship demonic things, bringing them into human bodies, and blessing from that demonic action.

It is our ancestors and ourselves who are comforted in this way. Will we ever be able to respect the truth? Think! When all such thoughts are put together, it will become the action and dharma of the great scholar. But that is not true dharma; nor is it action. This is just an evaluation of opportunities that have become familiar due to the antiquity of many ages. That evaluation should be extended to three periods - Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga, Kali Yuga. Since the Satya Yuga's can be changed, some ways to bring that proclamation of knowledge to realization are mentioned here and there.
None of us are included in the struggle to prove the historical truth of this and that. Other people in the world are not included either. What to do? Let us pray for the good of all of them.

What is the action called vision? Vision is the dialogue between the guru and the disciple, recognizing the different states of cause, effect, gross, and subtle. It is the correction of knowledge between the disciple and the guru. It is not a theoretical justification that destroys action by merely talking about revelation and realization. This is an error in action that keeps theory as knowledge. This is the fault of not recognizing the difference between Hindu and Sanatana and putting it into practice. This is an orphaned martial arts school where the gymnasium of the intellect works in people who believe in God. The expression 'orphaned martial arts school' (Nadhanillakkalari) is not only in Malayalam but in all languages. The visionary aspect to understand in which heavens this orphaned martial arts school is affecting must be obtained from the guru.
Our loss of values is that we did not get the realization that Ishwara, God, Brahman, and Parabrahman are all different according to the determination of God or the determination of Brahman.
Guruvani
2: What we have seen so far is that if a Mahatma is born in a deserving or undeserving home, a decision is taken to destroy his life immediately. Theories insist that a Mahatma must be born as a king of kings. But if asked what the logic behind this theory is, we mostly see an inability to answer.

Many Mahatmas have come after Sree Krishna. All of them have come with the emergence of another theory. In short, Vyasa and many prophets born as world teachers, as well as the widespread scholarly clan that originated similarly, have determined this emergence. When studying the dharma theory built by Hindu dharma to confine everything within the divine form, it seems as if God himself has given a deceptive method. Krishna's birth itself is one such thing.

Before Krishna's birth, the seven children born to that mother were beaten to death. The eighth one was not found. Therefore, it was not killed. Although Poothana was brought for that purpose, she was destroyed, according to the storytellers. Looking at it that way, whether born as a king of kings, in a cowshed, or without distinction between a hut and a palace, poets have sung the karma story these Mahatmas have experienced in a decorative manner, disconnected from their lives.

If we look at the Mahatmas who came after Sree Krishna, we can see that their lives themselves have been played with. The ignorance of the scholar who presented this as a special story is not small. When looking at this on the path of Yuga Dharma, the truth has been hidden by praising all their lives in a way that time calculation cannot be brought into history. This is what is understood if we look at the long list of poetic imagination decorated in praise and blame. The first example of this is Sree Krishna's life itself.

Hiding the evidence that Sree Krishna came as a Guru, millions of stories depicting him as a god have been fabricated. Keeping the Dharma of being a Guru intact, making Krishna a god and the Gopis as Devadasis, the reality has been hidden through acquired stories without Dharma in the decorative style of great poets, leaving no place for Dharma and losing Karma. To create the story that Vyasa lived when Krishna was alive, Vyasa was specially given the name Krishna Dwaipayana.

Dwaraka sank. When Arjuna gathered everyone and left there as Krishna said, forest robbers looted everything from Arjuna. It is recorded that many were killed and Arjuna was let go. Then it is said that Vyasa said, the boons of the gods and the bow and arrows obtained from it were for you to use when the Lord was present.
It's over. Now we can go to renounce the world. Everyone knows that all this is said to have happened in the place where Gujarat is situated now.

Looking from then to now, the birth of all great souls after Krishna's time has been like a hidden arrow. Because Buddha was born in a royal family, they did nothing then and kept quiet. Finally, when he became a Bodhisattva, they killed him by giving him pork. Similarly, it is said that Jyotiramalingam went with his body. Then only a lamp remained. It is said that those who wrote the story of Rama many ages ago left his body in the river. The poet's imagination is that he was taken somewhere in a chariot. The same is the story of Ramatirtha attaining Jalasamadhi.

Thus, whoever became a Shudra by birth and a Dvija by action, all of them, even mere poets, have been destroyed in this way. What is the history of Kabir Das himself? Although it was written and managed that he was a disciple of Ramadas Swami, no one knows what that hardship was for. Here too, the story has been written and defeated. What is Kabir's devotion to his guru? Even if all the trees that have grown so far and will grow in the world are made into pens, and all the oceans are made into ink, the greatness of the guru will remain - this is Kabir's devotion to his guru.

When looking at the historical presence of great souls, the stories written about them rarely, have destroyed all their experiential truths in the waterless sea (incomprehensible) by putting them in the karma dosha of the ignorant. We must also carefully understand the purpose of writing and keeping the stories of Moses, Buddha, Jesus, and the Prophet who came after Krishna. These miraculous deeds written like this have been made to be done by poor intellectuals. When talking about realization or vision, except for recording it as the light of the world, the form of light, and the flood of light, there too the gods and goddesses have been glorified.

The truth of the birth of Moses and Jesus has been covered up so that it cannot be recognized. Even the part where karma was given to tell the sacrifice of Jesus has been wrong. If there is evidence that the Prophet who came after Jesus was beaten and driven away by the people, that the mountain was set on fire, and when the fire went out, he came down and ate roasted skin - and shouted that the jinn are ruling the world - why couldn't the place of Samadhi of that great man be fully revealed? In fact, as soon as he saw the demonic power of these jinn, he sat in that cemetery itself. Once you sit in one place, you will see urination and defecation for seven or eight days. Finally, he passed away there itself. Even with all this, where was that body taken and laid to rest? Without even keeping that historical truth straight to remind us of this, they are trying to maintain love in a harsher language than Hindus today. By pouring blessedness into the life of that great man in the way of this kind of love, the seekers of sacrifice have kept it as a land of ignorance in such a way that we cannot take it or handle it mutually.
What will happen to our children who take up such karma doshas?

From Sri Krishna till today, no one has been spared. Who can cure the karma dosha that keeps them as a miracle after the time of the great souls? Isn't this the evil desire of the demonic forces that do not agree to take up the karma of the land of sacrifice?

The extraordinary and decisive dharma that shows the endless excellence of yoga and karma, divided into four as yoga, bhakti, karma, and jnana, has been attempted to be illustrated through Sri Ramakrishna and Vivekananda. What can be done about the brave defenders of dharma who cause intellectual destruction by taking up arms in the names of Sri Shankara, Chattampi Swami, and Narayana Guru, who were born in Kerala? They have left the people as complete scarecrows and pushed them into the veil of blindness. Caste, religion, and class hatred have grown in them to such an extent that even if God started forgiving, it would be impossible.

The blue sky is a colorless color that stands beyond the seven stages called jnanabhumika. The path of karma that has walked into the growth of science, which has written the theoretical lines of the nine planets in the language of scholars and laymen, is what exists today. Science should not become miserable and countless. Today's aeronautics is like this. Scientists should think whether these inventions, which can destroy the entire earth like madmen by giving all these names, are needed or not. What is to be achieved by taking the size and weight of each planet? What part of knowledge is going to emerge from it? What can be taken from it other than the path of karma that makes a goat a dog, as the old people say? What to say to these utter fools who travel in such a way that they never get consciousness in life, dress up in silk, leave the language called the crest jewel of scholars, and maintain a culture by dressing up as neither man nor woman, serving karma that burns with intellect! We have nothing to do with this baseless story that cultivates such a sense of humor. We also know that this is the failure of our daily life. Don't we need at least a good imagination?

Will the stage of karma come if the karma to be realized through life is lost by singing, talking, and writing? Is there anything else in this beyond the intellect that obeys or makes one obey by law? Aren't all these seen the playhouses of good and evil that bring God's words into the intellect by singing? Who doesn't know that all this is growing and spoiling the human masses who do not know how to behave knowing that it has come due to the mistake of the yugadharma.

Who doesn't know that only what the court creates by telling the truth in the name of God will happen? What has the legacy of ignorant creators who try to choose good and evil through people like Mugalalyam and Brigadier made us, the human figures who have created so much misery, as warmongers? Dharma has been presented by making us believe that this is the rule of the world. I ask you again, what else is there to say whether the burden of sin that came due to the mistake of the yugadharma is to test the ability of each person? What is that? Know it truly, think.
